How Coverage is Scheduled:

Coverage operates on a predictable, month-ahead framework to respect your schedule:

  • Planned Coverage: Your clinical blocks are confirmed at the start of each month to backfill known PTO and planned absences
    • This forms the basis of your committed hours
  • Dedicated Inbox Windows: A fixed portion of your weekly hours is pre-scheduled to manage the floating inbox queue, ensuring care loop closure
  • Short-Notice Flex (optional): You may opt into pre-agreed day-time flex windows to be activated for same-day call-outs
    • This is voluntary, defined in advance, and operates strictly within core weekday business hours
  • Days / Shifts: The shifts to work will be 8am - 5pm Monday - Friday. No weekend hours.

Responsibilities will include:

  • Essential Functions
    • Patient Care & Panel Coverage
      • Conduct comprehensive virtual onboarding, annual, transition-of-care, and follow-up visits - facilitated by an in-home Health Advocate or fully virtual - completing biopsychosocial assessments and managing complex chronic conditions (hypertension, diabetes, COPD, heart disease)
      • Order and follow up on labs and imaging to inform immediate treatment plans
      • Deliver targeted health coaching, lifestyle counseling, and disease-specific education to support patient self-management
      • Execute thorough, documented clinical handoffs back to the primary longitudinal care pod at the close of each coverage block
    • Systematic Inbox & Triage Management
      • Dedicate a set number of scheduled hours each week to clearing the centralized Float Pool queue: signing off normal results, managing critical medication refills, contacting patients with updates on abnormal results , and routing complex issues to permanent care teams
      • Provide rapid results management and urgent clinical triage for virtual and hybrid providers during their absences
    • Quality & Collaboration
      • Support preventative-care quality campaigns, including focused outreach and HEDIS/STARs gap closure
      • Provide real-time clinical guidance to Health Advocates during virtual visits; coordinate with behavioral health, nursing, pharmacy, and external providers
      • Possible attendance of weekly Multidisciplinary Care Conferences (MDCC) as needed to support care coordination for complex patients
      • Maintain accurate, timely, compliant EMR documentation with rigorous diagnostic coding and adherence to evidence-based care plans
  • Other Job Functions
    • Performs other duties as assigned

What makes you a fit for the team:

  • Clinical Detective: You excel at jumping into unfamiliar charts, investigating across systems quickly, and safely managing complex chronic patients with minimal ramp
  • Highly Adaptable: You thrive amid shifting priorities and float comfortably between provider panels while maintaining clinical excellence
  • Mission-Driven: Deeply committed to serving historically underserved populations through an integrated, tech-enabled model
  • Tech-Forward: Fluent with telehealth platforms and enthusiastic about incorporating emerging tools, software, and AI-enabled clinical workflows into daily practice to maximize efficiency

Desired skills and experience:

  • Required
    • Active, unrestricted Nurse Practitioner (NP) or Physician Assistant (PA) license
    • Active NP/PA licensure in at least one of the following core markets: MI, MA, or CO (with a willingness to obtain additional state licenses as requested)

    • Hands-on experience using AI tools in a clinical setting to optimize efficiency

jobs.excerpt: Role: Cloud Security Engineer / AI Security Engineer Location: Los Angeles, CA (Remote – 10% Travel; must be comfortable traveling to client sites for workshops and meetings) Duration: 3+ Months (Extension Possible)💼 Experience: 15+ Years Primary Skills: IAM Policy Templates, Cedar Policies Role Overview:Seeking an experienced Security Engineer with 15+ years of experience in cloud security and identity management to secure enterprise AI applications on AWS.
jobs.description:
Role: Cloud Security Engineer / AI Security Engineer

Location: Los Angeles, CA (Remote – 10% Travel; must be comfortable traveling to client sites for workshops and meetings)

Duration: 3+ Months (Extension Possible)

💼 Experience: 15+ Years

Primary Skills: IAM Policy Templates, Cedar Policies

Role Overview:

Seeking an experienced Security Engineer with 15+ years of experience in cloud security and identity management to secure enterprise AI applications on AWS. The role focuses on authentication, reusable IAM policy templates, Cedar-based authorization, and secure access to tools, APIs, and enterprise resources.

Key Responsibilities

1. IAM Policy Templates & Access Management

  • Design, develop, and maintain reusable AWS IAM policy templates for AI agents and AgentCore infrastructure.
  • Implement role-based access control (RBAC) and least-privilege security principles.
  • Define IAM roles, trust policies, permission boundaries, and resource-based policies.
  • Configure IAM execution roles for AgentCore Runtime and AgentCore Gateway.
  • Develop standardized IAM templates for accessing AWS services such as Lambda, S3, Bedrock, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, and CloudWatch.
  • Automate IAM policy deployment and configuration using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or AWS CDK.
  • Conduct IAM access reviews, permission audits, and policy validation.
  • Troubleshoot access-denied issues, role-assumption failures, and authorization misconfigurations.

2. Cedar Policies at AgentCore Gateway

  • Design, author, test, and deploy Cedar authorization policies using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Policy.
  • Implement fine-grained authorization for AI agents accessing tools through AgentCore Gateway.
  • Define policies specifying which identities can invoke particular tools, APIs, and operations.
  • Configure policy engines and associate them with AgentCore Gateways.
  • Implement attribute-based access control (ABAC) using identity attributes, roles, scopes, and contextual conditions.
  • Develop policies that restrict sensitive tool operations based on business roles, permissions, and security requirements.
  • Validate Cedar policies against gateway schemas and test permitted and denied access scenarios.
  • Enforce default-deny authorization and prevent unauthorized tool execution.
  • Monitor and troubleshoot authorization decisions and policy evaluation failures.

3. Security Governance & Compliance

  • Implement security controls for enterprise AI agents and Generative AI applications.
  • Develop security standards for agent identities, API integrations, and access management.
  • Support audit logging, access traceability, and security monitoring using AWS CloudTrail and CloudWatch.
  • Identify and mitigate risks including excessive privileges, credential exposure, unauthorized tool access, and privilege escalation.
  • Conduct security reviews of agent architecture and integrations.
  • Collaborate with AI engineering and DevOps teams to ensure secure production deployments.

4. Security Automation & DevSecOps

  • Automate security policy deployment through GitHub Actions and infrastructure-as-code pipelines.
  • Integrate IAM and Cedar policy validation into CI/CD workflows.
  • Implement automated security checks and policy compliance testing.
  • Maintain version-controlled security configurations across development, testing, and production environments.
  • Support security incident investigation, access troubleshooting, and remediation.

Required Technical Skills

  • AWS Security: IAM, IAM roles, policies, STS, AWS Secrets Manager, CloudTrail, CloudWatch.
  • Authorization: Cedar policy language, RBAC, ABAC, fine-grained access control.
  • Authentication: OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, AWS IAM authentication.
  • Infrastructure as Code: Terraform, AWS CDK, or CloudFormation.
  • Automation: Python, GitHub Actions, CI/CD security integration.
  • Cloud Security: Least-privilege access, identity federation, credential management, and secure API integrations.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.description:
Why Workit:

Workit Health is an industry-leading provider of on-demand, evidence-based telemedicine care. Our programs are based in harm reduction, and bring together licensed clinicians who really listen, FDA-approved medication, online recovery groups and community, interactive therapeutic courses, and care for co-existing conditions. Workit Health's patient-centered telemedicine model is improving clinical outcomes and eliminating barriers to treatment, making long-term recovery accessible to individuals who need it, without disrupting their daily lives.

We’re excited to expand our team as our impact and coverage areas continue to grow. Our team members are dedicated and passionate about our mission of making exceptional, judgment-free care for addiction more accessible.

We believe everyone deserves respectful, effective treatment for substance use disorder at the moment they're ready for it. We're looking for driven and compassionate individuals who share this goal. Join us in reducing stigma, saving lives, and changing the way addiction is treated in America.

Active state licensure: California
Schedule: 4x10 (4 days a week / 10 hours per day)
Hours: 8am-6pm PST

Job Summary:

As a Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant at Workit Health, you will be responsible for collaborating with a physician to provide whole-person care to patients with substance use disorders via our telehealth platform. Currently all of our positions are remote until further notice.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Co-facilitate virtual shared medical appointments and individual appointments by providing clinical assessments, treatments, and medication management.
  • Conduct new patient evaluations.
  • Make appropriate assessments, treatment plans, and referrals for patient problems.
  • Prescribe and monitor medications for opioid use disorder and alcohol use disorder.
  • Provide patient education and referrals, specific to patients assessed needs.
  • Maintain standards of confidentiality, HIPAA and 42 CFR Part II.
  • Utilize strong communication skills, verbal and written.
  • Maintain accurate patient records in EMR system.
  • Provide excellent member experiences resolving member inquiries and ensure our members’ needs are placed first.
  • Commitment to Harm Reduction philosophy in all aspects of clinical practice.
*Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time.

Qualifications:

  • 1 year of experience as a Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant
  • Active California state Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant license in good standing.
  • Minimum of 1 year experience in addiction medicine required
  • Experience prescribing SUD medications
  • Experience with harm reduction
  • Active DEA license
  • Current BLS certification
  • Willingness to obtain licensure in additional states
  • Ability to adapt and be flexible in a changing and evolving work environment
  • Ability and willingness to complete work independently online; familiarity with Google Drive, spreadsheets, documentation, video conferencing, and secure email
  • Professionalism, punctuality, and reliability a must
  • Enthusiasm for revolutionizing the way addiction is addressed and treated is necessary.
Pay range
$140,000—$150,000 USD

Benefits & Rewards:

  • Fully remote work
  • 5 weeks PTO (includes your birthday, 2 mental health days, and 2 floating holidays!)
  • 11 paid holidays
  • Comprehensive health, dental, pharmacy, and vision insurance with options to fit your family's needs
  • 12 weeks paid Parental Leave after 1 year of employment (includes maternity, paternity, adoption, and all ways in which our people build modern families)
  • 401k + 4% matching
  • Healthcare & dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA & DCFSA)
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA)
  • Employee assistance program, complete with financial coaching and counseling sessions
  • Professional development allowance for Providers and Behavioral Health team
  • Opportunities for internal mobility and growth at a Company with a proven track record of really promoting internally
  • Vibrant, democratized culture with clubs and multiple ERG groups
  • Colleagues who care deeply about closing health disparity gaps within the addiction space for underserved populations

Equal Opportunities for Everyone, including Folks in Recovery:

As we are an addiction recovery company founded by people in recovery, those in addiction recovery themselves are encouraged to apply. Workit Health is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

AI Interview Policy:

At Workit Health, we value authenticity, curiosity, and personal insight during our hiring process. To ensure a fair and genuine experience for all candidates, we ask that you refrain from using AI tools or external assistance during interviews or assessments. We’re most interested in your unique ideas, problem-solving approach, and communication style—qualities that help us understand how you’ll contribute to our team. Demonstrating your own thinking and creativity gives both you and us the best sense of fit and potential.

Privacy Policy:

jobs.excerpt: About TurvoTurvo provides a collaborative Transportation Management System (TMS) application designed specifically for the supply chain.
jobs.description:
About Turvo

Turvo provides a collaborative Transportation Management System (TMS) application designed specifically for the supply chain. Turvo Collaboration Cloud connects freight brokers, 3PLs, shippers, and carriers to unite supply chain ecosystems, delivering outstanding customer experiences, real-time collaboration, and accelerated growth. The technology unifies internal and external systems, providing one end-to-end solution that streamlines operations, enhances analytics, and automates business processes while eliminating redundant manual tasks. Turvo’s customers include some of the world’s largest Fortune 500 logistics service providers and shippers as well as small to mid-sized freight brokers. Turvo is based in Dallas, Texas, with offices in Hyderabad, India. ().

About the Role

Turvo is seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Manager to lead the development, execution, and optimization of our digital marketing strategies. This role will be responsible for driving brand visibility, attracting qualified prospects, generating sales pipeline, and contributing directly to revenue growth through integrated, data-driven marketing programs.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on digital marketing strategist with deep expertise in search engine optimization (SEO), Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), paid media, website optimization, marketing automation, and performance analytics. They understand how to leverage digital channels to engage B2B buyers throughout the customer journey, convert interest into qualified opportunities, and continuously improve marketing ROI.

This individual will own Turvo's digital demand generation strategy, combining inbound marketing, paid acquisition, account-based marketing (ABM), and lifecycle campaigns to accelerate new customer acquisition and support customer engagement and retention.

Primary Responsibilities

    Digital Marketing Strategy & Execution

  • Develop, own, and execute a comprehensive digital marketing strategy designed to increase qualified website traffic, generate inbound leads, build sales pipeline, and support annual recurring revenue (ARR) growth.
  • Plan, execute, and optimize integrated digital campaigns across paid search, organic search, social, email, retargeting, and other relevant channels.
  • Manage digital marketing budgets and optimize channel investments based on performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, and pipeline contribution.
  • Identify and test new digital channels, technologies, and tactics to expand reach and improve demand generation performance.

    • SEO, AEO & Website Optimization

  • Own Turvo's SEO and AEO strategies to improve organic search visibility, increase high-intent traffic, and strengthen brand discovery across traditional search engines and AI-powered search platforms.
  • Develop and execute keyword, content, technical SEO, and on-page optimization strategies to improve search rankings and organic lead generation.
  • Partner with internal teams and agencies to optimize website content, landing pages, calls to action, and conversion paths to improve visitor-to-lead conversion rates.
  • Monitor website performance, user behavior, and conversion metrics to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

    • Paid Media & Digital Advertising

  • Develop, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Reddit, and other relevant B2B advertising platforms with agency partners.
  • Own campaign strategy, audience targeting, budget allocation, creative development, A/B testing, and performance optimization.
  • Continuously evaluate campaign performance against key metrics, including cost per lead, cost per opportunity, conversion rates, and pipeline ROI.
  • Develop retargeting and audience segmentation strategies to engage high-intent prospects and accelerate conversion.

    • Marketing Automation, ABM & Lead Nurturing

  • Leverage HubSpot to build and optimize automated marketing workflows, lead nurturing programs, segmentation strategies, and lifecycle campaigns.
  • Develop targeted ABM campaigns to engage high-value accounts and key decision-makers within Turvo's priority industries and market segments.
  • Partner closely with Sales to align digital marketing initiatives with account priorities, pipeline objectives, and buyer engagement strategies.
  • Optimize lead capture, lead scoring, lead routing, and nurturing processes to improve marketing-to-sales conversion.

    • Analytics, Reporting & Performance Optimization

  • Establish and monitor KPIs across digital channels, including website traffic, engagement, lead generation, conversion rates, marketing-sourced pipeline, and revenue attribution.
  • Utilize Google Analytics (GA4), HubSpot, and other reporting tools to evaluate campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide visibility into marketing performance and ROI.
  • Present campaign results, insights, and strategic recommendations to Sales and executive leadership.
  • Apply data-driven insights, testing, and continuous experimentation to improve campaign efficiency and maximize marketing investment.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Sales, Product Marketing, and other internal stakeholders to develop compelling messaging, digital content, and campaigns aligned with Turvo's growth objectives.
  • Partner with content and creative resources to develop high-performing digital assets, including landing pages, advertising creative, emails, and campaign content.
  • Stay current on emerging digital marketing trends, AI-driven marketing technologies, and evolving B2B buyer behaviors.

Qualifications, Skills & Experience

  • 5–7 years of experience developing and executing B2B digital marketing and demand generation strategies, preferably within SaaS, enterprise technology, logistics, or supply chain software.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
  • Demonstrated success driving measurable results through digital marketing, including qualified lead generation, pipeline growth, and marketing ROI.
  • Strong expertise in SEO, AEO, Google Ads, Google Analytics (GA4), paid social advertising, and conversion rate optimization.
  • Advanced proficiency in HubSpot, including Marketing Hub, CRM, marketing automation, campaign management, lead scoring, workflows, and reporting.
  • Experience managing LinkedIn advertising and other B2B paid media platforms.
  • Strong understanding of website optimization, landing page performance, content strategy, and digital buyer journeys.
  • Experience developing and executing ABM campaigns, email nurture programs, and audience segmentation strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate marketing performance data into actionable strategies and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience managing digital marketing budgets and evaluating campaign performance against acquisition costs and pipeline contribution.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered marketing tools and emerging search and content discovery trends.
  • Proficiency with collaboration and creative tools such as Slack, Canva, and Google Workspace.
  • Excellent project management, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • A proactive, resourceful, and hands-on approach, with the ability to independently manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Turvo?

At Turvo, we're transforming how the logistics and supply chain industry connects, collaborates, and operates with a vision to unify the global supply chain network. As our Digital Marketing Manager, you'll play a critical role in shaping our marketing strategy, expanding our market presence, and driving measurable business growth.
We're looking for someone who combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution, thrives on performance data, and is passionate about using digital marketing to generate real business results.
If you're excited about building high-performing digital marketing programs and making a direct impact on revenue growth, we'd love to hear from you.

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Partner to support our Engineering and Product organizations. You’ll be a trusted advisor to hiring managers, guiding them through our hiring process and partnering with them on sourcing, interviewing, and closing offers. You’ll also work closely with TA Operations to improve our recruiting processes and drive recruiting-related projects that help us scale our hiring.

This is a full-time remote position.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Parallel Advisors is looking for a results-driven, experienced Tax Manager for our rapidly expanding tax department. You will be joining a fast-growing Registered Investment Advisory firm with a culture of entrepreneurship, education, and collaboration. Our Tax Manager will work closely with our Tax Team, clients, and financial advisors to deliver high-touch, comprehensive service to our clients. This role requires a strong understanding of complex tax issues, excellent client-facing capabilities, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, personalized environment.
This position will work to aid our organization in maintaining a high level of service to our clients in the areas of tax compliance, tax advisory, and proactive planning. You may also be asked to work with other cross-functional teams on other duties, such as financial projections, which support our service model and the overall mission of the Firm.
This is a fully remote role. It can be based in any state Parallel Advisors, LLC operates in.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Preparation of complex tax returns for high-net-worth individuals and their related business and investment entities.
  • Analysis of client books (e.g. QBO) for extraction of pertinent tax data and to propose year-end adjustments where appropriate.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for external client communications regarding tax matters, ensuring a high level of service and responsiveness
  • Prepare Quarterly & Year-End Tax Projections for clients and compute estimated tax payments.
  • Perform tax research and recommend solutions to client tax questions as needed.
  • Act as point person for assigned clients, responding to technical questions and requests from clients and/or advisors as they arise.

Qualifications

  • BA/BS in Finance, Accounting, or related field
  • Active CPA license or IRS Enrolled Agent (CPA preferred)
  • 7+ years of experience preparing complex tax returns for high-net-worth clients
  • Experience with professional tax software packages (i.e. Lacerte, Ultra Tax CS, CCH Axcess or ProSystem fx) and automated digital workpaper solutions (i.e. SurePrep) preferred
  • Experience with QuickBooks Online preferred
  • Ability to use deductive reasoning to identify or determine if the client qualifies for credits or deductions
  • Exceptional analytical skills for solving mathematical problems
  • Exceptional organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and deadline-oriented environment
  • Capability to manage multiple demands and competing priorities.
  • Sound judgment regarding confidential and sensitive matters.
  • CRM experience (Salesforce preferred) a plus.

Company: Parallel Advisors, LLC

- Parallel Advisors is a fast-growing, independent, Registered Investment Advisory firm. We are headquartered in San Francisco, CA and have offices in Arizona, Colorado, Hawaii, Michigan, Ohio, and Texas.
- To enhance our clients’ futures, we seek to know where they are today and where they want to be tomorrow. That means understanding not only their assets, such as concentrated stock holdings, real estate, and earning potential but also their aspirations, including all of their future financial goals.
- With this information in-hand, we chart, assess, and evaluate different scenarios based upon their unique objectives, risk tolerances, and time horizons. From this insight, we build a financial framework from which all our recommendations – including savings directives, insurance requirements, and investment strategies – flow. This framework provides a repeatable, measurable way to make objective decisions as to how to allocate their assets now and into their future.
- We offer our clients an open array of investment solutions, fee-based, and independent of any proprietary platforms.
- At Parallel, we combine the best advisors, support staff, and industry-leading technology in collaborative partnership to offer our clients an extraordinary experience.
- Parallel Advisors, LLC is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.excerpt: We are hiring a Director of VAR GTM & Enablement to build a scalable payments channel within Acumatica’s established SMB and lower-middle-market VAR ecosystem.
jobs.description:
We are hiring a Director of VAR GTM & Enablement to build a scalable payments channel within Acumatica’s established SMB and lower-middle-market VAR ecosystem.

With a live, proven product, you will create a repeatable GTM operating model that changes partner behavior and converts VAR relationships into measurable payments pipeline, activated merchants, payment volume, and revenue.

As a senior individual contributor, you will work across Partner Programs, Payments, Sales, Product, and Marketing to educate and evangelize the Payments opportunity and also identify and remove barriers to VAR payments adoption and selling at scale.

This commercial GTM leadership role excludes net-new VAR recruitment, partner-program operations, and direct sales with a focus on partner engagement and sign-ups.

This is a cross-functional role working closely with the Payments GM (products), Payments partner sales teams, Operations for metrics and program management, Partner recruitment and enablement, as well as Partner Account Management (sales), and Customer Success.

What You Will Own

Drive VAR Activation and Payment Volume

  • Own the payments adoption funnel across the North American Acumatica VAR base — from awareness and certification through first transaction, repeat usage, and scaled payment volume.
  • Segment VARs by potential, readiness, economics, and adoption behavior. Build differentiated activation strategies for each segment that increase payments productivity and customer attach rate.
  • Define the partner-level metrics, reporting, and operating cadence, focused on payment volume and resulting partner-sourced payments revenue. This is the north star.

Build Joint GTM with Strategic VARs

  • Build and execute joint business plans with priority VARs, including shared objectives, pipeline development, activation targets, forecasts, and quarterly business reviews.
  • Work directly with VAR executives and sales leaders to understand their Acumatica practice economics, services revenue, seller incentives, and customer priorities.
  • Develop repeatable plays that help VAR sellers position, sell, deploy, and expand payments within their existing Acumatica customer base.
  • Establish a disciplined operating cadence for pipeline, partner performance, forecasts, and business reviews.
  • Translate successful partner motions into repeatable plays that can scale beyond individual strategic relationships.

Build and Scale VAR Enablement

  • Design a VAR enablement strategy specific to the Acumatica ecosystem: product knowledge, payments economics, positioning against incumbent payment providers, objection handling, and sales execution.
  • Build certification programs tied to measurable partner activation and program-tier objectives measuring success through behavioral and commercial outcomes — not checkbox training.
  • Create sales tools purpose-built for Acumatica VAR sellers: battlecards, ROI tools, competitive positioning, talk tracks, use cases, and demo environments.
  • Design enablement that reaches hundreds of VARs without requiring high-touch support for every partner.

Optimize Partner Economics and the Program

  • Evolve the payments partner program, including tiering, incentives, MDF, deal registration, certification, and partner benefits, with a clear focus on driving partner behavior and payment economics.
  • Set program requirements and benefits that reward behaviors that drive payment volume: active selling, first transactions, and scaled usage.
  • Use partner performance data and market feedback to continuously improve partner economics and define a program evolution roadmap as the channel matures.

Diagnose and Remove Adoption Barriers

  • Identify root causes of partner underperformance: technical friction, sales capability gaps, compensation misalignment, competitive positioning, operational complexity, or product gaps.
  • Translate partner feedback into actionable requirements and scalable fixes for Product, Marketing, Solutions Engineering, Operations, and Payments leadership.
  • Secure cross-functional ownership and resources to resolve barriers through influence rather than direct organizational authority.

Represent the Payments Program

  • Serve as the senior internal and external voice for the payments partner program, building credibility with VAR leaders through expertise in Acumatica ERP and embedded payments.
  • Lead partner advisory sessions, executive business reviews, partner events, and relevant industry forums.
  • Bring market, partner, and competitive intelligence into internal product, commercial, and strategic decisions.

What Success Looks Like

Success means turning a large installed base of Acumatica VAR relationships into a productive, scalable payments channel measured primarily by payment volume and partner-sourced payments revenue.

Key outcomes include:

  • Increased percentage of enabled VARs actively selling the available Acumatica Payments solution.
  • Increased percentage of participating VARs completing their first payment transaction.
  • Increased repeat and scaled payment activity across activated VARs.
  • Increased partner-sourced payments pipeline and revenue.
  • Improved productivity and customer attach rates among priority VARs.
  • Increased adoption of certification, tiering, and incentive structures.
  • Better visibility into partner-level performance, pipeline, forecasts, and commercial contribution.
  • A repeatable VAR GTM and enablement model that scales across hundreds of North American Acumatica partners.

Specific performance targets will be established based on the company's current partner base, payments economics, and growth objectives.

Required

  • 8+ years in channel, partnerships, indirect sales, partner GTM, partner enablement, or related roles.
  • Deep ERP and channel expertise is required, with demonstrated experience working with ERP VARs, resellers, dealers, or implementation partners.
  • Demonstrated experience working within SMB and/or lower-middle-market ERP ecosystems.
  • Direct experience with the Acumatica ecosystem is strongly preferred.
  • Proven ability to drive commercial outcomes through an indirect partner base rather than relying on direct sales ownership.
  • Experience building or evolving partner programs, enablement motions, certification programs, incentives, or other mechanisms that change partner behavior and drive revenue.
  • Strong understanding of VAR business models, including reseller economics, services revenue, implementation cycles, recurring revenue, and seller incentives.
  • Working knowledge of B2B payments mechanics and economics, including acquiring/processing fundamentals, embedded payments models, and partner revenue-share structures. Direct B2B payments industry experience is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to work directly with partner executives and senior internal stakeholders.
  • Strong commercial judgment and comfort using partner, pipeline, payment-volume, and revenue data to diagnose performance.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence independent businesses or sales organizations where you do not control compensation, headcount, or day-to-day execution.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional leaders and secure resources without direct organizational authority.
  • Ability to operate effectively as a senior individual contributor in a matrixed organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to build structure and operating processes where none currently exist.
  • Executive presence and strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred

  • Direct experience in B2B payments, fintech, merchant services, embedded payments, or payment technology.
  • Experience selling or enabling B2B payments through an ERP, POS, ISV, or VAR ecosystem.
  • Experience developing joint business plans and executive-level QBRs.
  • Experience designing partner tiers, incentives, MDF, deal registration, or certification.
  • Experience with partner CRM/PRM systems and performance analytics.
  • Experience working across Product, Sales, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and Solutions Engineering.

jobs.description:
About the Remote Licensed Therapist (1099 Contractor) role at Headspace:

Headspace is currently seeking part-time, independently licensed contractor therapists to provide direct, virtual care as part of a multidisciplinary team on a 1099 contract basis.

To get started, we strongly encourage having 10+ hours available per week with full flexibility to adjust; more is always welcome depending on your schedule! Please note that due to care demand and member scheduling fluctuations, it could take a number of weeks to achieve a consistent schedule.

The pay for the Contract Mental Health Therapist ranges from $82-$87 per teletherapy session. Exact reimbursement rates will be determined during the interview process and are based on a number of factors including but not limited to location, licensure type, experience, specializations, languages spoken, and populations treated.

Session length is 60 minutes for an intake and 45 minutes for a follow up appointment, with concurrent note-taking expected and included in the session rate. All Headspace therapists must be licensed and reside in the US. Due to the nature of healthcare services provided to our customers, partners and members, all work must be provided in the U.S. Data, specifically personal health information may not be accessed, disclosed or used outside of the U.S. Please note that the U.S. is limited to the 50 states of the United States -- it does not include U.S. territories like Puerto Rico.

Why Work on the Headspace Network:

  • Exceptional Care, backed by Clinical Expertise: Bring your deep expertise to a platform that delivers exceptional measurement-based care. Headspaces’ comprehensive training and clinical support teams will partner with you to ensure member success, while our robust quality assurance process ensures ongoing support–enhancing your practice and providing a framework for continuous improvement in clinical outcomes.
  • World Class Content Created by a Beloved Brand:Supplement your member support with thousands of expert-led exercises, mood-boosting meditations, and stress-relieving tools for all of life’s moments. Whether your members report feeling stressed or anxious, need support navigating their caregiver journey, or experiencing grief, our content supports individual goals with tools backed by research and delivered by trained mindfulness experts.
  • Seamless Support for You and Your Members: A dedicated team at Headspace handles the operational details, allowing you to concentrate on what you do best — delivering high quality care. With intentional communication, a suite of administrative and clinical tools, and resources, we ensure providers and members feel supported every step of the way.
  • Education That Empowers Excellence: Benefit from access to a best-in-class training institute that prioritizes pragmatic, evidence-based approaches to transdiagnostic care and culturally responsive practice. Our education program promotes continuous skill development, improving your clinical expertise while expanding your knowledge and capabilities.
  • A Community of Care: Join a network of peers and Headspace experts with opportunities to collaborate, connect, and grow together while delivering on our mission to provide every person access to lifelong mental health support.

What you will do:

  • Provide high quality, innovative, tele-therapy to Headspace patients over a HIPAA compliant video conferencing platform
  • Complete, sign and lock clinical case notes in EMR within 48 hours of session as part of the per-session reimbursement rate.
  • Maintain your personalized database to record proof of licensure, license updates, expiration dates, personal information, etc.
  • Keep your availability calendar up to date
  • Work with a collaborative care team including health coaches, other therapists, psychiatrists, and external care providers

What you will bring:

  • 3+ years experience providing clinical psychotherapy to individuals, couples or families
  • An independent clinical license to practice in good standing (without need for clinical supervision), at the Master or Doctoral levelBC-TMH credential, if required by your state of license
  • Ability to offer at least 10 sessions per week for bookings, with the ability to flex up or down as needed
    • Night and weekend flexibility a plus
  • Clinical competence in evidence-based practices (CBT, DBT, ACT, Mindfulness, etc.) and measurement-based care
  • Experience with risk management and higher acuity cases
  • Knowledge, ability, and commitment to providing culturally responsive care
  • Familiarity, comfort and confidence with care delivery technology - various applications, tech tools, google web-apps, video conferencing, EMR, etc.
  • A safe secure location with reliable internet connection to provide Zoom-based psychotherapy
  • Effective communication skills and ability to work within interdisciplinary teams

Preferred (if applicable)

  • Licensure in multiple states
  • Licensed psychologist with willingness to apply for (or is already enrolled) with PSYPACT
  • Ability to deliver care to a variety of populations
  • Multilingual
  • Familiarity with the Headspace app and content
  • Willingness to include evening availability in your schedule to support member care flexibility

Privacy Statement

All member records are protected according to our Privacy Policy. Further, while employees and contractors of Headspace (formerly Ginger) cannot access Headspace products/services, they will be offered benefits according to the company's benefit plan. To ensure we are adhering to best practice and ethical guidelines in the field of mental health, we take care to avoid dual relationships. A dual relationship occurs when a mental health care provider has a second, significantly different relationship with their client in addition to the traditional client-therapist relationship—including, for example, a managerial relationship.

As such, Headspace requests that individuals who have received coaching or clinical services at Headspace wait until their care with Headspace is complete before applying for a position. If someone with a Headspace account is hired for a position, please note their account will be deactivated and they will not be able to use Headspace services for the duration of their employment.

Further, if Headspace cannot find a role that fails to resolve an ethical issue associated with a dual relationship, Headspace may need to take steps to ensure ethical obligations are being adhered to, including a delayed start date or a potential leave of absence. Such steps would be taken to protect both the former member, as well as any relevant individuals from their care team, from impairment, risk of exploitation, or harm.

jobs.description:
AP Operations, Automation & Scalability

• Own the end-to-end invoice-to-pay and payment lifecycle across legal entities, physician practices, and locations.

• Serve as functional owner and subject-matter expert for Coupa/Coupa Pay, including invoice workflows, approval routing, supplier enablement, payment configuration, and settlement processes.

• Develop a highly automated AP operating model using PO-based purchasing, EDI/e-invoicing, OCR, supplier portals, automated matching, and exception-based processing.

• Establish measurable automation, productivity, service-level, and transaction-capacity targets; continually redesign processes to scale without corresponding increases in headcount.

• Design and maintain structured 2-way and 3-way matching, approval workflows, and exception management.

Vendor Payment Onboarding & Master Data

• Own the financial/payment component of vendor onboarding following Procurement approval, including W-9s, banking instructions, remittance information, and required payment documentation.

• Establish and maintain the appropriate payment method for each supplier, prioritizing virtual card and ACH where appropriate and using checks by exception.

• Maintain strong vendor-master controls, including segregation of duties, independent validation of banking changes, duplicate-vendor controls, and fraud-prevention procedures.

• Partner with Treasury on payment runs, cash requirements, positive pay, ACH controls, settlement, stale checks, and payment optimization.

Acquisition & Practice Integration

• Own and maintain a standardized AP integration playbook for acquisitions and newly integrated practices.

• Lead pre-close and post-close AP readiness, including vendor inventories, outstanding invoices/liabilities, recurring payments, open POs, approval authorities, payment methods, banking information, and legacy AP processes.

• Establish vendors and payment workflows within Coupa and the appropriate legal entity/TIN and ensure appropriate cutoff between seller obligations and post-close obligations.

• Develop Day 1, 30-day, 60-day, and 90-day AP integration milestones; proactively communicate risks, decisions, dependencies, and outstanding items to stakeholders.

T&E, Corporate Cards & Spend Management

• Own administration and enforcement of the Company’s T&E and corporate card policies.

• Administer cardholder onboarding/offboarding, credit limits, merchant controls, receipt compliance, policy exceptions, and unusual-transaction review.

• Configure and maintain 50+ practice, regional, departmental, and/or functional spend budgets using a platform such as Ramp, BILL/Divvy, or similar.

• Provide Operations and Finance leaders with timely visibility into controllable spend, budget utilization, policy exceptions, and out-of-budget activity.

Controls, Policies & Procedures

• Develop and maintain comprehensive AP, vendor payment, and T&E policies, SOPs, desk procedures, approval matrices, and control documentation.

• Design and enforce segregation of duties, delegated authority, duplicate-payment controls, vendor-master controls, banking-change verification, and fraud-prevention controls.

• Support internal and external audits and maintain a strong control environment appropriate for a growing, PE-backed organization.

Accounting Accuracy & Close

• Ensure appropriate GL coding across entities, practices, departments, and cost centers and partner with Accounting on month-end cutoff and accrual accuracy.

• Support month-end close including AP accruals, GRNI/unreceived goods, open invoices, recurring expenses, unapplied credits, stale checks, and vendor statement reconciliations.

• Maintain W-9 compliance and support accurate 1099 preparation and reporting.

Team Leadership

• Build, lead, train, and develop a high-performing AP organization with clear roles, accountability, cross-training, and career development.

• Establish KPIs for productivity, invoice cycle time, first-pass match rates, exception rates, payment timeliness, vendor onboarding, automation, accuracy, and service levels.

• Remain hands-on in Coupa and operational processes when necessary; this role is expected to solve problems directly, not function solely as a people manager.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Problem Solving

• Serve as the primary AP business partner to Accounting, Procurement, Treasury, Operations, Integration, and practice leadership.

• Proactively communicate issues, implementation risks, process changes, deadlines, and decisions to stakeholders.

• Investigate recurring operational problems, identify root causes, and present practical, actionable solutions rather than simply escalating issues.

• Partner with Procurement to increase PO adoption while maintaining clear accountability between commercial vendor management and AP payment administration.

• 8–10+ years of progressive Accounts Payable/P2P experience, including 4+ years leading teams in a complex, high-volume environment.

• Demonstrated experience supporting a multi-entity, multi-location organization required.

• Hands-on enterprise P2P/AP system experience required. Coupa/Coupa Pay strongly preferred; SAP Ariba, Oracle, or comparable enterprise-scale platforms acceptable.

• Experience must include workflow configuration/optimization, supplier enablement, payment methods, approval workflows, and process improvement—not solely end-user processing.

• Demonstrated experience designing and implementing AP automation and scalable operating models, with measurable improvement in efficiency or transaction capacity.

• Experience managing supplier payment onboarding, ACH/banking information, virtual cards, checks, vendor-master controls, and payment fraud prevention.

• Experience administering a corporate card/T&E program and spend/budget management platform such as Ramp, BILL/Divvy, or comparable system.

• Experience developing AP policies, SOPs, approval matrices, internal controls, and KPI reporting.

• Experience integrating acquisitions, new locations, or business units into a centralized AP/P2P environment strongly preferred.

• Strong analytical, root-cause problem-solving, written communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

• Healthcare, physician practice management, MSO, or other highly decentralized/multi-site industry experience preferred.

• NetSuite experience preferred; advanced Excel skills required.

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or related field preferred; equivalent relevant experience considered.
  • Accounts Payable certification (e.g., CAPA) is preferred.

Job Type:

  • Full-time, exempt

Driving Technology Adoption, Consumption, and Growth

Lumen is evolving what and how we sell—bringing deeper technology fluency, consultative discovery, and business-outcome conversations into every customer engagement. Our Acceleration and Growth team offers distinct opportunities to help customers adopt, use, and expand technology that advances their priorities. As an Account Director Senior Large Enterprise Strategics, you will own growth across large, important, and potentially global enterprise accounts by translating customer business priorities into measurable outcomes enabled by Lumen’s network, cloud, security, managed services, and orchestration portfolio.

As the Account Director Senior, you operate independently from acquisition through modernization, activation, adoption, consumption, and expansion. Your broad command of customer economics, markets, technology, and complex buying environments makes you a trusted expert to customers and colleagues.

We are looking for an Operations Research Engineer to join the Workforce Management (WFM) product stream and help build the optimization capabilities behind workforce planning, forecasting, scheduling, and resource allocation for a large-scale contact center environment.

Responsibilities

  • Research, design, and develop optimization models for contact center workforce planning, scheduling and resource allocation.
  • Design and implement the schedule optimization engine using OR-Tools/CP-SAT.
  • Own the constraint model end to end: formalize business rule into a solvable, maintainable model.
    Build the production-grade solver as a service within the WFM platform that meets latency targets for real forecast group volumes.
  • Define and validate schedule quality metrics (coverage attainment, constraint violations, solve time, solution stability across re-solves) and instrument the service so quality can be monitored in production.
  • Build and execute tests and validation of optimization algorithms to deliver performance, scalability, and accuracy.
  • Collaborate with architects and engineering teams to integrate optimization models into an enterprise-grade optimization engine of the workforce management platform.

  • 6+ years of professional experience designing and implementing optimization solutions in production environments.
  • Hands-on production experience with OR-Tools (CP-SAT), or a comparable constraint-programming / mixed-integer-programming solver.
  • Strong foundation in linear programming, integer programming, or stochastic optimization.
  • Direct experience modeling and solving workforce or resource scheduling problems.
  • Experience working with large datasets and solving large scale optimization problems.
    Proficiency in Java, Python, or C++.
  • Experience translating complex business requirements into mathematical models and optimization objectives.
  • Strong software engineering skills with the ability to build production-ready services and validation frameworks.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

Nice to Have

Your credibility as someone who has been in the building and understands what it means when a classroom or cafeteria is short-staffed is what will set you apart. This is a phone-first role. Remote: Able to work remotely in the following states: CA, TX, IL, MA, MI, NV, GA, or WY. Must be able to work standard central or eastern timezone business hours.

OTE of $70,000-90,000 depending on experience and location, plus full benefits, unlimited PTO, and stock options.

Position Summary

The L1 Help Desk Analyst provides first-level technical support for PAM Health end users across hardware, software, network, and cloud-based environments. This role serves as the initial point of contact for IT-related issues and service requests, delivering timely troubleshooting, issue resolution, and customer support while ensuring alignment with established service level agreements (SLAs). The L1 Help Desk Analyst contributes to operational efficiency through accurate ticket documentation, strong customer service, and adherence to IT support processes and standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the first point of contact for end-user technical support requests through phone, email, chat, and ticketing systems

  • Escalate unresolved or complex technical issues to Tier II or Infrastructure teams with appropriate documentation and troubleshooting details

  • Communicate professionally with end users regarding issue status, expected timelines, and resolution updates
  • Follow established IT policies, procedures, and security standards while supporting end-user technology needs

Qualifications

  • Associate degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field preferred; equivalent experience may be considered
  • 1–3 years of Help Desk, Technical Support, or customer support experience in an enterprise environment preferred
  • Basic knowledge of Windows operating systems, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and standard desktop support practices
  • Familiarity with networking fundamentals including VPN, DNS, DHCP, and wireless connectivity troubleshooting preferred
  • Experience utilizing ticketing systems or ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow, NinjaOne, or similar tools preferred
  • Strong customer service, communication, and interpersonal skills

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced support environment
  • Exposure to remote support tools, endpoint management platforms, or cloud-based environments preferred

jobs.description:
Category: Legal / Security / Law

Location:


Child Protection Lawyer – 3 Month Contract

Location: Flexible / Remote Working
Rate: £55.00 per hour (Umbrella)
Contract: 3 Month Contract
Hours: Full Time
Working Pattern: Flexible Remote Working
Pay: Bi-Weekly

Summary

A Local Authority is in search of a seasoned Child Protection Lawyer to join its Legal Services team on a temporary basis. This position involves managing a diverse and intricate childcare caseload, offering expert legal guidance, advocacy, and representation to Children's Services, senior officials, members, and committees. The successful candidate will operate within a Lexcel-accredited legal practice, playing a crucial role in ensuring the Local Authority fulfills its statutory responsibilities effectively and lawfully. This role is ideal for an experienced childcare lawyer who can work autonomously, engage in advocacy, and provide practical, solution-oriented legal advice in a dynamic environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee a comprehensive and complex caseload of child protection and childcare issues.
  • Deliver prompt, precise, and legally sound advice to Children's Services and senior stakeholders.
  • Perform advocacy as needed in Family Courts and related proceedings.
  • Provide counsel on:
    • Care Proceedings
    • Public Law Outline (PLO)
    • Child Protection
    • Adoption Matters
    • Placement Orders
    • Special Guardianship Orders
    • Emergency Applications
    • Pre-Proceedings
  • Draft pleadings, court applications, witness statements, legal agreements, and related documents.
  • Facilitate lawful decision-making by officers, members, and committees.
  • Participate in hearings, meetings, and proceedings as necessary.
  • Maintain accurate records using electronic case management systems.
  • Adhere to Lexcel Practice Management Standards.
  • Assist in training and developing officers and colleagues.
  • Support senior lawyers and contribute to service development initiatives.

Essential


Requirements

Requirements:
  • Qualified Solicitor, Barrister, or Fellow of CILEX eligible to practice in England and Wales.
  • Current practicing certificate from the relevant professional body.
  • Extensive experience in Child Protection and Childcare Law matters.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Children Act 1989
    • Adoption and Children Act 2002
    • Family Procedure Rules
    • Public Law Childcare Proceedings
  • Experience in advocacy or a strong willingness to undertake advocacy.
  • Proven ability to manage a demanding and complex legal caseload.
  • Exceptional drafting, negotiation, and legal research skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Experience providing legal advice to Children's Services teams.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Desirable

  • Previous experience in Local Authority legal work.
  • Experience in supervising or mentoring junior legal staff.
  • Experience supporting management responsibilities within a legal team.
  • Knowledge of Adult Social Care or Education Law.
  • Experience working within a Lexcel-accredited practice.
  • Proficiency in using electronic legal case management systems.

What's on Offer?

  • £55.00 per hour (Umbrella)
  • 3 Month Contract
  • Full-Time Hours
  • Flexible Remote Working
  • Bi-Weekly Pay
  • Opportunity to join a Lexcel-accredited Legal Services team.
  • Diverse and challenging childcare caseload.
  • Opportunity to engage in advocacy and high-profile safeguarding work.
  • Supportive and collaborative legal environment.
  • Exposure to complex child protection and public law proceedings.
This role is suitable for candidates with experience as a Child Protection Lawyer, Childcare Lawyer, Children's Solicitor, Public Law Solicitor, Family Solicitor, Care Proceedings Lawyer, Safeguarding Lawyer, Local Government Lawyer, or Senior Childcare Solicitor.

jobs.description:
Sierra Space Careers:

At Sierra Space, we build the missions and systems that keep our world secure in the domain above Earth.

Sierra Space team members share a spirit of innovation and collaboration and a belief that we can deliver on the boldest missions in space today. Together with our customers, we aim to safeguard our nation, sustain human presence in space, and secure the freedom of operations in low Earth orbit and beyond.

Our success is measured by the trust of those who rely on what we build and deliver, and our technologies keep the United States and its allies mission-ready throughout space.

We are mission-driven, and together, we are an extraordinary team.

About the Role

The Electrical Engineer III role involves leading the design, development, modification, and evaluation of complex electrical components and systems. This position is suited for professionals with a strong background in electrical engineering and significant hands-on experience. Responsibilities include working on advanced projects, collaborating with a diverse team of engineers and technicians, and contributing to the development of innovative solutions. The role also involves mentoring junior engineers and technicians, acting as the Responsible Engineer (RE) for discrete technical packages, and staying updated with the latest advancements in electrical engineering.

In this role, you will lead the design and development of complex electrical components and systems, while modifying and evaluating existing electrical systems and components to improve performance and efficiency. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure electrical designs meet project requirements and standards, and conduct tests and simulations to validate the performance of electrical systems and components. Documenting design processes, test results, and modifications for future reference will be a key responsibility, as will providing technical support and troubleshooting assistance for electrical systems and components. Staying updated with the latest advancements in electrical engineering, you will apply new knowledge to ongoing projects to drive innovation and effectiveness. You will participate in team meetings and contribute to project planning and progress discussions, while mentoring and providing guidance to junior engineers and technicians. Additionally, you will have the ability to learn and receive instruction and mentorship from more experienced engineers. As the Responsible Engineer (RE) for discrete technical packages, you will ensure successful project execution and maintain technical excellence throughout the process.

About You

Our mission is driven by an unyielding commitment to advancing space-based technology in service of our customers and safeguarding national security. We seek individuals who are passionate about innovating beyond boundaries and relentlessly pursuing solutions that protect, preserve and empower – to join us in this critical mission.

We’re looking for team members who align with our values, mission and goals – while also meeting the minimum qualifications below. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Harness Design (2D) for harnessing on satellite programs to meet requirements
  • Propose innovative solutions to design challenges.
  • Attend and actively participate in cross-functional meetings.
  • Communicate and collaborate with the team to ensure the integrity of harness designs meets specifications and requirements.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Requires Bachelor's degree in a related field (or equivalent work experience in lieu of degree or Masters +3 yrs experience).
  • Typically 5+ years of related experience.
  • Certifications: Encouraged to begin seeking industry affiliations.
  • Advanced knowledge of electrical fundamentals, applicable tools, methodologies, and principles.
  • Familiarity with Electrical and Avionic systems and their functionality.
  • Ability to troubleshoot and solve more complex problems.
  • Ability to learn, receive instruction, and mentorship from more experienced engineers.
  • Owner of discrete technical packages as a Responsible Engineer (RE).
  • Ability to work with minimal supervision on projects involving both small and large engineering teams.
  • Intermediate knowledge of requirements management, functional requirements parsing, derivation, and allocation.
  • Intermediate knowledge of systems integration, technical risk identification and management strategies, and Verification and Validation (V&V) principles.
  • Experience performing trade studies to support subsystem architecture decisions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous work experience on Satellites, Spaceplanes
  • Experience selecting parts for harnessing to meet requirements
  • Experienced with NX2312 (Xcelerator) Routing tools, or TeamCenter & Mentor Graphics (Capital)
  • Experience taking preliminary designs to Flight Release status
  • Experience with configuration management
  • Exposure to simulations through functional and logical models and system analysis
  • Background in the Aerospace and Defense Industry
  • Experience composing and analyzing Electrical Load Analysis (ELA), circuit modeling, simula on, and analysis
  • Familiarity with design requirements related to High Intensity Radiated Field (HIRF) and Indirect Effects of Lightning (IEL)
  • Familiar with Electro Magnetic Effects (EME) to include, Electro Magnetic Compatibility (EMC) and Electro Magnetic Interference (EMI)

Elevate Your Career

At Sierra Space, we are committed to your personal and professional development. We empower you to make profound and meaningful contributions and foster a vibrant culture of collaboration, where teamwork ignites breakthrough innovations.

Sierra Space is an industry-leading space and defense technology company providing satellites, spacecraft, and enabling mission systems and components. We deliver mission-proven technologies to our customers that safeguard our nation, protect space-based assets and enable space exploration.

If you need special assistance or a reasonable accommodation related to applying for employment with Sierra Space or at any stage of the recruitment process, please contact us.

You’ll work directly with customers to understand how they manage their projects, configure and implement Autodesk solutions, deliver training and consulting, and help project teams successfully adopt the technology.

You’ll collaborate with customers, sales teams, technical specialists, and other internal stakeholders throughout the customer journey, from technical discovery and demonstrations through implementation, training, and ongoing adoption.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead customer demonstrations, technical discovery, implementations, training, and ongoing support.
  • Configure project and account settings, templates, permissions, and administrative standards.
  • Help customers set up and deploy new projects within the Autodesk platform.
  • Design and optimize workflows involving: Project documents and file management Sheets and drawings RFIs and submittals Issues and forms Meetings and daily logs Field reporting Assets and project closeout Reporting and dashboards
  • Facilitate discovery sessions to understand customer processes, business requirements, and adoption challenges.
  • Evaluate existing construction workflows and recommend improvements and best practices.
  • Develop implementation strategies, standardized project templates, and repeatable processes.
  • Provide administrator and end-user training to project teams.
  • Help customers successfully adopt new technology and workflows.
  • Partner with sales and customer success teams on technical discovery, demonstrations, and solution recommendations.

Genovice is seeking a versatileQMS Implementation Specialist / Project Managerto support project-based Quality Management System (QMS) implementations for life sciences clients.

This role is ideal for someone with a broad skill set acrossQMS implementation, project management, system configuration, data migration, and/or computer system validation (CSV). We are not looking for someone who specializes exclusively in one area. The ideal candidate will be comfortable wearing multiple hats throughout an implementation and supporting different phases of a project based on client needs.

  • Support end-to-end implementation of electronic Quality Management Systems (eQMS) for life sciences organizations.

  • Participate in system configuration and implementation activities based on business and quality requirements.

  • Support data migration activities, including data mapping, migration planning, verification, and reconciliation.

  • Develop and/or execute validation documentation such as User Requirements Specifications (URS), risk assessments, test scripts, traceability matrices, and validation summary documentation.

  • Facilitate requirements gathering and translate business processes into system requirements and workflows.

  • Work collaboratively with Quality, IT, Validation, business stakeholders, vendors, and client project teams.

  • Hands-on experience withQMS/eQMS implementation projects.

  • Experience in at leasttwo or moreof the following areas:

    • Project Management

    • QMS System Configuration

    • Data Migration

    • Computer System Validation (CSV)

  • Experience with one or more QMS platforms such as:

    • Veeva Quality

    • MasterControl

    • ZenQMS

    • SOLABS

    • Similar electronic Quality Management Systems

  • Understanding of common quality processes such as deviations, CAPA, change control, document management, training, audits, and/or supplier quality.

  • Working knowledge of GxP requirements, data integrity principles, and 21 CFR Part 11.

  • Strong communication, organization, and client-facing skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to different responsibilities throughout an implementation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting multiple QMS implementations or client-facing implementation projects.

  • Experience withSuccessFactorsor similar learning/training management platforms.

  • Experience working within a consulting or professional services environment.

  • Familiarity with system integrations and implementation lifecycle activities.

  • Experience supporting both technical and business stakeholders.

Location & Travel

Candidates located inEastern Pennsylvania or Central New Jerseyare strongly preferred. The role will primarily support projects remotely but requires the ability to travel approximatelyonce per monthto offices in the Bethlehem and/or Philadelphia, Pennsylvania area.

Engagement

This position will begin as an approximately6-month contract engagement with a strong right-to-hire opportunity. The goal is to identify an individual who can grow into a long-term member of the team supporting ongoing QMS implementation projects.

jobs.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About Ops Enablement

The Operations Enablement team builds the capabilities required to deliver fast, accurate, and high-quality servicing experiences for Affirm’s customers and merchants—while identifying opportunities to eliminate the need for them to contact us in the first place. We partner across Operations, Product, Engineering, Vendor Management, Legal, and Compliance to ensure every agent is trained, equipped, and able to deliver measurable results from day one.

Operating across the full servicing lifecycle, we translate new products, policies, and business requirements into scalable operational capabilities. Our work includes designing training and operational readiness strategies, standing up new servicing experiences, defining and measuring interaction quality, and ensuring agents can quickly access the information they need to resolve issues correctly.

We use performance insights, customer contact drivers, quality trends, and agent feedback to identify capability gaps and their root causes. We then build the learning programs, quality frameworks, knowledge systems, processes, and tools needed to close those gaps—while helping our Product and Engineering partners address friction upstream rather than requiring agents to absorb it downstream. By owning the full journey—from operationalizing new products and policies to improving existing workflows—Operations Enablement turns complex change into consistent, compliant, and high-quality servicing at scale.

One Role, Multiple Teams

We are hiring multiple Manager roles across Affirm's Ops Enablement organization through this single job posting. Rather than interviewing for one specific team, candidates will go through a shared interview process designed to assess the core skills we look for across Ops Enablement.

If selected, we will work with you to determine the best team match based on your interests, experience, strengths, and current business needs. You will have the opportunity to learn more about our teams and share your preferences as you move through the process.

Potential team placements include:

  • Customer Enablement: Owning and improving specific customer servicing experiences across multiple product offerings
  • Horizontal Enablement: Owning programs that touch multiple customer servicing experiences for specific product offerings

About the Role

As an Operations Enablement leader you will help to deliver scalable, compliant, and high-quality servicing experiences across our Operations organization. In this role, you will define and execute strategies that enable our servicing operations to grow efficiently while maintaining exceptional customer and merchant outcomes.

You will set the vision for operational readiness, ensuring that people, processes, and enablement systems evolve in lockstep with Affirm’s servicing strategy. As a senior member of the Operations Enablement team, you will own a portfolio of cross-functional initiatives aligned to strategic priorities—driving delivery across timelines, dependencies, and measurable business outcomes. You will define and execute servicing strategies by developing clear program roadmaps and execution plans and be responsible for planning, coordination, documentation, change management and measurement across assigned initiatives to ensure operational readiness and measurable outcomes

This role works closely with partners across Product, Engineering, Operations, Compliance, and external vendors to align priorities and ensure readiness for key business and regulatory changes. Serving as a connector between servicing strategy and day-to-day execution, you will translate strategy into scalable operational capabilities. We are looking for a hands-on, data-driven leader who thrives in complex, regulated environments and is passionate about building durable, high-quality servicing experiences at scale.

What You’ll Do

  • Own Program Performance: Lead complex cross-functional programs and initiatives, ensuring alignment with servicing strategy, OKRs, and long-term business priorities.
  • Define Program Roadmaps: Develop clear program roadmaps and execution plans, tracking progress against KPIs, timelines, budgets, dependencies, and risks.
  • Partner for Impact: Collaborate closely with senior leaders and cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, and Operations to align priorities and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Drive Stakeholder Engagement: Establish strong stakeholder engagement and governance practices, delivering clear, polished, and executive-ready communications on program status, outcomes, risks, and impact.
  • Manage Risk & Issue Resolution: Proactively identify risks, issues, and dependencies; propose data-backed solutions; and drive resolution in partnership with stakeholders.
  • Lead Operational Excellence: Apply Lean Six Sigma methodologies to identify root causes, implement scalable improvements, and continuously raise the bar for quality, efficiency, and compliance.
  • Own Change End-to-End: Manage the full lifecycle of process and product changes—from design and implementation through change management, adoption, and measurement—ensuring meaningful impact for customers and the business.
  • Build Technical Resources: Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate technical concepts into clear manuals and resources for both human and AI agents.
  • Elevate Knowledge Management: Architect and evolve our knowledge ecosystem (SOPs, job aids, learning platforms, AI-enabled knowledge tools), ensuring resources are accurate, engaging, and accessible at scale.
  • Translate Technical Concepts: Apply technical depth to plan, design, and create complex operational, instructional, and procedural content, translating technical concepts into clear resources for both human and AI agents.
  • Own Learning & Training Strategy: Oversee end-to-end design and delivery of training programs (onboarding, continuous learning, new product rollouts), ensuring effectiveness through measurement and feedback loops.
  • Collaborate on Experience Improvements: Partner with Product and Engineering teams to deepen understanding of the current customer and agent experience and identify opportunities for workflow and experience optimization.
  • Expand Program Scope: Take on additional program and project management responsibilities as needed, developing working knowledge across adjacent domains to support evolving business needs.

What We Look For

  • 7+ years of experience in program management or product operations, preferably within large-scale or global operations.
  • 3+ years of experience at a fintech or financial institution, including 3+ years in a role that involves scaling operations and providing ongoing coaching and feedback to team members.
  • Subject matter expert on financial regulations such as UCC, Reg E, Reg Z, Card Act, GLBA, UDAAP, GDPR, among others. Have a deep understanding of dispute management rules, response codes, and recommended response data.
  • Certification in Six Sigma, Project Management or Design Thinking
  • Experience implementing and scaling knowledge management and training (Salesforce, Confluence, LMS platforms, or AI-driven knowledge tools).
  • Demonstrated success leading large-scale, cross-functional initiatives with strong execution, stakeholder alignment, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong skills in strategic planning, issue/risk management and cross-functional execution.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication with the ability to deliver polished, executive-ready updates and influence stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in process mapping and workflow analysis
  • Proven experience designing business processes that drive a positive end user experience, reduce business risk and increase overall workflow efficiency.
  • Experience building workflows within a regulatory environment.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support team collaboration, operational priorities, and vendor or partner engagements.
