Walmart Connect (the advertising network arm for Walmart) is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for our suppliers, sellers, and the agencies and technology partners who serve them. Our Partner Network is the engine behind that ecosystem — the benefits, incentives, enablement, trust, recognition, and go-to-market programs that help our partners grow with Walmart.

As we scale globally, we are looking for a Senior Manager, International and Sam’s US to lead the extension of the full Partner Network program suite into net-new markets — beginning with Canada (CA), Mexico (MX), Chile, and Sam’s US. This is a builder role: you will take programs that are proven in WMC U.S. and adapt, localize, and stand them up to International and Sam’s US, in close partnership with regional Walmart and Walmart Connect teams, program owners, Legal, Compliance, and Finance. You will be the connective tissue between a centralized program vision and the realities of each local market.

This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable operating strategically — shaping which programs launch where and in what sequence — and operationally, rolling up their sleeves to localize playbooks, onboard partners, and make the first launches successful.

What you'll do...

Own international and Sam’s US program extension — lead the end-to-end rollout of the Partner Network program portfolio (partner benefits & incentives, tiering & recognition, partner trust & compliance, specialized partner programs, demand generation, evangelism, and the partner awards program) into Canada, Mexico, Chile, and Sam’s US.
Build the market-entry roadmap — partner with regional/business leadership to prioritize which programs launch in which markets/businesses and in what sequence, balancing local partner needs, revenue opportunity, and operational readiness.
Localize, don't just translate — adapt program mechanics, eligibility criteria, incentives, and partner-facing materials to each market's regulatory, cultural, currency, and competitive context, working with in-market/business teams to ensure relevance.
Coordinate cross-functionally — serve as the single point of accountability across program owners, regional Walmart/Walmart Connect teams, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Product, and Marketing to unblock launches and keep initiatives on track.
Define and track success — set launch KPIs and health metrics for each market, build the reporting cadence, and report progress and risks to leadership on a regular basis.
Create a repeatable playbook — codify the international/Sam’s US expansion approach into a scalable, reusable model so each successive market launches faster and more consistently than the last.
Be the voice of the market — bring local partner and team feedback back to central program owners to influence the global program roadmap.

Strong program-management skills: able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, timelines, and dependencies with minimal oversight.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders and partner-facing audiences.

Direct experience with the Latin American (Mexico, Chile) and/or Canada markets, including familiarity with local partner ecosystems and regulatory environments.

MBA or equivalent advanced degree.

Staff Software Engineer - Code Puppy AI & Data | Walmart Global Tech Join Walmart as a Staff Software Engineer within our AI & Data organization and help make it trivially easy for associates, engineers, data scientists, and citizen developers to turn ideas into AI-powered solutions quickly, safely, and cost-effectively.
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Staff Software Engineer - Code Puppy
AI & Data | Walmart Global Tech Join Walmart as a Staff Software Engineer within our AI & Data organization and help make it trivially easy for associates, engineers, data scientists, and citizen developers to turn ideas into AI-powered solutions quickly, safely, and cost-effectively. At Walmart, we operate at Fortune #1 scale. Our challenges are complex, global, and deeply meaningful. Here, you'll do the best work of your career, work that helps people save money and live better.
About AI & Data The AI & Data organization within Walmart Global Tech is building a platform-first ecosystem that centralizes enterprise data, provides foundational AI capabilities, and delivers intuitive AI solutions for all personas. We enable AI at enterprise scale responsibly, securely, and reliably.
About the Team Our team builds intelligent agents that make associates' jobs easier, faster, and more fulfilling, from automating repetitive tasks to providing decision support for complex operations. We work directly with business stakeholders to rapidly iterate on agentic solutions that deliver measurable operational impact. We leverage the Element LLM Gateway to safely access state-of-the-art language models while ensuring all data remains within Walmart's network.
Position Summary As a Staff Software Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and scaling agentic AI solutions that drive business transformation across Walmart. You will partner with business and technology teams to translate complex operational challenges into innovative AI-powered products and services. This role requires deep technical expertise, strategic thinking, and the ability to influence architecture and engineering best practices across teams. You will be a great fit if:
  • You thrive at the intersection of business problem-solving and hands-on software engineering.
  • You are passionate about leveraging AI, machine learning, and large language models to create impactful solutions.
  • You enjoy working directly with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver measurable business value.
  • You excel in highly collaborative, fast-paced environments and can effectively influence without authority.
  • You are excited about building scalable, enterprise-grade software systems and mentoring fellow engineers.

What You'll Do
  • Design, develop, and deploy scalable agentic AI applications and multi-agent systems that address critical business challenges.
  • Lead architecture and technical design discussions for highly available, secure, and performant platforms.
  • Translate business requirements, operational workflows, and user needs into production-ready technical solutions.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers, data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to deliver impactful outcomes.
  • Drive the end-to-end development lifecycle, from solution design and implementation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
  • Build integrations with AI platforms, APIs, enterprise systems, and large-scale data ecosystems.
  • Champion engineering excellence through code reviews, testing strategies, observability, and operational best practices.
  • Establish standards and best practices for agentic AI development, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, and LLM integration.
  • Mentor and coach engineers across teams, fostering technical growth and innovation.
  • Contribute to technology roadmaps and help shape the future direction of AI-powered products at Walmart.

What You'll Bring
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong software engineering experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems and enterprise applications.
  • Expertise in one or more programming languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
  • Experience designing and implementing scalable cloud-native applications and microservices architectures.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML technologies, large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and agentic frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of software design principles, system architecture, API development, and cloud platforms.
  • Experience working with data platforms, analytics systems, and modern engineering toolchains.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven ability to influence technical strategy and drive cross-functional initiatives.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and leading technical projects from concept to production.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience building AI-powered products in enterprise environments.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, knowledge graphs, LLM orchestration, and AI evaluation frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, GCP, or AWS.
  • Familiarity with retail, supply chain, omnichannel commerce, logistics, or operational systems.
  • Advanced degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field.


At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Fulfillment Experience builds the capabilities and operating mechanisms that make Walmart a reliable, convenient on-demand partner. Our teams determine what customers can buy, the promise and fulfillment choices they see, how orders are managed and recovered, and how the network performs at scale. We partner across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Merchandising, Store Operations, Fulfillment Centers, Last Mile, Transportation, and Strategy to improve customer outcomes while balancing speed, assortment, cost, and operational feasibility.


Role summary

The (USA) Manager, Technology Operations identifies and solves complex, high-impact fulfillment problems across a defined product, operational, or customer-experience area. This role turns ambiguous customer, operational, and financial signals into a clear diagnosis, an aligned plan, and measurable results. Working across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, and operations partners, the Manager leads initiatives from discovery and analysis through decision, delivery, readiness, and impact measurement. Success requires structured problem solving, clear communication, sound business judgment, and the ability to influence without direct authority.


What you'll do

  • Own a complex problem space or initiative that improves customer experience, fulfillment performance, or financial outcomes.
  • Use customer, operational, and financial data to identify opportunities, quantify impact, isolate root causes, and define success measures.
  • Translate ambiguous problems into clear problem statements, hypotheses, options, and data-driven recommendations.
  • Lead cross-functional solution design and execution with Product, Engineering, Data Science, Finance, Store Operations, Fulfillment Centers, Last Mile, Transportation, and other partners.
  • Build and manage end-to-end plans that make ownership, milestones, dependencies, risks, decision points, pilots, launch readiness, and success measures clear.
  • Drive alignment and resolve trade-offs without direct authority; escalate issues with a clear recommendation when timely leadership decisions are needed.
  • Create concise, executive-ready updates and decision materials that clarify what changed, why it matters, and the action required.
  • Measure results after launch, identify gaps or unintended outcomes, and drive refinements, scaling, or corrective action.
  • Improve the team's planning, visibility, and execution through better processes, tools, automation, and operating routines.

What you'll bring

  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in eCommerce, supply chain, operations, product, strategy, analytics, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.
  • Strong structured problem-solving skills, including the ability to turn ambiguous issues into clear questions, synthesize disparate inputs, identify root causes, and recommend a practical path forward.
  • Strong analytical fluency and comfort using data to form hypotheses, assess trade-offs, define metrics, and measure impact.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex work understandable and action-oriented for audiences at every level.
  • Proven ability to influence without authority, build trust across functions, navigate competing priorities, and drive commitments to closure.
  • Disciplined program-management skills, including planning, milestone management, dependency and risk management, and launch or change readiness.
  • Sound customer, operational, and financial judgment; able to balance the ideal solution with what is practical to execute at scale.
  • A high-ownership mindset, curiosity, attention to detail, and a bias for action.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience partnering directly with Product, Engineering, and Data Science teams to deliver technology-enabled business outcomes.
  • Experience in omnichannel retail, eCommerce, fulfillment, supply chain, marketplaces, or a similarly complex operating environment.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, BI and visualization tools, Jira, Airtable, or process-automation tools.

jobs.excerpt: Position Summary... What you'll do... Walmart International is looking for a Group Director, Product Management to lead the development of new products, capabilities, and business models across our global business.
jobs.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Walmart International is looking for a Group Director, Product Management to lead the development of new products, capabilities, and business models across our global business.


This is a highly strategic, entrepreneurial role for a product leader who thrives in ambiguity and knows how to take an opportunity from 0→1 and ultimately to scale. We’re looking for someone with a consulting-style approach to problem solving and a builder’s mindset—someone who can quickly understand a complex challenge, create structure, develop a strategy, and mobilize teams around execution.


You’ll take an end-to-end view of the business, connecting customer needs with technology, operations, economics, partnerships, and the physical movement of goods. You’ll work across Walmart’s international markets and partner closely with senior leaders across Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Strategy, Finance, and external organizations.


What You’ll Do...

  • Define and lead multi-year product strategies across complex, global product areas.
  • Identify new opportunities and lead 0→1 product development from business case and experimentation through launch and scale.
  • Solve ambiguous business problems using a structured, hypothesis-driven approach.
  • Evaluate where Walmart should build, buy, partner, or integrate to accelerate innovation.
  • Develop and leverage strategic partnerships and third-party ecosystems.
  • Connect digital product strategy with the operational realities of commerce, supply chain, logistics, fulfillment, and the movement of goods.
  • Influence executive investment and prioritization decisions through clear, data-driven narratives.
  • Lead and develop senior Product Management leaders and build high-performing teams.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and emerging technologies to create new customer and business value.

What You’ll Bring...

  • Significant Product Management leadership experience across complex products, platforms, or portfolios.
  • A strong track record of building and scaling 0→1 products or capabilities.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset paired with structured, strategic problem-solving skills.

Job Title: Executive Director, Digital Product Management -Research

Job Location: South San Francisco, California, United States|Thousand Oaks, California, United States

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do. Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions, and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives. Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, the Executive Director, Digital Product Management - Research will be the senior digital technology leader for Research. The Executive Director will translate Research strategy and portfolio priorities into a coherent technology, data and AI agenda that accelerates science, improves the quality and reuse of scientific data, and creates durable advantage in how Amgen discovers medicines. As a member of the Research Leadership Team, the Executive Director will help transform how science is done, and shape investment priorities to ensure that digital technologies are actively moving the portfolio forward from disease understanding and target selection through molecule design and synthesis, and translational safety. Success would include evidence of better scientific decisions and faster experimental learning.The Executive Director will own the technology environment for Research, including benchtop environment, electronic lab notebooks, scientific workflows, and the data products and platforms that connect Research disciplines. The successful candidate will lead a talented organization and serve as a trusted thought partner to scientific leaders, ensuring that Research teams have dependable, well-designed capabilities that enable better and faster science.


Responsibilities include:

  • Research strategy, portfolio impact, and executive leadership
  • Set and continuously evolve the multi-year Research Technology, Data & AI strategy in partnership with Research, linking capability investments to the Research portfolio, scientific priorities, and measurable outcomes.
  • Serve on the Research Leadership Team as a strategic advisor and decision-maker; bring technology and data insight to portfolio choices, operating plans, capital decisions, and risk discussions.
  • Own portfolio prioritization and investment recommendations across the function, balancing scientific value, urgency, adoption, technical dependencies, risk, cost, and organizational capacity.
  • Establish clear outcomes, OKRs and value measures; use evidence to redirect investment, retire low-value solutions and scale what demonstrably advances the science.
  • Scientific technology, laboratory workflows, and data products
  • Own the technology foundation that enables Research scientists to do their best work: benchtop and instrument-adjacent technology, electronic lab notebooks, LIMS, and integrated scientific workflows.
  • Deliver reliable, scalable products that scientists want to use, improve workflows, and demonstrate measurable value.
  • Lead the modernization and integration of scientific data workflows from capture at source through analysis, reuse, and decision-making, with a strong emphasis on data quality, metadata, terminology, and fit-for-purpose governance.
  • Build a coherent portfolio of governed, reusable data products that connect experiments, observations, models, and knowledge across Research, making data discoverable, trustworthy, and ready for analytical reuse.
  • Advance digital capabilities across the Research portfolio, including disease understanding, target selection, small molecule discovery, large molecule discovery, DNA-encoded libraries, and antibody-drug conjugates, while enabling productive collaboration across scientific domains.
  • Ensure platforms and workflows are designed around scientist needs and continuously improve the end-to-end user experience.
  • Technology, data, and operating leadership
  • Lead and develop a high-performing organization spanning research informatics, laboratory and benchtop technology, digital products, and scientific data enablement.
  • Build strong partnerships with Research scientific leaders, the Technology and AI & Data organizations, and external collaborators; resolve cross-functional dependencies and material trade-offs.
  • Demonstrate robust technology investment discipline across platform rationalization, build-versus-buy decisions, and managing technical debt.
  • Set a high bar for product and delivery excellence: clear problem framing, scientist co-design, strong architecture, rigorous vendor management, reliable operations, adoption, lifecycle management, and realized value
  • Create a culture that combines scientific curiosity with accountability; one that moves quickly, learns from evidence, anticipates risk, and delivers dependable services to laboratories and research teams
  • Communicate strategy, investment decisions, performance, risks, and opportunities clearly to executive audiences, translating complex scientific and technical choices into decisive action

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The candidatewe seek is an experienced leader with the following qualifications. They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:


  • Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive
  • Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection
  • Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders
  • Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree & 6 years of technology experience OR
  • Master’s degree & 10 years of technology experience OR
  • Bachelor’s degree & 12 years of technology experience AND
  • 6 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of progressive leadership experience, including direct leadership of senior leaders and/or responsibility for a substantial, multi-disciplinary organization
  • Experience leading technology, data, digital, informatics or computational capabilities in a research-intensive, life sciences environment
  • Scientific credibility that they can earn the trust of scientists and enable existing assumptions to be challenged
  • Understanding of drug discovery research lifecycle and builds credibility with scientists across relevant disciplines, such as small molecules, biologics, DELs, ADCs, disease biology, or translational science
  • Experience setting multi-year strategy in partnership with business functions and leading enterprise-scale changes across laboratory technology, scientific software, data platforms, scientific workflows, or research informatics
  • Experience in creating and scaling scientific data products, FAIR data practices, metadata and terminology capabilities, and integrated data-to-insight workflows
  • Technology and data judgment, with the ability to make informed decisions across cloud platforms, architecture, laboratory systems, data engineering, analytics, and vendor ecosystems
  • Ability to influence senior executives, lead through ambiguity, resolve consequential cross-functional trade-offs and create alignment without relying solely on formal authority
  • Executive communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex scientific, technical and investment choices into clear recommendations and action
  • Experience in biotechnology, pharmaceutical research or another highly regulated, technology-intensive environment strongly preferred

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way. The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is $249,042 to $336,940. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications. In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:


  • Comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts.
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans and bi-annual company-wide shutdowns
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. The Microsoft Licensing & Cloud Billing Specialist is responsible for managing, optimizing, and governing Microsoft licensing and cloud billing across the organization. This role ensures licensing compliance, billing accuracy, cost optimization, and alignment between Microsoft agreements, cloud consumption, and business needs. The position serves as a critical liaison between IT, Finance, Procurement, and external Microsoft partners.

Microsoft Licensing Management

  • Ensure license compliance and readiness for audits or true-ups

Cloud Billing & Financial Operations

  • Oversee Microsoft cloud billing accuracy, reconciliation, and reporting
  • Manage monthly CSP/NCE billing cycles, proration, credits, and adjustments
  • Reconcile Microsoft invoices against reseller invoices and internal usage reports
  • Track renewals, commitments, and term expirations to avoid financial risk

Cost Optimization & Governance

  • Monitor license utilization and recommend right-sizing actions

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with IT teams on Azure, Microsoft 365, AVD/VDI, and security licensing

  • Coordinate with Procurement and external Microsoft partners or resellers
  • Support leadership with clear, executive-level reporting and insights

Reporting & Documentation

  • Maintain accurate license inventories and entitlement documentation
  • Produce regular reports on license usage, spend, and compliance status
  • Document processes, standards, and controls related to licensing and billing

Required Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of Microsoft licensing and cloud billing models
  • Experience with Microsoft 365, Azure, and CSP/NCE billing structures
  • Ability to interpret complex contracts, agreements, and licensing terms
  • High attention to detail with strong analytical and reconciliation skills
  • Experience working cross-functionally with IT and Finance teams

Preferred Qualifications

Working at Abbott

The Opportunity

In Abbott’s Electrophysiology (EP) business, we’re advancing the treatment of heart disease through breakthrough medical technologies in atrial fibrillation, allowing people to restore their health and get on with their lives.

We are seeking an experienced, high caliber Senior Field Clinical Specialist - Electrophysiology for our Southeast region. This position will be primarily responsible for demonstrated and consistent technical and clinical support to the Clinical Affairs Organization, with specific focus on Electrophysiology (EP) Business Unit (BU) technologies and therapy areas.

This individual will provide field support of clinical research study procedures with Abbott EP BU technologies, as well as accurate technical support/troubleshooting, project and/or territory management, general field image representation for Abbott, and field input to EP BU product management groups. You will function as an expert resource for covering clinical studies/procedures, handling challenging technical/protocol troubleshooting scenarios, critical software or product testing, product or project advisory boards, and high-profile presentations while collaborating with the sites and other cross functional partners on EP BU clinical studies.

  • Seek opportunities to continue demonstrating and developing technical, research, and organizational leadership qualities.

At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is seeking Sales Managers to join our passionate, high energy, and fast moving sales team. You’ll lead and support our Account Executives II focusing on mid-sized Private Sector organizations. You will have a consistent track record of ability to hire, develop, and lead an inclusive, engaged, and high performing team.

This is a remote position open to candidates living in the US Central Time Zone. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this position.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You have innate curiosity in how businesses work: One day you’ll meet with someone in waste management and the next you may be learning about the inner workings of a food distribution center. Our top sales team members seek to learn the ins and outs of the businesses they support in order to make a larger impact.
  • You build genuine relationships with your customers: The industries we serve have relied on pen-and-paper solutions for years and haven’t been met with the type of technology we offer. Our customers value earned trust and human relationships built over time.
  • You want to be with the best: Samsara’s high-performance culture means you’ll be surrounded by the best and challenged to go farther than you have before.
  • You are a team player: At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.

Click here to learn about what we value at Samsara.

In this role, you will:

  • Coach a team of ~8 account executives on sales strategy, pipeline reviews and achieve quarterly targets

  • Work cross-functionally to strategically solve problems and project manage

Annual OTE Salary
$176,460—$259,500 USD

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Belonging at Samsara

Accommodations

jobs.description:
About The Samaritans Cape Cod and the Islands

The Samaritans on Cape Cod and the Islands is a nonprofit organization dedicated to suicide prevention, crisis intervention, and support for those affected by suicide loss. Through our 24/7 Crisis Helpline, community-based prevention programs, and grief support services, we provide compassionate, nonjudgmental support to individuals and families across Cape Cod and the Islands.

The Samaritans on Cape Cod and the Islands (SCCI) seeks a strategic, relationship-centered development leader to strengthen philanthropic support for our suicide prevention and bereavement support mission.

This is SCCI’s first Director of Development position and an opportunity to build a disciplined, sustainable fundraising program in partnership with the Executive Director, Board, staff, donors, and community.

Position Overview

Reporting to the Executive Director, the Director of Development will lead SCCI’s fundraising strategy and increase private philanthropic support through individual giving, major gifts, grants, corporate partnerships, donor stewardship, and Board engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement a comprehensive annual development plan with clear goals, timelines, revenue targets, and performance measures.
  • Build and manage a qualified portfolio of individual, foundation, corporate, planned-giving, current, lapsed, and prospective donors.
  • Cultivate, solicit, and steward individual donors and major gift prospects; strengthen retention, recurring giving, annual giving, and unrestricted support.
  • Research funding opportunities and oversee grant proposals, sponsorship materials, reports, and supporting documentation in coordination with program and finance staff.
  • Develop corporate sponsorships, community partnerships, and fundraising opportunities; assess events for mission alignment, revenue potential, and donor engagement.
  • Equip Board members and volunteers to identify, cultivate, steward, and solicit donors through practical tools, training, talking points, and follow-up.
  • Maintain effective donor data, gift processing, acknowledgement, pledge tracking, segmentation, reporting, prospect management, and ethical fundraising practices.
  • Provide regular written fundraising reports to the Executive Director, Development Committee, and Board of Directors.
  • Establish measurable progress toward the position becoming self-sustaining through increased philanthropic revenue by the end of year two.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Demonstrated success in nonprofit fundraising, development leadership, donor cultivation, and revenue growth.
  • Experience securing major gifts, grants, sponsorships, annual gifts, or comparable philanthropic support.
  • Strong writing and speaking skills, including donor proposals, appeals, and impact messages.
  • Ability to work effectively with executive leadership, Boards, committees, volunteers, donors, and community partners.
  • Comfort with donor databases, fundraising reports, prospect tracking, and data-informed decisions.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting with strong communication, organization, and accountability.
  • Discretion, integrity, emotional intelligence, and sensitivity to suicide prevention and bereavement support.
  • Knowledge of Cape Cod and the Islands’ philanthropic, civic, nonprofit, or community networks is strongly preferred.

Work Arrangement and Residency Requirements

This is a fully remote position. The Director must reside full-time on Cape Cod, maintain a professional home office with reliable internet, participate in regular virtual meetings, and attend in-person staff gatherings, donor meetings, events, and community activities on Cape Cod and the Islands as needed. The role requires independent time management and reliable follow-through on agreed goals, deadlines, and reports.

Compensation and Benefits

  • $120,000 starting annual salary.
  • $5,000 annual health stipend.
  • A performance bonus may be considered at each annual performance review, in an amount determined at that time, provided mutually established goals and objectives have been met.
  • $5,000 retention bonus after three years of continuous, achievement-oriented service.
  • Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays.

How to Apply

Applications are due December 1, 2026. Interested candidates should submit their application using the application link provided.

For questions about the position or application process, please contact Susan Ricardi, Manager of Administration, at .

ABOUT THE ROLE

The Key Account Manager is responsible for managing, retaining and growing BESA contractor membership within their allocated geographical area.

The role acts as the main relationship lead for contractor members, ensuring they receive clear value from BESA, understand the support available to them, and remain engaged throughout their membership.

The role is also responsible for identifying and developing growth opportunities. This includes new contractor membership opportunities, Member Pledge opportunities, member referrals, supply chain opportunities and wider engagement.

This is a commercial relationship role. It combines account management, retention, engagement and growth.

Candidates must reside in Wales and have a strong connection to the country, with the credibility, knowledge and professional networks needed to engage effectively and represent BESA across Wales.

KEY DUTIES

Account management and retention

  • Manage a portfolio of allocated contractor members.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key contacts across member businesses, including owners, directors, commercial leads, technical leads, operations leads and compliance contacts.

  • Understand each member’s business, priorities, challenges and current use of BESA business support services.

  • Identify retention risks early and take action before membership renewal becomes a concern.

  • Ensure the member portfolio is fully aware and up to date with their BESA Competence Assessment Standard (CAS) Audits.

  • Maintain regular contact with priority members and ensure meaningful engagement is recorded in iMIS.

  • Ensure members understand and access relevant:

  • BESA business support - Technical, Employment, Health and Safety, Legal & Commercial, Training & Skills

  • Engagement activity – Region & Nation meetings, Specialist Group and Committee meetings and Business Networking Events

  • Additional Certificate Schemes and Benefits - REFCOM, VHR, SFG20, Welplan and wider BESA Group services where relevant.

Growth and new membership

  • Identify and develop new contractor membership opportunities within the allocated region or account base.

  • Prioritise contractor businesses that are active in BESA in-scope work areas and have clear potential for membership.

  • Support regional growth through Member Pledge, member referrals, supply chain opportunities, former members, event leads and warm introductions.

  • Progress suitable opportunities directly or hand them over to the sales team where appropriate.

  • Track all opportunities in iMIS, including owner, stage, likely band, revenue value where known, next action and source.

Member Pledge activity

  • Identify members who may be suitable to sign and commit to the BESA Member Pledge.

  • Support signed Member Pledge relationships where the business has agreed to the principles and the document is signed by the CEO, MD or equivalent senior decision-maker.

  • Work with Membership Operations to ensure supply chain lists are cleaned, mapped, uploaded and tagged correctly in iMIS.

  • Support the conversion of suitable supply chain contractors into full BESA contractor membership.

Regional engagement

  • Represent BESA across the allocated geographical area or account base.

  • Attend relevant member meetings, events, sector events and engagement activities.

  • Promote BESA’s role as the trade body for building engineering services contractors.

  • Identify opportunities for member stories, case studies, insight and examples of member value.

  • Feed insight back into the business, including member challenges, retention risks, market trends and growth opportunities.

KEY DELIVERABLES

The Key Account Manager will be expected to deliver:

  • Strong engagement across allocated contractor members

  • Account plans for priority members

  • Early identification of retention risk

  • Monthly RAG reporting

  • New contractor membership opportunities

  • Signed Member Pledge relationships

  • Supply chain growth opportunities

  • New full contractor members (targets set annually)

  • Accurate iMIS records

  • Clear weekly and monthly reporting

ABOUT YOU

Skills, Knowledge & Experience

Essential

  • Experience in account management, key account management, membership engagement or business development.

  • Strong relationship management skills.

  • Ability to manage a portfolio of accounts.

  • Ability to identify retention risk and growth opportunities.

  • Strong communication and follow-up discipline.

  • Commercial awareness.

  • Experience using CRM or membership management systems.

  • Ability to work independently across an allocated region or account base.

  • Ability to work collaboratively with internal teams.

Desirable

  • Knowledge of building engineering services, M&E, HVAC, FM or construction supply chains.

  • Experience in a membership body, trade association or compliance-led environment.

  • Understanding of competence, technical standards, procurement or contractor assurance.

  • Experience supporting member retention, account growth or regional engagement.

  • Experience with supply chain-led growth or referral-led sales.

BehavioursAt BESA, we expect all colleagues to demonstrate behaviours that support our culture and values.

  • Customer Empathy – We anticipate and address customer challenges to foster connection and meaningful experiences with them.

  • Accountability – We keep our word and deliver the results we promise, holding others to account to do the same. We actively manage potential consequences and take ownership to address them.

  • Continuous Improvement – We are deeply curious to understand how things work for our customers, industry and organisation. We challenge the status quo and look to enhance and evolve everything we do.

  • Agility – We respond and adapt swiftly to changing circumstances.

  • Commerciality – We make informed decisions that enable profitable and/or sustainable growth.

  • Care – We create an environment where people feel valued and heard, providing a sense of belonging.

Closing Date: 1st November 2026

Interviews will be arranged directly with shortlisted candidates

Don’t meet every single requirement? At BESA, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you're enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn't match every requirement perfectly, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be exactly the candidate we're looking for!

We encourage early applications, as we may close the vacancy once we receive a strong pool of candidates!

jobs.excerpt: About Navista We believe in the power of community oncology to support patients through their cancer journeys.
jobs.description:
About Navista

We believe in the power of community oncology to support patients through their cancer journeys. As an oncology practice alliance comprised of more than 40 sites, Navista provides the support community practices need to fuel their growth—while maintaining their independence.

What Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) contributes to Cardinal Health

Practice Operations Management oversees the business and administrative operations of medical practices.

The Revenue Cycle Management manages a team focused on a series of clinical and administrative processes that healthcare providers utilize to capture, bill, and collect patient service revenue. The revenue cycle shadows the entire patient care journey and begins with patient appointment scheduling and ends when the patient’s account balance is zero.

Responsibilities

Patient & Care Team Support

  • Lead a team of financial counselors providing real‑time support to patients, physicians, nurses, and care coordinators throughout the oncology care continuum
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex or urgent patient financial issues that could delay or disrupt care
  • Ensure financial counseling services are embedded into clinical workflows to support same‑day decisions and treatment starts
  • Promote a patient‑centered approach that balances financial clarity, empathy, and access to care

Revenue Cycle Leadership

  • Oversee front‑end revenue cycle functions, including insurance verification, benefits interpretation, prior authorization support, and patient cost estimation
  • Ensure timely identification and resolution of coverage issues prior to treatment initiation
  • Collaborate with downstream RCM teams (coding, billing, collections, denial management) to ensure continuity and accuracy across the revenue cycle
  • Monitor KPIs related to access, counseling timeliness, authorization turnaround, point‑of‑service collections, and financial clearance rates

Financial Assistance & Access Programs

  • Manage processes for screening and enrolling patients into financial assistance programs, including manufacturer assistance, charity care, grants, and foundation support
  • Maintain expertise in oncology‑specific reimbursement, benefit designs, and emerging payer policies
  • Ensure compliant and consistent application of financial assistance guidelines and documentation

Team Leadership & Development

  • Recruit, train, mentor, and evaluate financial counseling staff across multiple sites or service lines
  • Establish standard operating procedures and best practices for immediate patient and provider support
  • Foster strong communication, accountability, and service excellence within the team

Provider & Operational Partnership

  • Act as a trusted operational partner to physicians, APPs, nursing leaders, and practice administrators
  • Translate financial and coverage information into clear, actionable guidance for care teams
  • Participate in clinic leadership meetings and cross‑functional initiatives focused on access, growth, and patient experience

Compliance & Quality

  • Ensure all financial counseling activities comply with regulatory, payer, and organizational requirements
  • Support internal and external audits related to financial clearance, authorizations, and assistance programs
  • Continuously improve processes to reduce administrative burden on clinical teams and patients

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in healthcare administration, business, finance, or a related field (or equivalent experience) preferred

  • 5+ years of progressive experience in healthcare revenue cycle or financial counseling, preferably in oncology preferred

  • 3+ years of people management or team leadership experience preferred

  • Strong knowledge of insurance plans, oncology benefits, prior authorizations, and patient financial responsibility preferred

  • Demonstrated ability to work directly with clinical teams in fast‑paced care environments

  • Experience in a large MSO, multi‑site oncology practice, or complex specialty setting

  • Familiarity with EHR and RCM systems (e.g., Epic, Aria/Mosaiq, OncoEMR, or similar)

  • Deep understanding of oncology drug reimbursement models, including buy‑and‑bill, specialty pharmacy carve‑outs, and alternate funding pathways

  • Knowledge of ASP, WAC, AWP, and other drug pricing methodologies and their impact on charge capture and margin

  • Familiarity with Medicare Part B vs. Part D, commercial payer variations, and site‑of‑care reimbursement differences

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Manages department operations and supervises professional employees, front line supervisors and/or business support staff

  • Participates in the development of policies and procedures to achieve specific goals

  • Ensures employees operate within guidelines

  • Decisions have a short-term impact on work processes, outcomes and customers

  • Interacts with subordinates, peers, customers, and suppliers at various management levels; may interact with senior management

  • Interactions normally involve resolution of issues related to operations and/or projects

  • Gains consensus from various parties involved

jobs.excerpt: Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70K-85K/yr Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further!
jobs.description:
Licensed Marriage and Family Therapist (LMFT) $70K-85K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples?   • Health care benefits.

  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice.

Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

jobs.excerpt: Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.
jobs.description:
Fidelity will not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly experienced and dynamic leader to serve as Senior Vice President, Head of DC Sales. This executive leadership role is responsible for leading the Defined Contribution sales organization by setting a strategic vision, driving sustainable revenue growth, and expanding Fidelity’s market leadership across Advisor DC, Core, and Large Plan Sponsor Market segments. 

This role exists to accelerate client acquisition, maximize sales effectiveness, and position Fidelity as the provider of choice in the retirement marketplace through strong leadership, talent development, and execution of enterprise growth objectives. 

The Expertise You Have

  • Bachelor’s Degree Required; advanced degree preferred 
  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in Defined Contribution, retirement, or institutional investment industry, including significant leadership responsibility and commercial accountability. 
  • Deep knowledge of the retirement industry, including Defined Contribution plans, plan sponsor needs, participant outcomes, fiduciary considerations, recordkeeping, and retirement solutions.  
  • Proven ability to lead large-scale sales organizations, develop go-to-market strategies, increase market share, and achieve significant asset and revenue growth objectives. 
  • Strong network and credibility across plan sponsors, consultants, advisors, industry influencers, and key centers of influence 

The Skills You Bring

  • Series 7 and 63 registrations 
  • Strategic leadership capability with the ability to translate long-term business objectives into actional sales growth strategies and measurable outcomes. 
  • Deep understanding of industry trends, regulatory developments, marketplace dynamics, and competitive offerings affecting the workplace retirement market. 
  • Expertise in identifying client needs, positioning complex retirement solutions, and leading large, strategic sales opportunities through successful completion. 
  • Experience leading complex institutional sales opportunities, contract negotiations, pricing discussions, and strategic partnership agreements.
  • Strong executive presence with ability to influence internal and external stakeholders at the highest level 
  • Passion for talent development, coaching, and fostering a culture of accountability, and performance excellence 
  • Client-focused and commercially oriented, with a strong commitment to delivering sustainable value for clients and the business. 
  • Commitment to maintaining highest standards of compliance and regulatory guidelines 
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities 

The Value You Deliver

  • Lead, develop, and maintain a highly motivated, highly productive sales team which will lead to stronger client relationships and increased sales
  • Deliver business growth by expanding Fidelity’s Defined Contribution market position, increasing sales effectiveness, winning strategic mandates, and achieving asset, revenue, and market share objectives
  • Share the future direction of the Defined Contribution business by identifying emerging market opportunities, influencing enterprise priorities, and ensuring Fidelity remains at the forefront of the retirement industry innovation and client needs 
  • Serve as Fidelity’s senior executive representative within the retirement marketplace, strengthening the firm’s reputation and influence among plan sponsors, consultants, advisors, recordkeepers, advisors, and other key stakeholders 

The Team

The Institutional Client Group (ICG) team is responsible for distributing and servicing Fidelity’s investment management capabilities to institutional asset owners, such as retirement plans, endowments and foundations, and corporate assets. The Head of DC Sales organization leads a team of 17 associates, including 10 Advisor DC sales professionals, 4 Core Plan Sponsor sales professionals, and 3 Large Plan Sponsor sales professionals. Coverage spans DC retirement advisors and plan sponsors across the core and large-market segments, including plans above and below $1.25B with geography across US.

Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.

The base salary range for this position is $185,000-$400,000 per year.

Placement in the range will vary based on job responsibilities and scope, geographic location, candidate’s relevant experience, and other factors.

Base salary is only part of the total compensation package. Depending on the position and eligibility requirements, the offer package may also include bonus or other variable compensation.

We offer a wide range of benefits to meet your evolving needs and help you live your best life at work and at home. These benefits include comprehensive health care coverage and emotional well-being support, market-leading retirement, generous paid time off and parental leave, charitable giving employee match program, and educational assistance including student loan repayment, tuition reimbursement, and learning resources to develop your career. Note, the application window closes when the position is filled or unposted.

Please be advised that Fidelity’s business is governed by the provisions of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the Investment Advisers Act of 1940, the Investment Company Act of 1940, ERISA, numerous state laws governing securities, investment and retirement-related financial activities and the rules and regulations of numerous self-regulatory organizations, including FINRA, among others. Those laws and regulations may restrict Fidelity from hiring and/or associating with individuals with certain Criminal Histories.

Certifications:

Series 07 - FINRA, Series 24 - FINRA, Series 63 - FINRA

jobs.description:
Telehealth Therapist | Remote | Licensed in California | Full-Time

Banyan Treatment Centers is seeking a full-time Telehealth Therapist to join a clinical team built for growth, delivering IOP-level care to individuals overcoming substance use and mental health disorders.

This role calls for a clinician who brings strong therapeutic skill and genuine care to every session, while thriving in a fast-paced, collaborative telehealth environment. You'll report to the Telehealth Clinical Director, with additional support from the Head of Telehealth — giving you clinical guidance and operational backing at every level.

Position Details

  • Schedule: 40 hours per week. Banyan runs both AM and PM program tracks, and scheduling varies depending on current business and caseload needs — candidates should expect this to be discussed and confirmed during the interview process. Current need typically leans toward PM coverage, though this is subject to change.
  • Compensation: $85,000 - $90,000 (Dependent on licensure, education and previous clinical experience).

About the Company

Banyan Treatment Centers is a leading national provider of intensive treatment for individuals facing substance use and mental health disorders. Backed by TPG's The Rise Funds, one of the nation's largest private equity investors, Banyan is rapidly expanding access to high-quality, compassionate care.

Why Join Banyan Treatment Centers?

As a Telehealth Therapist, you will:

  • Join a mission-driven, nationally recognized organization backed by the resources and infrastructure to deliver best-in-class care at scale.
  • Work within a leadership structure built for support — a Clinical Director and Head of Telehealth both invested in your success and the program's growth.
  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team to provide integrated, patient-centered care.
  • Make a direct, lasting impact on patients during one of the most critical phases of their recovery.
  • Grow professionally within an organization that invests in continuous learning, mentorship, and career development.
  • Be supported in expanding your practice across state lines — we cover the cost of obtaining additional state licensure where there's a business need.

Benefits

Eligible full-time team members receive comprehensive benefits including:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Life insurance and disability coverage
  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Wellness incentives and employee assistance programs
  • Licensure reimbursement for additional state credentials, where applicable

Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate group therapy sessions within an Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP), managing a caseload of patients across multiple weekly groups.
  • Provide individual therapy to support each patient's progress through treatment.
  • Lead family engagement sessions to build support systems and strengthen continuity of care.
  • Complete comprehensive biopsychosocial assessments to guide level-of-care decisions and treatment planning.
  • Develop and complete master treatment plans, continuously updating individualized, measurable goals in collaboration with patients and the care team.
  • Apply sound clinical judgment in crisis situations — risk assessment, de-escalation, and suicide risk evaluation — within an outpatient setting.
  • Maintain consistent communication with referral sources and families to support progress and continuity of care.
  • Coordinate step-down and discharge planning, connecting patients with resources for legal, financial, and vocational needs.
  • Follow and provide consistent clinical care throughout the full patient enrollment in the program, from intake through discharge.
  • Maintain thorough, timely clinical documentation across all phases of care — this role involves a significant documentation load.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Active, unrestricted clinical license — LPC, LCSW, or LMFT strongly preferred (or applicable state equivalent). Associate/Intern-level, pre-licensed credentials accepted for Professional Counseling, Social Work, and Marriage & Family Therapy tracks.
  • Licensure in the state of California required at time of hire.
  • Master's degree in social work, counseling, marriage & family therapy, or a related human services field.

Strongly Preferred:

  • Active clinical licensure in 3 or more states.
  • Willingness to obtain licensure in additional states as business needs arise.
  • 2+ years of clinical experience serving SUD and/or MH populations.

Preferred:

  • Direct experience at an IOP level of care.
  • Experience with Kipu EMR systems.
  • Experience carrying a full caseload virtually.

Competencies

  • Working knowledge of clinical standards of care for patients with substance use and co-occurring mental health disorders.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build rapport and trust with diverse patient populations.
  • Sound clinical judgment and crisis intervention skills, including risk assessment and de-escalation.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills, with high attention to regulatory and confidentiality standards.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote setting while staying closely connected to a collaborative care team.

Apply Now

If you're a skilled clinician who's passionate about making a lasting difference and ready to grow with a mission-driven team, apply today and help us transform lives at Banyan Treatment Centers.

Banyan Treatment Centers is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Remote Clinical Pharmacist – HEDIS Medication Adherence
jobs.excerpt: About the Role:We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Clinical Pharmacist with a PharmD degree and experience in HEDIS medication adherence initiatives.
jobs.description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Clinical Pharmacist with a PharmD degree and experience in HEDIS medication adherence initiatives. The ideal candidate will play a crucial role in improving medication adherence rates among patients, ensuring compliance with HEDIS/Medicare quality measures, and driving overall health outcomes.

Key Responsibilities:

HEDIS Quality Measures:

  • Lead efforts to improve HEDIS medication adherence and other pharmacy quality measures, including but not limited to adherence to antihypertensive, cholesterol-lowering, and diabetes medications.
  • Analyze medication adherence data, identify gaps in care, and implement targeted interventions to improve adherence rates.
  • Collaborate with healthcare providers, care managers, and other stakeholders to develop and implement strategies that promote adherence to prescribed therapies.

Patient Engagement:

  • Conduct medication therapy management (MTM) sessions to address barriers to adherence, provide patient education, and ensure understanding of medication regimens.
  • Work directly with patients to identify and resolve issues related to medication adherence, including cost, side effects, and complex dosing schedules.
  • Utilize motivational interviewing techniques to encourage patients to adhere to their prescribed medication regimens.

Data Analysis & Reporting:

  • Monitor and track HEDIS performance metrics, generating reports to assess the effectiveness of interventions and programs.
  • Use electronic health records (EHR) and pharmacy data to identify patients at risk of non-adherence and develop action plans.
  • Provide regular updates to leadership on progress towards HEDIS goals and make recommendations for improvement.

Collaboration & Training:

  • Serve as a medication adherence subject matter expert (SME) within the organization.
  • Provide training and support to other pharmacists, care managers, and clinical staff on best practices in medication adherence.
  • Participate in cross-functional teams focused on quality improvement, population health management, and value-based care initiatives.

Leading-edge technologies and inclusive practices drive both individual and collective growth as we modernize and grow our technical capabilities.

Position Overview: We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Staff Software Engineer responsible for leading technical execution within Product Engineering teams. This role requires implementation of product capabilities with a strong focus on API-driven services and event-driven architecture. Collaborating closely with Product Management and Product Engineering to deliver customer and product-centric capabilities while leveraging lean development practices. You’ll bring a proactive attitude about risk, working to identify and resolve performance and scalability issues. Staff Engineers cultivate a healthy and respectful environment with a passion for driving innovation and excellence.

  • Lead the design, development, and deployment of services, APIs, and integrations, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and performance.
  • Ensure code quality and implement strategies to safely and reliably make changes to production systems frequently.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Mentor and support the growth of junior and intermediate engineers through knowledge sharing, pairing, technical guidance, and feedback.
  • Partner with Engineering Managers to evaluate team performance, provide input for annual reviews, and participate in hiring initiatives.
  • Stay up to date on industry trends and emerging technologies, bringing innovative solutions to the team.
  • Collaborate with other Staff and Sr. Staff Engineers to create a community of practice and an overall organizational technical strategy for business success.
  • Influence and publishing within the organization and industry to effect positive changes in business value and tech strategy within RB Global, along with advancing the craft of software development worldwide.

**Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned in support of organizational priorities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in software development with hands-on experience in backend development with Java or Go.
  • 2 Years minimum experience as a Staff engineering supporting a minimum of 4 teams across a major business domain.
  • Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Go.
  • Expertise in Spring Framework (e.g., Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security) and building RESTful APIs.
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, and event-driven systems.
  • Strong experience with relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL) as well as highly scalable no-SQL datastores.
  • Experience with Knowledge Graphs, and ML/AI Feature stores is a key differentiator.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Familiarity with frontend frameworks (e.g., React, Angular) for collaboration with full-stack teams.
  • Experience with modern Lean Software development, pair programming, TDD, and Trunk Based Development.
  • Good awareness of CI and CD approaches and tools.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.
  • A deep customer and product focus, with a passion for delivering high-quality solutions.

  • Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies and drive innovation in software engineering with zero friction in your value stream.
  • Collaborative and inclusive work environment that values diverse perspectives.
  • Access to continuous learning and professional development opportunities.
  • Competitive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, and professional development opportunities.
  • This is your opportunity to work with an engineering-driven organization innovating and delivering on a scale well beyond other players in our industry.
  • We value innovation, consistent delivery, quality deliverables, and finding joy in our work while crushing our competition.
