jobs.excerpt: At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality.
jobs.description:
At Forbes Advisor, our mission is to help readers turn their aspirations into reality. We arm people with trusted advice and guidance so they can make informed decisions they feel confident in and get back to doing the things they care about most.

We are an experienced team of industry experts dedicated to helping readers make smart decisions and choose the right products with ease. Forbes Advisor boasts decades of experience across dozens of geographies and teams, including Content, SEO, Business Intelligence, Finance, HR, Marketing, Production, Technology and Sales. The team brings rich industry knowledge to Forbes Advisor's global coverage of consumer credit, debt, health, home improvement, banking, investing, credit cards, small business, education, insurance, loans, real estate and travel.

Overview

We're looking for a Data Science Manager who can turn commercial problems into scalable Data Science products. You'll work closely with the Director of Data Science to turn our Data Science strategy into scalable products and measurable business outcomes. You'll manage the day-to-day work of a growing team while partnering directly with stakeholders across the business to understand the decisions they're trying to make and identify where Data Science can materially improve the outcome.

This is a player-coach role. You'll lead and develop a growing team of Data Scientists while remaining close enough to the work to shape methodology, review technical outputs and contribute hands-on where needed. Your success won't be measured by how many models the team builds, but by how widely they're used and the commercial impact they create. This is not a research-focused role. We want someone who enjoys solving difficult modelling problems but is equally interested in what happens afterwards: how a model gets into production, how people use it, what we learn from it and whether it actually improves performance.

Responsibilities

  • Commercial & Decision Science: Work with the Director of Data Science and business and marketing teams to identify high-value opportunities for Data Science, translating commercial problems into predictive models and decision-making products. You'll focus on areas including lifetime value, propensity modelling, customer value, forecasting and performance marketing optimisation, with commercial impact at the centre of how work is prioritised.
  • Scalable Data Science Products: Guide the development of reusable models and methodologies that can scale across products, verticals and use cases rather than repeatedly solving the same problems. You'll take work from experimentation through adoption, ensuring outputs are measurable, explainable and designed around how they'll ultimately be used.
  • Production Data Science: Work closely with Engineering and ML Ops to turn successful modelling work into reliable production products. You'll ensure models have appropriate experimentation, monitoring, retraining and feedback loops, while partnering with technical teams on the infrastructure needed to operate them at scale.
  • Business Partnership & Insight: Build trusted relationships across Marketing, Commercial, Analytics, Product and Engineering. You'll translate business needs into Data Science opportunities and complex modelling into clear recommendations, ensuring the team goes beyond producing predictions to explain what they mean, what we can learn from them and what the business should do next.
  • Team Leadership & Technical Quality: Lead and develop a growing team of Data Scientists while remaining technically close to the work. You'll coach the global team, review modelling approaches and technical outputs, establish consistent standards and contribute hands-on where it adds value. You'll create an environment where technical rigour, curiosity and commercial thinking reinforce one another.

Requirements

  • Experience managing and developing Data Scientists while remaining comfortable working at a technical level.
  • Strong experience in predictive modelling, machine learning and customer analytics.
  • Experience applying Data Science to commercial or performance marketing problems, ideally including LTV, propensity, customer value or acquisition optimisation.
  • Strong Python and SQL skills and experience working within modern cloud-based Data Science environments.
  • Experience taking models beyond experimentation and working with Engineering or ML Ops teams to deploy and operate them in production.
  • Strong understanding of experimentation and model evaluation, with experience in incrementality or causal inference particularly valuable.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical work into clear recommendations for senior business audiences.
  • A product mindset, with an interest in building reusable capabilities rather than one-off models.
  • Strong commercial judgement and a focus on measuring the real-world impact of Data Science.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in any of the following would be valuable, but we don't expect every candidate to bring all of them:
  • Performance marketing and optimisation across Google, Meta or other major advertising platforms.
  • Value-based bidding or conversion-value optimisation.
  • Direct collaboration with advertising platform Data Science or Marketing Science teams.
  • Affiliate marketing, lead generation or digital publishing.
  • Financial services, insurance, health or other regulated industries.
  • Attribution and marketing measurement.
  • Forecasting commercial or marketing performance.
  • DSP or advertising optimisation algorithms.
  • Modern MLOps tooling and platforms such as Vertex AI.
  • Applied AI techniques that complement traditional predictive modelling and decision science.

jobs.description:
Job Type: Full-Time | Location: Texas | Department: Data Center Delivery | Reporting to: Director, Network Delivery | Work Location Type: #remote
IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid-connected land and power in renewable-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.
Reporting to the Director, Network Delivery, the Senior Project Manager – Network Infrastructure Design & Standards is the portfolio design authority for the passive and physical network infrastructure that supports IREN’s data center campuses: outside-plant and inside-plant fiber, carrier entrances and meet-me rooms, campus backbone, structured cabling, pathways, and the rack, rack-unit and power placement of network equipment.
The role develops and maintains the network infrastructure standards the Director approves, and then holds every campus to them: approving designs, deviations and test packages, directing external architecture and engineering partners on telecom design, and setting the acceptance criteria that construction is measured against. It is an individual-contributor role with design-approval authority, working alongside the Senior Project Manager – Route Planning, the Senior Project Managers – Network Delivery and the Senior Project Managers – Site Network Delivery.
With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever-evolving applications of high-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way – responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.

Responsibilities

Standards and governance
  • Develop and maintain the portfolio network infrastructure standards – fiber architecture, cable and connector types, panel and splice architecture, pathways, MMR and MDF/IDF design, labeling, testing and acceptance criteria – and submit them to the Director, Network Delivery for approval.
  • Approve or reject telecom and fiber designs, deviations and substitutions against the approved standards; maintain the technical exception record and the remediation conditions that go with it.
  • Run design reviews at 30 / 60 / 90 percent and IFC for every campus; no construction package is released and no carrier order is placed before the gate is passed.

  • Set and track engineering KPIs: standards compliance, RFI and change-order reduction, first-pass test acceptance, documentation completeness and turnover quality.
Fiber infrastructure engineering
  • Lead the engineering review of OSP and ISP fiber infrastructure across the portfolio: carrier connectivity, campus backbone, inter-building and inter-campus connectivity, and the fiber serving compute, enterprise and operational technology networks.
  • Establish fiber-count and capacity requirements from current demand, redundancy, customer growth and future expansion; own the spare-capacity strategy for strands, panel ports, pathways and telecommunications spaces.
  • Set fiber-loss budgets, optical performance requirements and standardized distribution and patching architectures, including splice-versus-patch decisions.
Carrier entrance, MMR and diversity criteria
  • Set the standards for carrier entrance facilities, meet-me rooms, duct banks, manholes, handholes and diverse building entrances.
  • Define the physical-diversity and shared-risk criteria that the Senior Project Manager – Route Planning applies to candidate routes; review route packages for compliance.
  • Define demarcation, rack, cross-connect, power, grounding and carrier equipment placement standards in the MMR.
Campus infrastructure and equipment placement
  • Develop and approve campus fiber backbone architectures and MMR, core, MDF, IDF and telecommunications-room connectivity requirements.
  • Determine the room, rack and rack-unit position for new network equipment; coordinate A/B power and PDU outlet assignments with Electrical and Facilities Engineering.
  • Coordinate telecommunications infrastructure with civil, electrical, architectural, structural and mechanical design so pathways, rooms and power are protected in every building.
A/E and consultant direction
  • Direct external A/E firms and engineering consultants on telecom design: scopes of work, deliverables, milestones and review expectations.
  • Review and approve basis-of-design documents, specifications, drawings, fiber schematics, rack elevations, pathway plans, splice diagrams, port assignments and fiber matrices.
  • Hold consultants accountable for quality, completeness, constructability and compliance with IREN standards; evaluate performance across projects.
Construction support and engineering assurance
  • Conduct constructability reviews before construction packages are issued; superintendents and Senior Project Managers – Site Network Delivery attend the 60 percent review.
  • Provide technical direction on field conditions and engineering conflicts raised through RFIs by the Senior Project Managers – Site Network Delivery; evaluate proposed changes for reliability, capacity, cost, schedule and future expansion.

  • Participate in engineering-verification walks and confirm installed infrastructure matches approved design intent.
Testing and acceptance
  • Set the portfolio fiber acceptance standard: Tier 1 testing, Tier 2/OTDR, insertion loss, optical return loss where applicable, polarity, end-face inspection, splice-loss limits and launch/receive requirements.
  • Review and approve test packages before infrastructure is accepted; define the process for failed tests and deficiencies.
  • Apply acceptance criteria consistently across campuses and contractors.
NetBox, DCIM and documentation
  • Own the NetBox/DCIM data standard for physical infrastructure: asset, rack, panel, port, cable, circuit and pathway naming and the data required at each construction stage.
  • Define the handover data required from designers, contractors and carriers so as-builts match installed conditions.
Cross-functional coordination and risk
  • Partner with Network Engineering so logical design and equipment standards are reflected in physical design before construction; Network Engineering decides what a device does, this role decides where it lives and how it connects.
  • Provide technical input into RFQs, contractor bids and carrier proposals; support make-versus-buy decisions with the Senior Project Manager – Route Planning and Procurement.
  • Identify engineering risks and single points of failure across the portfolio; conduct root-cause analysis after significant infrastructure failures and drive portfolio-wide corrective actions.
  • Escalate unresolved technical risks to the Director, Network Delivery with a recommendation.

Requirements

  • Minimum 10 years of telecommunications, fiber infrastructure, data center engineering or network infrastructure experience.
  • 5+ years of proven project management on mid to large data center or mission-critical programs, including ownership of telecom or fiber design scope through construction and acceptance.
  • Deep technical expertise in outside-plant and inside-plant fiber, carrier entrance and MMR design, campus backbone, structured cabling and telecommunications spaces and pathways.
  • Experience directing engineering consultants and A/E firms and reviewing complex construction and engineering packages: basis of design, specifications, drawings, fiber schematics, splice diagrams, fiber matrices, rack elevations, submittals and RFIs.
  • Working knowledge of ANSI/TIA-568, 569, 606 and 758, ISO/IEC 11801, BICSI TDMM and OSP guidance, IEEE 802.3, NEC and applicable NFPA requirements.
  • Advanced understanding of fiber-optic systems: OS2 and OM4/OM5, MPO/MTP and LC connectivity, optical-loss budgets, Tier 1 and Tier 2/OTDR testing, splice-loss acceptance, DWDM and coherent optics.
  • Experience with NetBox or other DCIM platforms, AutoCAD, Bluebeam, Procore or similar tools.
  • Executive presence and reporting: able to explain technical risk and recommend a decision to technical and executive audiences, in writing and in person.
  • Experience in a fast-paced growth environment and in solving complex problems with company-wide impact.
  • OSHA 30.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Suite (Project, Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint).
Preferred qualifications – network and telecommunications
  • High-capacity architectures: 100G, 400G and 800G optical connectivity, DWDM and optical transport, and coordination with Network Engineering on logical design.
  • Network equipment physical deployment: room, rack and rack-unit placement, A/B power and PDU outlet assignment, cable management and airflow constraints.
  • Operational technology networks: physical infrastructure dependencies for BMS, EPMS, fire and life-safety monitoring, security, CCTV, access control, Wi-Fi and environmental monitoring.
  • Infrastructure records: NetBox or other DCIM data standards, naming conventions, port and cable identifiers, and as-built validation.
  • Standards and program governance: authoring and rolling out design standards, templates and acceptance criteria across multiple sites.
Also highly regarded
  • BICSI RCDD, OSP or RTPM, FOA CFOS/D, PE or equivalent credentials.
  • PM certification (PMP or equivalent) highly regarded but not required.
  • Experience supporting high-density AI, HPC or hyperscale environments.
  • Experience on direct-to-subcontractor (multi-prime) delivery as well as GC-led delivery.
  • Familiarity with GIS tools and with Primavera P6.

Benefits

Compensation
  • Actual compensation will be determined based on factors such as experience, qualifications, and market data for the region.
  • Total Compensation package may be inclusive of annual incentive bonus, equity (long-term incentive).
  • Relocation (as applicable and based on successful candidate circumstances)
Health & Wellness
  • 100% company paid health insurance premiums (medical, dental, and vision) for employees, 75% company paid coverage for dependents
  • Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance
  • Voluntary life, critical illness, and accident coverage available
  • Health Savings Accounts (HSA) – when combined with the High Deductible Health Plan
  • Employee Assistance Program and wellness resources
Retirement & Financial Wealth
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Access to financial planning and legal services
Time Off & Leave Programs
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays
Growth & Development
  • Internal skills training and advancement pathways
  • Professional development to support certifications, continuing education, or role related training
Community & Culture
  • Company events and team-building activities
We value diverse perspectives and believe that skills can be developed. If you’re passionate about this role, we want to hear from you — whether you meet every criteria or not. Your unique experiences might be exactly what we need!
IE US Operations Inc., the employing entity and proud member of the IREN group is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to creating an inclusive workplace. We are committed to evaluating qualified applicants and do not discriminate against protected characteristics under applicable legislation.

At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:
• Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future.
• Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.
• Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.
Technology is one of the most important parts of our business. Whether it’s supporting our songwriters, ensuring we provide the right royalty data to global partners, or helping our creative teams use the latest AI tools to discover new talent—technology plays an invaluable role in our success. Product Managers help turn vision into reality. Check out first-hand accounts from the WMG engineering, product, design, infrastructure and data teams in our blog!
WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone. We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.
Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.

A little bit about our team

At Warner Chappell Music (WCM), we are building the future of music publishing technology. As a Product Manager on the WCM Tech team, you will take ownership of two of our core, high-impact publishing platforms: Arrow and Tango.


Your Role

In this role, you will lead the evolution of our Demo Marketplace (ARROW)—a cutting-edge application that gives internal teams, A&R executives, and external partners direct streaming access to exclusive, unreleased song demos from our world-class roster of songwriters. You will also contribute to our core copyright and royalty engine - Tango, driving the foundational technology behind song metadata, rights management, and royalty processing. Working alongside Engineering, UX, and Technical Program Management teams, you will turn complex cross-functional data into seamless digital experiences.

Here you'll get to:

  • Drive Platform Roadmaps: Own roadmaps for ARROW (increase publishing revenue with our demo marketplace mobile app) and Tango (core publishing backend infrastructure).

jobs.excerpt: Head of AI Enablement & Transformation Voice Systems Engineering (VSE) is a dynamic organization driven by innovation and a shared passion for positively impacting people's lives.
jobs.description:
Head of AI Enablement & Transformation

Voice Systems Engineering (VSE) is a dynamic organization driven by innovation and a shared passion for positively impacting people's lives. We operate multiple brands and businesses, including Psychic Source, Plasma Futures and Soundbed, all focused on mind and body wellbeing, with our flagship brand, Psychic Source, leading the way.

Our vision at VSE centers on the belief that when talented individuals unite, possibilities become limitless. Rooted in a remote-first environment, we've cultivated a culture that embraces diversity, equity, work-life balance, and a true sense of belonging.

For over three decades, VSE has used technology to connect people with expert, caring guidance. We are an established, profitable company, and this year we made a deliberate decision to rebuild the way we work around AI rather than simply adding it to what we already do. Many AI projects are already underway across the business, and the whole company comes together every week to focus on AI adoption. We are now looking for the person to bring that work together and lead it.

We are seeking a passionate, hands-on and experienced Head of AI Enablement & Transformation to turn that commitment into everyday practice across the company. This is a builder's role rather than an advisory one. You should be comfortable prototyping and shipping generative AI agents, automations and the tooling that lets non-engineers use them safely, and equally comfortable teaching a team of roughly forty-five people, most of them non-technical, to apply these tools in their own jobs. You will own the stack, the guardrails and the numbers. You will not have a team reporting to you; the impact of this role comes from forty-five people who can do things they could not do before, working through AI champions across the business, the tools you build and the sessions you run. VSE runs on Holacracy, and this role sits in our General Company Circle, our most senior leadership team, with clearly defined domains that are yours to decide: the tooling stack and its vendors, the skills library and agent registry, and the scorecard and its targets.

Your first priority will be consolidation rather than expansion: bringing the work already underway into one coherent, well-governed program, deciding what to standardize on and what to retire, and putting the right guardrails in place before adding anything new. For the right person, this is the part that determines whether everything that follows succeeds, and the path from this role to real company-wide impact is unusually short.

If you're our new Head of AI Enablement & Transformation, you will look forward to engaging in activities such as:

  • Building and shipping AI capabilities: prototypes, agents, evaluation frameworks, and the pipeline that allows a non-engineer to deploy something safely. You will write code most weeks.

  • Leading hands-on enablement across the company: a weekly working session you run, role-specific playbooks, office hours, and a network of AI champions in every function, with adoption measured in actual use rather than attendance.

  • Redesigning core workflows around what AI makes possible, in partnership with the teams that do the work, rather than automating the steps that already exist.

  • Owning the AI scorecard: publishing weekly results including the metrics that missed, setting targets, and being transparent when a target changes and why.

  • Deciding the tooling stack: evaluating models, platforms, agent frameworks and vendors; running proofs of concept; making build-versus-buy calls; and avoiding tool sprawl.

  • Building the guardrails first: a graduated autonomy model that agents earn on evidence, traceability from every output back to its prompt and approver, a permissions and data-classification model that holds, and acceptable-use policy developed with Legal, HR and IT as partners from week one.

  • Managing the use-case pipeline from intake through prioritization, pilot, rollout and maintenance, and retiring at least one initiative each quarter, openly and with the reasoning, including your own.

  • Protecting the quality of what we ship: validating outputs against sources, retesting after model and tool updates, and defining where human oversight is required.

  • Looking after the team: one scorecard metric asks the team whether AI is making them more capable or just more pressured. Two consecutive weeks of decline pauses the rollout of new AI initiatives, and you are the one expected to call it.

Required Skills & Experience – You Should Have:

  • A track record of personally building and shipping agentic AI systems, automations or LLM-powered tools that people actually use, within the last twelve months.

  • At least 7 years in technology, operations, product, consulting or transformation roles, including at least 2 years of applied generative AI work.

  • Fluency with the current LLM ecosystem: prompting, agents, tool use, evaluation, retrieval, workflow orchestration and the major model providers, along with the judgment to tell a stakeholder when an idea will not work.

  • Scripting or coding ability sufficient to prototype, integrate via APIs, and troubleshoot without waiting on an engineering team.

  • Demonstrated success rolling out AI or automation across a non-technical workforce, with measurable gains in adoption, quality or efficiency.

  • Experience establishing governance, responsible-AI or data-handling policies in a live operating environment.

  • Excellent facilitation, coaching and communication skills: equally credible with engineers and with a customer care representative whose week you are trying to make easier.

  • Comfort owning a capability end to end, with direct accountability for results and without a team reporting to you.

Desired Skills:

  • Experience in a platform technology business, a two-sided marketplace, or an online B2C company. Industry background is not a requirement.

  • Experience consolidating scattered AI pilots or tools into one coherent, governed platform.

  • Familiarity with low-code automation platforms, data pipelines, and BI tooling.

  • Experience working in Holacracy or another self-management framework.

You don't need a background in our industry, but you do need to care about what we do. Our customers are real people reaching out at real moments in their lives, and the trust we have built with them over more than thirty years is the asset you will be working with.

At VSE the well-being of our people comes first, and we have nurtured a culture that focuses on health and wellness, personal growth, and social responsibility. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment of belonging for all employees and applicants. We are an equal opportunity employer.

We offer an unlimited vacation policy and flexible work schedule, so you can prioritize your needs for whatever season of life you are in. Our comprehensive insurance programs include medical, dental, vision, and life. VSE employees also have access to a "wellness wallet" that will reimburse them for gym memberships, workout equipment, mindfulness apps, healthy food boxes, ergonomic workspace tools, and more.

We prioritize investment in our people by offering a tuition reimbursement program and plenty of opportunities to continue learning. We also help you plan for your future and beyond by offering a 401k match and access to expert financial advice.

Please know that showing us things you have built or led yourself will be part of our hiring process. We don't just want to hear about your work; we want to see it. That might be a tool, an agent, a workflow or a short walkthrough of a project, along with what it does and what you learned along the way. If some of your work can't be shared because it belongs to a previous employer, that's understood, and we'll ask you to walk us through what you can.

This is a remote based position. You can learn more about life and work at VSE by visiting us here.

We are currently inviting residents of Colorado, Florida, New Jersey, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Washington.

Clinical Liaison (RN/Allied Health Professional)

Location: Remote (covering PA and NYC)

Employment Type: Part-Time - Weekend Coverage 9a-5p

Compensation: $55-$60/hr

The Role

    Are you an experienced Registered Nurse or Allied Health Professional, looking to step away from direct hands-on care and transition into an administrative, strategic, and business development role?

    We are seeking a dynamic, mission-driven Clinical Liaison to serve as the primary bridge between our hospital partners and the myLaurel care team during the weekends. In this role, you will be covering remotely across multiple partner facilities. You will serve as the main point of contact for our Acute Care at Home program through EMR secure chat and direct outreach, and provide administrative coordination and education to drive referrals and ensure seamless patient handoffs.

What You'll Do

    • Weekend & PTO Continuity Lead: Ensuring seamless weekend continuity for the full-time team, with additional capacity to provide coverage during planned PTO.

    • Drive Patient and Partner Engagement:. Work alongside hospital case managers, discharge planners, emergency department staff, and physicians to generate referrals for our in-home care programs.

    • Lead Administrative Coordination: Manage the logistical and administrative workflows of patient transitions, ensuring that the handoff from the hospital or emergency setting to the patient’s living room is flawless.

    • Identify Eligible Patients: Use your clinical background to review patient charts, assess eligibility for our acute-care-at-home model, and advocate for safe, alternative care pathways.

What You Bring

    • Active Registered Nurse or Allied Health License: Current, unencumbered license

    • Experience: 2+ years of experience in an acute care clinical setting. Previous experience or a strong interest in healthcare business development, clinical sales, discharge planning, or utilization review is highly preferred.

    • Relationship Builder: Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the natural ability to establish trust and build rapport with busy medical professionals and patients.

    • Administrative Excellence: Strong organizational skills and a desire to manage program logistics and care transitions rather than providing direct, hands-on patient care.

    • Remote Work Acumen: Thrives in remote environments, adeptly managing high-volume partner communications and complex schedules.

    • Tech-Savvy: Comfortable navigating various EMRs (Electronic Medical Records) and utilizing CRM software to track referral status and patient coordination

Why Join myLaurel?

    • Competitive Base Compensation: $55-60/hr

    • Career Growth: The perfect opportunity to pivot your clinical expertise into the business, administrative, and growth side of healthcare.

    • Work-Life Balance: Paid Time Off (PTO)

    • Financial Wellness: 401(k) retirement plan

    • Impact: The opportunity to be on the ground floor of a transformative healthcare model that keeps patients out of the hospital and in their homes.

About myLaurel

myLaurel was founded on the belief that a meaningful portion of hospital care can—and should—be delivered in the comfort of home. As a tech-enabled medical group, we provide on-demand acute and transitional care to frail, elderly, or medically complex patients at home—helping them avoid the traditional pathway of ambulance, emergency department, hospital admission, and post-acute facility care.

Health systems, payers, and provider groups partner with myLaurel to reduce avoidable utilization, lower readmission rates, accelerate throughput, and improve the patient experience—all while maintaining the highest standards of clinical quality and safety. We stand behind our outcomes by putting our fees at risk, demonstrating both accountability and confidence in the results we deliver.

Care is delivered through a physician-led model that combines virtual oversight with in-home clinicians, advanced technology, diagnostics, and therapies. For high-risk populations, myLaurel achieves 33% lower ED utilization, a 49% absolute reduction in readmissions, and an average of 15 bed-days saved daily - alongside a Net Promoter Score of 97.

Recognized for innovation and industry leadership, myLaurel has been named to Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and the New York Digital Health 100. The company is headquartered in New York City.

Learn more at: mylaurelhealth.com

jobs.title: SOC Analyst Internship Program - LSU Students Only
jobs.excerpt: Have you thought about a career in cybersecurity?
jobs.description:
Have you thought about a career in cybersecurity? Ever daydreamed about sleuth-level mastery the likes of Charlotte Justice, Easy Rawlins, or Veronica Mars... or perhaps captivated by the show Mr. Robot, national news like the Log4Shell Zero-Day vulnerability and major ransomware incidents, or the topic of election security? Our Security Operations Center (SOC) Analyst internship may be for you!

Let’s face it - Finding hands-on opportunities to learn about cybersecurity can be tough, and there isn’t one set path into this field. The industry needs organizations that are willing and able to train and equip the next generation of cybersecurity leaders, to secure our organizations, businesses, and nation. There is an imperative to break the mold of who is typically considered a cybersecurity professional, and it takes more than technical ability to succeed. With that in mind, we see the cybersecurity skills gap as an opportunity and are eager to be an on-ramp for those who want to learn and find a pathway into the constantly evolving, challenging world of online security.

Sure, our team has plenty of people with traditional IT-related backgrounds, but we also have team members who have crossed into cybersecurity from completely unrelated fields ranging from Education to Emergency Medical Technicians. We believe that having technically competent analysts with diversity of thought, culture, and experiences not only creates a better world but also fosters a more inclusive work environment. This gives us a competitive advantage to better protect our range of clients with the ability to consider threats from more diverse perspectives.

SOC analysts are the first line of defense for any of C3’s clients. Analysts have the critical responsibility to initially triage and make key decisions about how to identify, investigate, and address potentially malicious activity in a client’s network. This internship is designed to give students and aspiring cybersecurity professionals an opportunity to gain real-world experience working within a SOC, providing exposure to the technology, data, processes, and expectations that accompany a SOC analyst role. Guided coaching, paired with independently driven, hands-on activities will help you develop vital technical skills as well as soft skills. The internship offers ambitious students an opportunity to move from theoretical knowledge to practical experience.

Intrigued? Awesome! Here’s what you need to know about us: Our SOC began as a homegrown Louisiana-based company, focused on establishing Louisiana as a cybersecurity center of excellence. That means being the best at what we do so that we can bring 5,000 industry jobs to the state of “Union, Justice, and Confidence”. We would love to provide this internship opportunity to a student or resident of the state. As such, this cohort is only accepting applicants who are or will be enrolled in a Computer Science or Cybersecurity focused degree program within the LSU System Schools in January 2027

C3's Core Values:

  • Team Human: Respecting all humans is a critical part of who we are at C3. We practice integrity in all interactions, we empathize with others, we create a supportive work environment, and we support the communities in which we live and operate.
  • Security First: At the cornerstone of our business, we prioritize security above convenience, cost or efficiency. A “security-first” approach means we practice what we preach and we lead by example for our clients.
  • Be an Advocate: We are passionate in our advocacy for our customer’s success and a path to the best solution for their business. We embrace feedback, put ourselves in your shoes and advocate for your interests as our own.
  • Embrace Change: It's a practical necessity in an industry that never stands still. As a new entity born from the merger of two top-ranked CMMC-focused IT services companies, we're keenly aware that our success hinges on our ability to adapt - whether that means integrating new platforms, refining processes, or keeping pace with changing guidelines.
  • Resilience: Our ability to withstand adversity and accomplish objectives while maintaining professionalism and discipline is critical to successful crisis management and risk avoidance.

Internship Selection Process

Phase I - Application (until Nov 14)

Applicants complete Internship applications.
The C3 SOC Leadership Team will review and screen applicants and select candidates for Phase II.

Phase II - Assessment

Assessments will be assigned to candidates selected for Phase II.
The C3 SOC Leadership Team will review Assessment results and select candidates for Phase III.

Phase III - Interview

Phase III candidates will be scheduled for a (virtual) interview with the Internship Panel.
The Internship Panel and the C3 SOC Leadership Team will select Interns and Intern Alternates.

Responsibilities

As part of our Security Operations Center (SOC) team of analysts who actively monitor security alerts, perform threat hunting, and escalate tickets in order to manage potential threats/risks within our client environments, responsibilities include:

  • Complete the C3 SOC Analyst training program
  • Learn the basics of Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (SOAR), threat detection, and cybersecurity incident response (IR)
  • Monitor, detect and respond to security events from reviewing logs and alerts, and provide support when analysis confirms actionable incidents
  • Conduct network forensics, log analysis, and malware triage in support of threat hunting and investigations
  • Assist with auditing client security tool policies and configurations
  • Assist in projects to streamline, improve and create required operational tools, rule sets, processes, and documentation related to SOC workflows.
  • Assist in testing, analyzing, and evaluating existing or proposed SOC team tools, utilities, systems, and processes
  • Perform threat intelligence research with newly identified threats and vulnerabilities
  • Develop, document, and correlate recommendations for cybersecurity incidents and alert tickets

Basic Qualifications

  • Enrolled in a relevant IT/Cybersecurity degree program in LSU or LSU satellite campus.
  • Basic understanding of networks and technical environments, including conceptual knowledge of administering, defending, and analyzing servers or workstations
  • Experience working with Operating Systems (Windows, macOS, or Linux)
  • Basic analytical, problem-solving, time management, organizational, and project management skills
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work in a collaborative team environment, multitask, and prioritize during high-stakes security situations
  • Comfortable using and/or learning tools such as Teams and Office
  • Ability to follow defined processes and procedures, work independently and make decisions with minimal direction

Advanced Qualifications
For students further along in their IT/Information Security studies or individuals who have decided to pursue a career in cyber and have work experience or completed self-study training via platforms such as LetsDefend, TryHackMe, Hack The Box, RangeForce, Udemy, Cybrary, Coursera, etc.).

  • Experience with security tools in a work or lab* environment (lab = academic lab or home lab set up with servers, big data, and security tools set up to conduct tasks specific to analysis and triage of security data and events)
  • If you meet these advanced qualifications, we might even have a job for you so definitely reach out!

Schedule: 16-38 hrs/wk

Compensation: $11 - $14 hourly, depending on experience. We will work with your academic institution if they offer academic credit.
Internship Length: January 11, 2027 – May 14, 2027.

Location: Remote (Louisiana)

This is a high-volume, fast-paced position that requires prior knowledge of grievance and appeals processes. In this role, you will research complex claim and service issues, determine appropriate levels of review, coordinate with internal teams and providers, document findings, and prepare professional correspondence including acknowledgment and resolution letters. Success in this position requires exceptional attention to detail, strong written communication skills, sound judgment, and the ability to efficiently navigate multiple systems while delivering accurate, compliant, and timely resolutions that support both provider satisfaction and business objectives.

In this role, you will primarily be working in a remote setting. CANDIDATES MUST RESIDE IN THE STATE OF ARIZONA TO BE CONSISDERED. Work shifts will be 8:00 a.m.-5:00 p.m. Monday-Friday. If this role sounds like the one for you, Apply Today!

Registry/Per Diem positions do not have guaranteed hours and no medical benefits package is offered. Completion of post-offer Occupational Health physical assessment, drug screen and background check (includes employment, criminal and education) is required.

POSITION SUMMARY

This position handles member and provider grievances, appeals and claim disputes. This position will act as a key advocate and contact for HP members with general health care and accessibility concerns and inquiries on the various levels of the grievance and appeals process.

CORE FUNCTIONS

1. Determines which claim disputes meet acceptable claim dispute criteria, specifically screening for Untimely claims and Resubmissions; maintains a log, categorizes and tracks all received documents, notices, returned receipts; decides and responds to those appeals and claim disputes not meeting criteria with appropriate correspondence and routing. Assists in resolving member questions and concerns regarding the health care system in an effort to prevent the need for members to file formal grievances or appeals.

2. Enters all accepted appeals and claim disputes and its corresponding information into the CRM; creates and maintains case files, including appropriate review sheets for Medical Review and/or Claim Review according to policy, AHCCCS, HCG, and CMS regulations; updates CRM for ongoing cases with responses from reviewers. Assesses individual cases and documents in various CRM programs for pertinent information for referral and/or transmission to co-workers.

3. Ensures all appeals and claim disputes are acknowledged, by official correspondence, within AHCCCS, HCG, and CMS contractual timelines; protects the confidentiality of member information and other information. Facilitates, communicates and accepts input regarding member and provider appeal information from appropriate individuals that would include employees, providers, Medical Director, Plan Administrator, RNs, Risk Management, attorneys, AHCCCS, HCG, CMS and others.

4. Responds to all incoming phone calls, researches and resolves member and provider questions and concern regarding grievances, appeals and claim disputes. Opens, reviews, researches (if necessary), date stamps and routes or responds to all incoming mail. Responds in an expedient manner that is consistent with the mission and values of UAHN and in support of related regulations and policies and procedures to member, staff and physician grievances, appeals and claim disputes with minimal supervision.

5. Creates and submits all resolution and extension correspondence, utilizing appropriate Arizona Revised Statues, Arizona Administrative Code, Code of Federal Regulations, and other supporting regulatory policies and statutes for all UAHP managed plans. Self-audits daily to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements.

6. Recognizes, facilitates and gathers relevant medical records, coding and claim documentation that is required for the reviewers to fully investigate grievances, appeals, and claim disputes. Responsible for trouble shooting, identifying, and resolving special handling requirements related to grievance and appeal issues.

7. Reports at Grievance/Appeals meetings, as appropriate, all incoming, attended and scheduled State Fair Hearings.

8. Works internally with other departments in order to facilitate timely responses and inquiries, and assists with workgroups as requested. Provides technical expertise to other departments regarding grievances, appeals and claim disputes.

9. This position works under supervision, prioritizing data from multiple sources to provide quality care and support. Incumbents work in a fast-paced, sometimes stressful environment with a strong focus on customer service. Interacts with staff at all levels throughout the organization.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

High school diploma/GED or equivalent working knowledge. Two years of work experience in health care related field or experience managing projects/initiatives, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Knowledge of AHCCCS, HCG and/or CMS regulations. Knowledge of MS Word, Excel and Microsoft Office Suite required. Knowledge of Medical terminology, claims processing guidelines, and CRM & IDX. Knowledge of grievance, appeal and claim dispute processes.

Strong interpersonal, organizational and problem solving skills. Strong oral and written communication skills required. Ability to work independently ensuring all deadlines/timelines are met and to work with various levels of healthcare professionals. Ability to be flexible and work on a variety of projects simultaneously under tight time constraints. Strong analytical, critical-thinking and time management skills. Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize multiple tasks daily. Ability to quickly identify, summarize and present (verbally and orally) options to issues which may arise, and to consistently meet and exceed regulatory reporting requirements for all lines of business.

• Ensures team remains aware of latest security and privacy legislation, regulations, advisories, alerts and vulnerabilities pertaining to UofL Health

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreSpectro Cloud is redefining how organizations manage Kubernetes, virtualization, and AI infrastructure across data centers, public cloud, edge, and distributed environments.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Spectro Cloud is redefining how organizations manage Kubernetes, virtualization, and AI infrastructure across data centers, public cloud, edge, and distributed environments.

Our Palette platform gives organizations the flexibility and control to build, deploy, and manage Kubernetes-based infrastructure anywhere while simplifying operations at scale. As infrastructure evolves to support AI and GPU-intensive workloads, Spectro Cloud is helping customers modernize their environments while improving operational efficiency and economics.

We are growing quickly and looking for high-energy, accountable sellers who want to build pipeline, win new customers, and help shape our continued growth.

Who We Are Seeking

We are looking for a results-driven US Commercial Account Executive based in the New York Area to drive new-logo growth across the commercial market.

This is a high-velocity, new-business role with a clear mandate: consistently acquire new customers, achieve quarterly new-logo goals, and deliver quarterly revenue targets with strong linearity throughout the quarter.

We want a seller who is willing to participate in their own success.

You will have support from Marketing, Sales Development, Sales Engineering, leadership, and our partner ecosystem—but you are ultimately accountable for creating pipeline, progressing opportunities, winning new logos, and delivering your number.

The successful candidate doesn't wait until the final weeks of the quarter to produce results. You build enough pipeline and maintain enough deal velocity to consistently close business throughout the quarter.

Job Responsibilities

As a Commercial Account Executive, you will own your territory and your results.

You will:

  • Consistently achieve or exceed quarterly new-logo goals.

  • Deliver strong quarterly linearity, with new customers and revenue closing throughout the quarter.

  • Build, develop, and manage a healthy pipeline that supports both the current quarter and future quarters.

  • Own your territory from both a revenue and go-to-market perspective.

  • Develop and execute a territory plan identifying high-potential accounts, industries, partners, and use cases.

  • Proactively prospect and create your own opportunities in addition to working inbound and SDR-generated opportunities.

  • Maintain a consistent cadence of in-person customer meetings, discovery sessions, demos, technical evaluations, and executive conversations.

  • Sell across multiple lines of business and buying centers within target accounts.

  • Build relationships across infrastructure, cloud, platform engineering, virtualization, DevOps, AI, application, and executive teams.

  • Work closely with channel partners, VARs, systems integrators, cloud providers, and technology partners to generate and accelerate opportunities.

  • Identify opportunities to land with an initial use case and expand into additional teams, business units, and workloads.

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and demonstrate complete command of your business.

Quarterly Execution & Linearity

Success in this role requires more than simply hitting an annual number. We expect consistent quarterly execution.

You will be responsible for:

  • Achieving quarterly new-logo and revenue targets.

  • Maintaining sufficient pipeline coverage for both the current and following quarter.

  • Creating new pipeline every week.

  • Progressing opportunities with urgency and clearly defined next steps.

  • Closing business throughout the quarter rather than relying on end-of-quarter concentration.

  • Maintaining a balanced pipeline across early-, mid-, and late-stage opportunities.

  • Building enough opportunity volume to overcome normal deal slippage without compromising the quarter.

  • Identifying pipeline gaps early and taking action to address them.

  • Maintaining disciplined deal inspection and forecasting.

  • Entering each new quarter with meaningful pipeline already developed. Linearity matters.

We are looking for sellers who build predictable businesses—not sellers whose results depend on a last-minute end-of-quarter push.

What You Will Sell

You will position Spectro Cloud's portfolio across a broad range of modern infrastructure initiatives, including:

  • Enterprise Kubernetes management

  • Hybrid and multi-cloud infrastructure

  • Virtualization modernization

  • VMware alternatives and modernization

  • Data center modernization

  • Edge and distributed computing

  • Platform engineering

  • GPU infrastructure

  • AI infrastructure

  • AI workload orchestration

  • Infrastructure efficiency and economics

  • Tokenomics and AI inference economics

You should be comfortable identifying an initial business or technical problem and expanding the conversation across multiple lines of business and use cases.

Sales Execution

This is not a role where pipeline is simply handed to you.

Successful Commercial AEs at Spectro Cloud actively participate in creating their own success.

You will:

  • Prospect consistently into targeted commercial accounts.

  • Convert outbound, inbound, partner, and SDR-generated opportunities into qualified pipeline.

  • Conduct effective discovery across technical and business stakeholders.

  • Build meaningful customer relationships through regular in-person, face-to-face engagement.

  • Identify compelling events and measurable business outcomes.

  • Develop strong internal champions.

  • Establish access to decision-makers and Economic Buyers.

  • Create urgency and maintain momentum throughout the sales cycle.

  • Manage technical evaluations and POCs against clearly defined success criteria.

  • Use MEDDPICC principles to qualify and manage opportunities.

  • Utilize Mutual Action Plans where appropriate to establish clear customer and Spectro Cloud commitments.

  • Work closely with Sales Engineering to efficiently move technical evaluations toward business decisions.

  • Maintain disciplined opportunity management and next steps.

  • Forecast accurately and consistently.

Channel & Partner Execution

Our partner ecosystem should amplify your ability to win.

You will:

  • Develop productive relationships with strategic channel partners within your territory.

  • Work with VARs, systems integrators, cloud providers, and technology partners to identify new opportunities.

  • Build joint pipeline with partners rather than treating the channel simply as a fulfillment mechanism.

  • Develop joint account strategies for priority commercial accounts.

  • Leverage partners to gain access, accelerate opportunities, and expand Spectro Cloud's reach.

  • Hold partners accountable while giving them compelling reasons to bring Spectro Cloud into their customers.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of successful B2B enterprise technology sales experience in an in-person, customer-facing role.

  • Proven experience developing relationships and selling directly to customers through face-to-face meetings, executive briefings, onsite discovery sessions, presentations, and strategic account engagements.

  • Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding quarterly quota.

  • Demonstrated success acquiring new-logo customers.

  • Evidence of strong quarterly execution and sales linearity.

  • Strong prospecting and pipeline-generation skills.

  • Experience managing a high-velocity commercial sales motion.

  • Ability to manage multiple active opportunities simultaneously without sacrificing sales discipline.

  • Experience selling across multiple lines of business and buying centers.

  • Experience working with channel partners to generate and accelerate pipeline.

  • Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, containers, virtualization, or related infrastructure technologies.

  • Familiarity with AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud.

  • Exposure to GPU and AI infrastructure is highly desirable.

  • Ability to connect technical capabilities to business value, operational efficiency, TCO, and infrastructure economics.

  • Experience with MEDDPICC or a comparable enterprise sales methodology.

  • Strong CRM, pipeline management, forecasting, and territory-planning discipline.

  • Established customer and partner relationships in New York and the Northeast are highly desirable.

What Makes You Successful Here

You are a hunter.

You like winning new customers and understand that new logos are the lifeblood of a growing company.

You don't wait for pipeline—you create it.

You participate in your own success.

You understand that Marketing, SDRs, Sales Engineering, leadership, and channel partners are resources that amplify your efforts, not substitutes for them.

You understand the importance of quarterly linearity. You build pipeline early, create urgency, and consistently close business throughout the quarter.

You value being in front of customers. You build relationships face-to-face and understand that strategic customer engagement extends beyond email, Zoom, and Teams.

You don't confuse activity with productivity. You understand your conversion rates, pipeline coverage, deal velocity, and what needs to happen every week to achieve your quarterly goals.

You know how to land with an initial use case and then identify opportunities across additional teams and lines of business.

You take ownership of your territory, pipeline, forecast, partners, and results.

You are competitive, curious, accountable, coachable, and comfortable operating in a fast-moving growth environment.

Why Spectro Cloud

Enterprise infrastructure is undergoing one of its largest transformations in decades.

Kubernetes, virtualization modernization, distributed infrastructure, GPU computing, and AI are converging and changing how organizations design and operate technology.

Spectro Cloud sits at the center of that transformation.

If you want to build a territory, win new customers, work directly with customers and partners, and have a direct impact on the growth of the company, we'd like to hear from you.

The salary range for this role is $240,000 - $320,000 OTE + Equity.

This position is responsible for facilitating proper charge capture in accordance with standard billing policies and clinical documentation practices through the use of the hospital's electronic information systems, manual processes, and review of the medical record. Identifies inconsistencies in medical reports and works with healthcare staff to improve charge capture and error correction. Minimum Job Qualifications

  • Educational Requirements: High School Diploma or GED

Job Specific and Unique Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Displays problem solving ability, initiative, reasoning ability, decision making techniques, is detailed oriented, and appropriate use of resources

  • Identify deficiencies or discrepancies in nursing and/or physician documentation that affects billing and notifies the originator of the incorrect documentation to allow for proactive improvements related to charge capture.

Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING

Join the Kingdom of Saudia Arabia (KSA) Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence (C4I) Modernization Team and be a critical contributor on the first-phase design team helping to shape the project’s overarching modernization initiatives.

The team’s primary focus during the design stage is to shape the functional architecture and system capabilities that will rapidly modernize the customer’s product line. Day-to-day activities will include (but are not limited to) requirements governance, architecture definition, system documentation, CONOPs development, and integration guidance/planning. This is an opportunity to help design and develop the updated baseline while working directly with an international customer.

THE WORK

The KSA C4I Team is seeking a systems engineer to join our development team. In this role, you will:

  • Decompose customer requirements and use cases into system capabilities and functions
  • Perform requirements tracing to ensure that the necessary system and subsystems are developed in accordance with customer requirements/expectations
  • Create/refine MBSE models depicting system architecture and system activity/sequence diagrams
  • Help contribute to various SE CDRL documents, including (but not limited to): SEMP, ICD, SDD’s, TEMP
  • Help refine and develop overall system CONOPs to ensure planned modernization capabilities continue to meet the overall mission needs

PLEASE NOTE

  • This position may require travel to customer sites throughout the KSA.
  • This position may occasionally support off-hours test events, including overnight and weekend activities.

WHO WE ARE

The KSA C4I Modernization Team is a geographically dispersed project team that will operate in an Agile Scrum environment. Team members have the opportunity to work directly with an international customer and gain exposure to the technologies and processes supporting this upgrade.

Come be a part of a rapidly developing, fast-paced project team that is empowered to quickly develop and iterate potential design upgrades, with a condensed feedback loop that allows for quick iterations on proposed updates. This customer environment is a unique experience for an engineer to put their stamp on drafting new system functionality with a very engaged customer in an accelerated design cycle. If the thought rapidly performing various design activities and growing your knowledge on the numerous types of systems engineering artifacts that are developed and delivered as part of design stage of a modernization upgrade project is exciting, then the KSA C4I Team is the place to be!

This team/position is contingent upon contract award.

Basic Qualifications

  • Experience in MBSE (Cameo, Rhapsody)
  • Experience with Requirements Decomposition and Traceability (DOORS, Jama)
  • Experience with Use Case and CONOPs Definition/Decomposition
  • Experience across the various activities in the Systems Engineering V-Diagram
  • Experience Developing CDRL Documentation
  • 4+ years of relevant work experience (Advanced Degree may be substituted for 2 years of experience)

Desired Skills

  • Experience tracing requirements down to subsystem design/implementation details
  • Experience participating in Early system design/maturation activities
  • Previous C2 Domain Experience
  • Experience in Agile Methodologies & Tools
  • Previous International Customer Experience

Driving Technology Adoption, Consumption, and Growth

Lumen is evolving what and how we sell—bringing deeper technology fluency, consultative discovery, and business-outcome conversations into every customer engagement. Our Acceleration and Growth team offers distinct opportunities to help customers adopt, use, and expand technology that advances their priorities. As an Account Director Senior Large Enterprise Strategis, you will own growth across large, important, and potentially global enterprise accounts by translating customer business priorities into measurable outcomes enabled by Lumen’s network, cloud, security, managed services, and orchestration portfolio.

As the Account Director Senior, you operate independently from acquisition through modernization, activation, adoption, consumption, and expansion. You set account strategy, shape and negotiate commercial terms, mobilize cross-functional resources, and advise executive stakeholders. Your broad command of customer economics, markets, technology, and complex buying environments makes you a trusted expert to customers and colleagues.

Job Summary:

Manager, Product Analytics and Experimentation
Location: US- Remote
Division: Global Product Analytics and Experimentation
Line Manager: Sr. Director, Global Product Analytics and Insights
Contract Terms:****6 months****


THE TEAM
The Global Product Analytics and Experimentation team at Ticketmaster is a highly skilled, collaborative group that finds opportunities to improve the product and grow revenue through rigorous analysis, experimentation, and new ways of looking at data. The team partners with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Strategy, and Finance. Our work covers fan insights, ticket sales, shopping behavior, site and app analytics, incremental revenue streams, venue and client analysis, and customer lifetime value.


THE JOB
We are seeking an experienced experimentation and product analytics leader to join Global Product Analytics and Experimentation. As Manager, Product Analytics and Experimentation, you will lead the development of a scalable experimentation practice that drives product decisions and improves the fan experience. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution: setting experimentation standards, onboarding and enabling teams, configuring and managing tests in Optimizely, analyzing results with rigor, and turning learnings into clear product recommendations. You will partner across Product, Design, Engineering, Research, and Analytics to make experimentation part of every stage of product development.


WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

  • Lead and scale the product experimentation program, including processes, governance, measurement standards, and team onboarding.
  • Serve as the hands-on subject-matter expert for Optimizely, including experiment setup, audience targeting, QA, instrumentation validation, and test monitoring.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to identify testing opportunities and design statistically sound A/B, multivariate, and other experiments.
  • Interpret experiment results, explain what they mean and where they fall short, and turn findings into recommendations that shape product strategy and roadmap decisions.
  • Work with stakeholders to define and measure key digital metrics tied to fan and business goals.
  • Use data analysis to find trends, patterns, and opportunities that improve the end-to-end fan experience.
  • Build analytics tools, methods, and self-service resources that help teams make better data-informed decisions.
  • Translate business questions into analytical and experimentation solutions.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders and counterparts across the North America Insights and Analytics organization.
  • Partner with the Research team to combine behavioral, experimental, and qualitative insights into a deeper understanding of fan needs.

WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (OR TECHNICAL SKILLS)

  • Demonstrated experience leading and executing a product experimentation program, from hypothesis development and test design through implementation, analysis, and recommendations.
  • Hands-on experience with Optimizely or a comparable experimentation platform, including configuring, QA-ing, launching, and monitoring experiments.
  • Advanced statistical knowledge, including hypothesis testing, power analysis and sample-size planning, confidence intervals, sequential testing, multiple-comparison correction, and variance reduction techniques.
  • Proven ability to spot and address common experimentation pitfalls, such as sample ratio mismatch, peeking, novelty effects, and interaction effects between concurrent tests.
  • Ability to design and run complex product experiments, including A/B and multivariate tests.
  • Advanced proficiency with AI tools and LLMs to speed up and scale analytics work, such as writing and debugging queries, automating recurring analysis and reporting, generating test hypotheses, and summarizing results. Strong judgment to check AI output for accuracy.
  • Experience with digital analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Contentsquare.
  • Advanced SQL proficiency, with hands-on experience in Databricks and Google BigQuery.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to turn complex analytical and experimental findings into clear, compelling stories for non-technical audiences.

YOU (BEHAVIORAL SKILLS)

  • Partners with stakeholders to understand their needs, build analytical frameworks, and deliver data-driven strategic insights.
  • Coaches and enables others, helping teams build confidence and skill in experimentation.
  • Builds rapport and trust with diverse team members.
  • Brings curiosity and intellectual honesty, and is willing to let the data challenge assumptions, including their own.
  • Is open to diverse perspectives and ideas.
  • Focuses on the highest-impact work.
  • Manages time well to meet deadlines and commitments.
  • Adapts to changing priorities and environments.
  • Stays resilient through setbacks and obstacles.

BENEFITS & PERKS

Through our ‘Taking Care of Our Own’ program, we provide benefits across six key pillars:

  • HEALTH: Medical, vision, dental and mental health benefits for you and your family, with access to a health care concierge, and Flexible or Health Savings Accounts (FSA or HSA)
  • YOURSELF: Free concert tickets, generous paid time off including paid holidays, sick time, and personal days
  • WEALTH: 401(k) program with company match, stock reimbursement program
  • FAMILY: New parent programs including caregiver leave, plus fertility, adoption, foster, or surrogacy support
  • CAREER: Career and skill development programs with School of Live, tuition reimbursement, and student loan repayment
  • OTHERS: Volunteer time off, crowdfunding match

LIFE AT TICKETMASTER

We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.

Our mission at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. Ticketmaster is the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the global market leader in live event ticketing products and services. Through official partnerships with thousands of venues, artists, sports teams, festivals, performing arts centers and theaters, Ticketmaster processes 550 million tickets per year across 35+ different countries.

We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.

Our work is guided by our values:

Reliability - Fans and clients count on us to power their live event experiences and we rely on each other to make it happen.

Teamwork – While we celebrate individual achievements, we know have more success as a team.

Integrity - We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent.

Belonging - We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY

We aspire to build teams that reflect and support the fans and artists we serve. Every day we aim to promote environments where everyone can be themselves, contribute fully, and thrive within our company and at our events. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with.

Ticketmaster strongly supports equal employment opportunity for all applicants regardless of age (40 and over), ancestry, color, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), family and medical care leave or the denial of family and medical care leave, mental or physical disability (including HIV and AIDS), marital status, domestic partner status, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, military and veteran status, political affiliation, national origin (including language use restrictions), citizenship, race, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding and medical conditions related to pregnancy, childbirth or breastfeeding), gender, gender identity, and gender expression, sexual orientation, intersectionality, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state or local law, rule, ordinance or regulation.

We also afford equal employment opportunities to qualified individuals with a disability. For this reason, Ticketmaster will make reasonable accommodations for the known physical or mental limitations of an otherwise qualified individual with a disability who is an applicant consistent with its legal obligations to do so, including reasonable accommodations related to pregnancy in accordance with applicable local, state and / or federal law. As part of its commitment to make reasonable accommodations, Ticketmaster also wishes to participate in a timely, good faith, interactive process with a disabled applicant to determine effective reasonable accommodations, if any, which can be made in response to a request for accommodations. The Director of Coding Quality Assurance and Education provides strategic leadership and enterprise oversight for coding quality assurance, audit, education, compliance validation, and technology-enabled coding quality across Hospital Billing (HB) and Professional Billing (PB). This position establishes the enterprise vision, governance structure, standards, and performance expectations necessary to promote coding accuracy, regulatory compliance, consistency, operational excellence, and continuous improvement throughout WVU Medicine.

The Director leads the coding quality and education function, including assigned managers, Coding Auditor/Educator staff, and other quality resources, and serves as a senior partner to Coding leadership, Compliance, Clinical Revenue Cycle, Epic/Information Technology, Finance, operational leaders, and external coding partners. The Director is accountable for enterprise audit strategy, education and remediation programs, vendor quality assurance, executive-level reporting, and the development of controls for computer-assisted, AI-assisted, autonomous, and other emerging coding technologies.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:
1. Bachelor's degree in Health Information Management, Health Information Administration, Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, or related field AND five (5) years of progressive experience in medical coding, coding auditing, coding quality assurance, coding education, compliance, or a related revenue cycle function

OR

Associate’s Degree in Health Information Technology AND seven (7) years of progressive experience in medical coding, coding auditing, coding quality assurance, coding education, compliance, or a related revenue cycle function

OR

High school diploma AND ten (10) years of progressive experience in medical coding, coding auditing, coding quality assurance, coding education, compliance, or a related revenue cycle function AND active coding certification from the American Health Information Management Association or American Academy of Professional Coders.

EXPERIENCE:
1. Three (3) years of leadership experience with responsibility for coding quality, auditing, education, compliance, or a related revenue cycle function.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

EDUCATION, CERTIFICATION, AND/OR LICENSURE:
1. Master’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Health Information Management, or related field.

2. Active coding certification from the American Health Information Management Association or American Academy of Professional Coders.
EXPERIENCE:
1. Five (5) years of leadership experience in coding quality assurance, coding audit, compliance, or coding education within a large, complex healthcare system, including experience supporting both Hospital Billing and Professional Billing environments.

CORE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Establishes and directs the enterprise strategy, governance framework, and operating model for coding quality assurance, audit, education, and validation across Hospital Billing and Professional Billing.

2. Provides executive oversight of routine, focused, compliance-directed, and risk-based coding audit programs to evaluate coding accuracy, documentation support, regulatory compliance, reimbursement integrity, and adherence to organizational standards.

3. Approves and maintains enterprise audit methodologies, sampling standards, scoring protocols, quality thresholds, escalation criteria, and remediation expectations to ensure consistent application across coding functions.

Standard Job Description

WHAT WE'RE DOING

Join the Kingdom of Saudia Arabia (KSA) Command, Control, Communications, Computers, and Intelligence (C4I) Modernization Team and be a critical contributor on the first-phase design team helping to shape the project’s overarching modernization initiatives.

The team’s primary focus during the design stage is to shape the functional architecture and system capabilities that will rapidly modernize the customer’s product line. Day-to-day activities will include (but are not limited to) requirements governance, architecture definition, system documentation, CONOPs development, and integration guidance/planning. This is an opportunity to help design and develop the updated baseline while working directly with an international customer.

THE WORK

The KSA C4I Team is seeking a systems engineer to join our development team. In this role, you will:

  • Decompose customer requirements and use cases into system capabilities and functions

The KSA C4I Modernization Team is a geographically dispersed project team that will operate in an Agile Scrum environment. Team members have the opportunity to work directly with an international customer and gain exposure to the technologies and processes supporting this upgrade.

This customer environment is a unique experience for an engineer to put their stamp on drafting new system functionality with a very engaged customer in an accelerated design cycle. If the thought rapidly performing various design activities and growing your knowledge on the numerous types of systems engineering artifacts that are developed and delivered as part of design stage of a modernization upgrade project is exciting, then the KSA C4I Team is the place to be!

  • Working knowledge of Navy or USMC acquisition organizations, budgets, and requirements processes.
  • Experience supporting competitive pursuits that resulted in contract awards.

Education Perfect is an EdTech platform designed to empower educators and amplify their impact in the classroom. We help teachers personalise learning at scale through powerful learning, assessment and insights tools, supporting teachers and students to reach their full potential.

  • Are passionate about supporting teachers and improving student learning through high-quality digital resources.

The project will commence in early November and continue until mid-December 2026. We anticipate approximately 20 hours of work, with a total contract payment of $2,000 AUD.

The work will involve:

  • Curriculum alignment review: Review our History curriculum alignment across Stages 4 and 5 and recommend any changes needed (approximately 8 hours).
  • Learning pathway review: Review the existing learning pathways and recommend improvements (approximately 8 hours).
  • Prioritisation of fixes and gaps: Prepare for and participate in a collaborative session to prioritise identified gaps and improvements (approximately 2 hours).

The remaining time will allow for project preparation, collaboration and follow-up as needed.

If you’re passionate about History education and would love to help shape high-quality digital learning experiences for NSW teachers and students, we’d love to hear from you!
