jobs.title: Assistant Vice President - Pharmacy Analytics
jobs.excerpt: Who are we? Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart.
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.

People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.

What is the role?

We are seeking an Assistant Vice President (AVP), Pharmacy who will serve as a strategic pharmacy consultant supporting employer clients in the design, evaluation, and optimization of pharmacy benefit programs. This role will lead pharmacy benefit management (PBM) procurement initiatives, financial and contract analyses, market assessments, vendor evaluations, and client-facing consulting engagements, while overseeing day-to-day operations of the Pharmacy Analytics practice supporting Howden’s middle market teams. The ideal candidate will bring expertise from a PBM, health plan, pharmacy analytics, or pharmacy consulting environment and possess a strong understanding of the evolving pharmacy landscape, including specialty drugs, GLP-1 therapies, PBM pricing models, rebate strategies, financial guarantees, and emerging cost-containment solutions.

What will you be doing?

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to employer clients on pharmacy benefit strategy, plan design, and cost management opportunities.
  • Lead and support PBM market checks, renewals, procurement projects, and formal RFP processes.
  • Oversee day-to-day operations of the Pharmacy Analytics practice for Howden’s middle market teams, including workflow planning, prioritization, resource allocation, and delivery oversight.
  • Manage intake, scoping, and work assignment for PBM RFPs, rebate reconciliations, market checks, contract reviews, and other financial analyses.
  • Analyze PBM financial proposals, pricing guarantees, rebate arrangements, dispensing fees, and contractual terms.
  • Develop, maintain, and oversee claim-level and aggregate financial models used to evaluate PBM proposals, validate pricing guarantees and rebate arrangements, assess pharmacy program performance, and quantify vendor savings opportunities.
  • Establish modeling standards, documented assumptions, quality-control procedures, and peer-review processes to promote accuracy, consistency, transparency, and auditability across pharmacy analytics deliverables.
  • Interpret PBM claims, eligibility, formulary, rebate, specialty, and financial data; identify data-quality issues; and translate analytical findings into clear client recommendations and executive-level deliverables.
  • Provide strategic guidance on specialty pharmacy, biosimilars, GLP-1 medications, cell and gene therapies, and emerging market trends.
  • Review and negotiate pharmacy contract provisions and performance guarantees.
  • Prepare and present client deliverables, executive summaries, and recommendations to employer leadership teams.
  • Support finalist presentations, vendor evaluations, and implementation activities.
  • Collaborate with account teams, producers, and subject matter experts to identify growth opportunities and deliver exceptional client service.
  • Build and maintain relationships with PBMs, specialty pharmacies, clinical vendors, and other strategic partners.

What are we looking for?

Qualifications


  • 7+ years of experience in pharmacy consulting, PBM account management, PBM underwriting, pricing, trade relations, clinical strategy, or related pharmacy benefit roles.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of PBM contracting, rebate programs, pharmacy pricing methodologies, and specialty drug management.
  • Advanced pharmacy financial modeling and analytical skills, including experience building and reviewing claim-level models, evaluating PBM pricing proposals, validating contract guarantees, and working with large pharmacy claims data sets.
  • Exemplary knowledge of pharmacy analytics capabilities, methodologies, coverages, and services, including their application to PBM procurement, market checks, rebate reconciliations, contract reviews, and ongoing financial performance monitoring.
  • Thorough understanding of PBM data layouts, claims and eligibility files, contract structures, financial terms, pricing guarantees, rebate arrangements, and core pharmacy data concepts.
  • Demonstrated ability to oversee analytical workflow, prioritize competing requests, assign work effectively, review outputs, and communicate modeling assumptions, limitations, and results to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to translate complex pharmacy concepts into actionable recommendations for clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and relationship management skills.
  • Experience managing multiple projects and client deliverables in a fast-paced environment.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with pharmacy analytics and reporting tools is preferred.
  • Ability to travel periodically for client meetings, conferences, and business development opportunities.

Compensation and Benefits

The expected base salary range for this role is $150,000- $190,000; actual base salary will be determined based on factors including candidate experience and work location. This role is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA).

In addition to a competitive base salary, employees are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus. Howden also offers a variety of benefits and programs, subject to eligibility, including:


  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including healthcare savings and reimbursement accounts
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible Paid Time Off and paid parental leave
  • Life and Disability insurance

Our sustainability promise

We’re on a life-long journey to become an ever-more sustainable group. It's a commitment to taking care of our people and the world we live in, to doing good business, and to making a positive impact wherever we can. Our governance processes, company policies, and review systems are all geared towards our goal of making a positive impact in the world. You can read more about our sustainability work here.

What do we offer in return?

A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:

  • Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new

  • We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges

  • We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond

Reasonable adjustments

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs. Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.

If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.

*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Title and Summary

Director of Product Management, Freight & Logistics Payments Strategy, Global B2B TransportationOverview
Director, Freight & Logistics Payments Strategy, Global B2B Transportation will drive growth across the freight, logistics, and supply chain payments ecosystem, spanning air, sea, road, and rail. This role focuses on identifying where Mastercard's commercial products, partnerships, data capabilities, acceptance, and embedded payment solutions can create value in a complex transportation market.
Payment flows across transportation remain fragmented, moving through invoices, virtual cards, freight payment and audit workflows, ACH, checks, and specialized transportation payment providers. Success requires understanding how the key players, from shippers and carriers to freight brokers, forwarders, 3PLs, TMS platforms, and technology providers, operate and exchange value. The successful candidate will turn that knowledge into practical go-to-market strategies, partnerships, and product requirements, serving as the link between Business Development, regional and global product teams, and external partners to help Mastercard qualify opportunities and drive meaningful growth.
We are looking for someone who comes from the freight and logistics industry, provides services or solutions to this vertical, or has worked at a payments company serving freight, logistics, fleet, transportation, or supply chain clients. The ideal candidate brings a generalist mentality and strong business and technical problem-solving skills, moving easily between market strategy, client engagement, financial business cases, product requirements, and cross-functional execution.

Role - Director, Freight & Logistics Payments Strategy, Global B2B Transportation
In this role, the selected candidate will:

Industry Strategy & Market Development

•Lead Mastercard’s freight and logistics go-to-market strategy across air, sea, road, and rail.
•Identify key industry trends, customer pain points, technology shifts, and competitive dynamics that shape freight and logistics payment flows.
•Serve as the internal freight and logistics expert, developing clear narratives, use cases, and opportunity priorities by segment, market, and product fit.
Business Development Enablement
•Partner with global and regional Business Development teams to identify, qualify, and advance freight and logistics opportunities.
•Support client conversations with practical industry expertise, payment flow knowledge, and consultative guidance.
•Build enablement content that helps teams connect Mastercard products to specific freight and logistics needs.
Ecosystem & Partnership Development
•Identify strategic partnerships that expand Mastercard’s access, distribution, relevance, and acceptance across freight and logistics.
•Engage key ecosystem players including brokers, 3PLs, forwarders, carriers, shippers, TMS providers, fleet platforms, marketplaces, fintechs, and payment providers.
•Develop partnership business cases, commercial models, and execution plans that accelerate adoption of Mastercard-powered payment solutions.
Product Strategy & Innovation
•Translate freight and logistics market needs into product requirements, capability gaps, and roadmap recommendations.
•Work with global product teams to shape solutions for transportation payment use cases.
•Represent the voice of the customer and market while assessing how Mastercard capabilities apply to freight and logistics payment flows.
Commercialization & Thought Leadership
•Develop practical go-to-market plans that connect industry priorities, customer needs, partner opportunities, and Mastercard capabilities.
•Support market sizing, business cases, opportunity prioritization, and growth planning for freight and logistics payments.
•Create thought leadership, executive narratives, and customer-facing materials that show Mastercard’s understanding of transportation payments.
All About You
•Deep experience in freight, logistics, transportation, fleet, supply chain, or transportation technology.
•Strong understanding of shippers, carriers, brokers, forwarders, 3PLs, TMS platforms, freight marketplaces, and logistics providers.
•Ability to explain transportation workflows, commercial relationships, and payment challenges clearly.
•Practical knowledge of commercial payments, fleet payments, invoice payments, virtual cards, embedded payments, or transportation payment solutions.
•Likable cross-functional influencer who works well in a highly matrixed organization.
•Ability to translate fragmented payment pain points into scalable commercial opportunities.
•Comfort connecting customer needs to product capabilities, business cases, and measurable growth outcomes.
•Experience developing go-to-market strategies, market entry plans, partnership strategies, or product strategies.
•Strong analytical skills to assess market dynamics, prioritize opportunities, and build executive-ready recommendations.
•Ability to balance market insight, customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and commercial discipline.
•Clear communicator with senior leaders, customers, partners, and cross-functional teams.
•Builder mindset with the ability to define white-space opportunities and move from insight to action.
•High ownership, urgency, and commitment to quality, impact, and continuous improvement.Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. jobs.description:
Global Strategic Account Manager

About JRNI

JRNI is the enterprise platform for scheduling and managing high-value, one-to-one customer experiences — appointments, virtual and in-person consultations, events, and queuing — at global scale. Some of the world’s largest retail and financial services brands rely on JRNI to connect customers with the right expert at the right moment, turning individual interactions into measurable revenue, loyalty, and lifetime value. We serve blue-chip enterprises across multiple regions and industries, and our customers sit at the center of everything we build and every decision we make.

Role Summary

The Global Strategic Account Manager owns the growth and expansion of a portfolio of JRNI’s most important global enterprise accounts. This is a senior, quota-carrying individual-contributor role reporting directly into the CCO organization that owns Customer Expansion and Growth. You are the commercial owner of your book of business: accountable for protecting and growing recurring revenue, deepening executive relationships across complex multinational organizations, and converting customer success into commercial outcomes.

This role is for a consultative, outcome-oriented seller who thrives on long-cycle, multi-stakeholder enterprise relationships. You will act as a trusted advisor to senior business and technology leaders, orchestrate cross-functional internal teams around each account, and build multi-year expansion plans that align JRNI’s roadmap to your customers’ strategic priorities. Success is measured by net revenue retention, expansion bookings, and the durability of the partnerships you build.

Key Responsibilities

Own revenue retention and growth

  • Carry and consistently achieve a net-new expansion and renewal quota across a defined portfolio of global strategic accounts.
  • Drive net revenue retention (NRR) by protecting the existing base and expanding through cross-sell, upsell, seat and volume growth, and new use cases, regions, and business units.
  • Own the full renewal lifecycle — forecasting, negotiation, and on-time closure — protecting value while minimizing churn and contraction.

Build and execute strategic account plans

  • Develop and maintain multi-year account and territory plans that map JRNI’s capabilities and roadmap to each customer’s strategic and financial objectives.
  • Identify whitespace and build a data-driven expansion pipeline spanning additional geographies, lines of business, and product lines.
  • Lead executive business reviews (EBRs) that quantify realized value and secure sponsorship for the next phase of growth.

Cultivate executive and multi-threaded relationships

  • Establish and expand relationships with senior stakeholders — from economic buyers and C-suite sponsors to operational champions — across complex, matrixed global organizations.
  • Serve as a trusted strategic advisor, bringing industry insight, benchmarks, and a clear point of view on how enterprises create value through customer experience.
  • Navigate and multi-thread across regions and functions to reduce single-threaded risk and build durable, sponsor-backed partnerships.

Orchestrate the internal team

  • Act as the commercial quarterback for each account, aligning Customer Success, Solutions/Value Engineering, Product, Marketing, and Professional Services around a shared growth plan.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success to translate adoption, health, and value realization into commercial expansion.
  • Channel customer needs and market signals back to Product and Leadership to inform roadmap and go-to-market priorities.

Forecast, negotiate, and operate with rigor

  • Maintain accurate, timely forecasts and healthy pipeline hygiene in the CRM; deliver predictable results against monthly, quarterly, and annual targets.
  • Lead complex commercial negotiations — pricing, packaging, and multi-year contracting — in partnership with Deal Desk, Legal, and Finance.
  • Apply a structured value-selling and mutual-success-planning methodology throughout the customer lifecycle.

Success Metrics

Performance in this role is evaluated against a clear set of growth and retention outcomes:

Metric

What it measures

Net Revenue Retention (NRR)

Primary measure of growth within the assigned book of strategic accounts

Expansion / Upsell Bookings

New ARR generated through cross-sell, seat/volume growth, and new use cases

Pipeline Coverage

Qualified expansion pipeline sufficient to support quota attainment

Account Health & Adoption

Product utilization, executive engagement, and reference-ability

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of quota-carrying experience in enterprise SaaS account management, strategic/key account management, or enterprise expansion sales, with a consistent record of exceeding retention and growth targets.
  • Demonstrated success managing and growing large, global, multi-stakeholder enterprise accounts (six- and seven-figure ARR).
  • Proven ability to drive net revenue retention through renewals, upsell, and cross-sell in a recurring-revenue model.
  • Strong executive presence and consultative, value-based selling skills; able to build credibility with C-level and senior business leaders.

jobs.excerpt: 🚀 Join Our Remote Data Products & Machine Learning Startup!
jobs.description:
🚀 Join Our Remote Data Products & Machine Learning Startup! 🚀

At Muttdata, we build innovative Data Products and Machine Learning solutions that help companies solve complex business challenges. As a fast-growing, remote-first startup, we're passionate about technology, collaboration, and continuous learning.

We are looking for an analytical, curious, and business-minded Data Scientist Senior 🐶🚀 to join one of our key engagements with a leading beverage company in Mexico. You will be the go-to person for measuring what really works in growth and marketing: designing experiments, estimating causal impact, and turning the results into decisions that drive customer acquisition, retention, and revenue.

This role sits at the intersection of statistics, economics, and marketing. You will work closely with marketing, growth, and commercial stakeholders, as well as with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers, to move beyond correlations and answer questions like "Did this campaign actually cause an increase in sales?" or "Which promotions and channels deserve more budget?". A strong analytical profile, methodological rigor, and the ability to communicate findings to non-technical audiences are essential. A background in Economics (or similar quantitative fields) is highly valued.

🚀 What We Do

  • Leveraging our expertise, we build modern Machine Learning systems for demand planning and budget forecasting.
  • Developing scalable data infrastructures, we enhance high-level decision-making, tailored to each client.
  • Offering comprehensive Data Engineering and custom AI solutions, we optimize cloud-based systems.
  • Using Generative AI, we help e-commerce platforms and retailers create higher-quality ads, faster.
  • Building deep learning models, we enhance visual recognition and automation for various industries, improving product categorization, quality control, and information retrieval.
  • Developing recommendation models, we personalize user experiences in e-commerce, streaming, and digital platforms, driving engagement and conversions.

🌟 Our Partnerships

  • Amazon Web Services
  • Astronomer
  • Databricks

🌟 Our Values

  • 📊 We are Data Nerds
  • 🤗 We are Open Team Players
  • 🚀 We Take Ownership
  • 🌟 We Have a Positive Mindset
    • 🔍 Curious about what we’re up to? Check out our case studies and dive into our blog post to learn more about our culture and the exciting projects we’re working on! 🚀

Responsibilities 🤓

  • Design, run, and analyze A/B tests and multivariate experiments (sample size and power calculations, randomization, guardrail metrics, interpretation of results).
  • Apply causal inference techniques (Difference-in-Differences, Synthetic Control, Propensity Score Matching, Instrumental Variables, Regression Discontinuity, uplift modeling) to estimate the impact of marketing campaigns, promotions, pricing, and loyalty initiatives when randomization is not possible.
  • Measure and optimize marketing performance: incrementality, attribution, ROI/ROAS, customer lifetime value (CLV), and marketing mix modeling (MMM).
  • Translate business questions from growth and marketing teams into well-defined analytical problems and experimental designs.
  • Develop analyses, features, and models on Databricks (notebooks, Spark, Delta Lake), collaborating with Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers on data pipelines and analytical datasets.
  • Build predictive and segmentation models (churn, propensity, customer segmentation) that support targeting and personalization strategies.

Required Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in Data Science, Applied Statistics, Econometrics, or similar analytical roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks (notebooks, Spark/PySpark, Delta Lake) – required.
  • Solid, hands-on experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and online/offline experiments.
  • Strong knowledge of causal inference methods and their assumptions, limitations, and practical application (DiD, Synthetic Control, Matching, IV, uplift, etc.).
  • Strong foundations in statistics and econometrics (hypothesis testing, regression, Bayesian and frequentist approaches, time series).
  • Proficiency in Python (pandas, PySpark, statsmodels, scikit-learn) and advanced SQL.
  • Experience applying data science to growth, marketing, or commercial problems (campaign measurement, pricing, promotions, customer analytics).

Nice to Have Skills 😉

  • Degree in Economics, Econometrics, Statistics, or related quantitative fields (ideally with a focus on applied microeconomics or causal inference).
  • Experience in CPG, retail, consumer goods, or beverage industries.
  • Experience with Marketing Mix Modeling (e.g., Meridian, Robyn, PyMC-Marketing) and media attribution.
  • Experience with causal libraries (DoWhy, EconML, CausalML) and Bayesian modeling (PyMC, Stan).
  • Experience with MLflow and Databricks workflows/jobs.

🎁 Perks

  • 🌍 Remote-first culture – work from anywhere!
  • 🚀 In-Company English Lessons.
  • 💪 Wellhub or sports club stipend to stay active
  • 🚀 AWS, DBT, Google Cloud, Azure & Databricks certifications fully covered

  • Provide technical medical expertise and support to the Benefit Claims analysts through thorough review of claims to include evaluation and analysis of provider medical records, test results and course of treatment. Provide timely consultations with the analysts and identify when additional medical information is needed.
  • Clearly communicate the disability claim assessment, rationale and recommendation with medical directors, outside consulting physicians and analysts regarding insured’s medical condition, clinical medical findings, significance of and support for claimed limitations, appropriateness of treatment and alternatives, expected duration of claim, and potential for rehabilitation or return to work.

  • A minimum of 5-8 years of professional experience preferably in critical care nursing, medical-surgical nursing or orthopedic nursing with a bachelor’s degree in nursing
  • A minimum of 5-8 years of professional experience as a physician’s assistant or nurse practitioner and associated bachelor/master’s degree
  • Consistent critical decision-making skills and flexibility in all aspects of work

  • Superior written and verbal communication skills.
  • Flexibility and willingness to change as job duties change

Skills You Have

jobs.excerpt: COMPANY OVERVIEW: Founded in 1989, United Automobile Insurance Company is an innovative and established organization looking for a Litigation Adjuster – Property Damage and Bodily Injury to join our team.
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW:

Founded in 1989, United Automobile Insurance Company is an innovative and established organization looking for a Litigation Adjuster – Property Damage and Bodily Injury to join our team. Family-owned, UAIC, is one of the largest privately held property and casualty insurance companies in the United States. The key to our growth and success is a commitment to providing quality service to our agents and customers, by providing disciplined underwriting, and strategic claims handling. Our ongoing efforts to invest substantial resources in personnel and technology are the foundation of our promise of assuring maximum efficiency and specialized operations in the industry. We are proud that our independent agents and customers have recognized our dedication by making UAIC the market leader in every state where we conduct business.

SCOPE:

The Liability Litigation Adjuster is responsible for the handling, investigation, evaluation, and resolution of auto liability claims in litigation, including attorney-represented claims involvingproperty damage andbodily injury. This role requires strong technical claim handling, litigation management, and negotiation skills to ensure timely, cost-effective claim resolution while maintaining compliance with state regulations.
Ideal candidates will bring at least 3+ years of progressive litigation claims handling        experience, with depth in PD, BI, , and the ability to manage claims with minimal         supervision.

This position offers a remote work arrangement, allowing the ideal candidate to work from their preferred location within the Southeast region.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage a pending of litigated auto liability claims from assignment through resolution
  • Investigate and evaluate coverage, liability, damages, and exposure
  • Handle attorney-represented claims, including responding to demands, discovery, and negotiations
  • Evaluate and adjust property damage claims (primary focus) and bodily injury claims (preferred exposure)
  • Partner with defense counsel to develop litigation strategy and monitor case progress
  • Attend mediations, settlement conferences, and trials (as needed)
  • Set and manage accurate reserves based on claim evaluation
  • Review medical records, repair estimates, and expert reports to assess damages
  • Ensure compliance with Florida and Texas claims handling regulations
  • Negotiate settlements within authority and escalate high-exposure claims appropriately
  • Maintain detailed file documentation in accordance with company and regulatory standards
  • Collaborate with SIU, underwriting, and subrogation teams when applicable

Required Qualifications
  • Minimum 3 years of experience handling automobile liability claims, with demonstrated experience in litigated property damage (PD), bodily injury (BI claims (combined or individually).
  • Strong, hands‑on experience managing complex PD claims, including total losses, evaluations, and third‑party liability.
  • Proven experience handling attorney‑represented, escalated, or disputed claims, including active litigation files.
  • Solid understanding of coverage analysis, liability determination, negligence principles, and damages assessment.
  • Ability to independently manage a litigated or high‑exposure BI/PD caseload in compliance with internal guidelines and regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrated negotiation, settlement, and conflict‑resolution skills, including experience negotiating with attorneys.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft clear claim notes, position letters, and settlement documentation.
  • Active adjuster license in Florida and/or Texas.
  • Strong organizational and time‑management skills, with the ability to prioritize in a fast‑paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications
  • Direct experience handling litigated property damage (third party) and bodily injury claims, including soft tissue, complex injuries, and exposure analysis.
  • Prior litigation claims handling experience, including working with defense counsel, discovery, evaluations, and settlement authority recommendations.
  • Familiarity with non‑standard auto insurance environment.
  • Experience with claims management systems such as Guidewire, or similar platforms.
  • Experience participating in mediations, arbitrations, or settlement conferences.
  • Knowledge of state‑specific statutes, thresholds, and tort environments (Florida and/or Texas preferred).


EDUCATION:
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience
  • Bilingual preferred.
  • Adjusters license required.

BENEFITS:
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with employer match.
  • Comprehensive Medical, Prescription Drug, Vision, and Dental Insurance
  • Paid Time Off, Holidays, and Leave programs.
  • Flexible spending accounts
  • Basic Life Insurance and Voluntary Life/ADD
  • Short Term and Long-Term Disability

All employment decisions at UAIC are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, or belief, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate.

jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks a Senior Database and Application Support Engineer to support database availability, application operations, service restoration, component upgrades, and recovery validation for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Senior Database and Application Support Engineer to support database availability, application operations, service restoration, component upgrades, and recovery validation for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

The Database and Application Support Engineer will diagnose database outages, application dependencies, connection failures, unavailable services, certificate problems, and API-related issues. This role will support troubleshooting and restoration across database, application, middleware, server, network, cloud, and security components.

The engineer will coordinate operational response with Task 4 enterprise IT teams and work with Task 7 software-development teams when resolution requires application-code analysis or correction. The role will focus on production support, infrastructure integration, recovery, and technical coordination rather than serving as the primary application developer.

This position is remote, with a preference for candidates located in the Chicago area. After-hours work may be required during outages, deployments, maintenance windows, upgrades, and recovery activities.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Database and Application Support Engineer will:

  • Monitor and support the availability, performance, health, and recoverability of enterprise databases and applications.
  • Diagnose database availability issues, failed services, connection failures, authentication problems, resource constraints, and performance degradation.
  • Analyze application dependencies across databases, servers, services, middleware, APIs, certificates, networks, cloud platforms, storage, and external interfaces.
  • Troubleshoot database listeners, connection strings, connection pools, ports, drivers, service accounts, permissions, and network paths.
  • Investigate failed database connections, application timeouts, unavailable services, transaction errors, and data-access issues.
  • Review database, application, middleware, operating-system, web-server, API, and network logs to isolate faults.
  • Use monitoring data, metrics, traces, alerts, logs, and event records to identify the source and scope of service disruptions.
  • Diagnose certificate expiration, trust-chain, hostname, binding, private-key, protocol, and encryption-related failures.
  • Support installation, renewal, replacement, validation, and troubleshooting of certificates used by applications, databases, APIs, and supporting services.
  • Diagnose REST, SOAP, API gateway, endpoint, authentication, authorization, payload, timeout, and connectivity failures.
  • Validate dependencies among APIs, backend services, databases, certificates, identity providers, and network controls.
  • Support administration and troubleshooting of relational database platforms used within the enterprise environment.
  • Support application servers, web servers, middleware, schedulers, integration services, background services, and supporting runtime components.
  • Participate in Outage Response Team activities involving database or application degradation and service outages.
  • Provide technical diagnosis, mitigation options, workarounds, recovery actions, restoration support, and service validation.
  • Maintain detailed incident timelines covering symptoms, technical findings, actions, decisions, dependencies, communications, and restoration results.
  • Escalate complex issues to database administrators, application owners, senior engineers, vendors, cloud providers, or development teams.
  • Coordinate with Task 4 enterprise operations teams on infrastructure, server, network, cloud, storage, certificate, identity, and platform issues.
  • Coordinate with Task 7 software-development teams when incidents require application-code review, defect correction, build changes, or software releases.
  • Provide logs, traces, error details, reproduction steps, configuration information, and impact assessments to development teams.
  • Validate that application-code corrections resolve the operational issue without introducing new availability or integration problems.
  • Support development of temporary workarounds or contingency measures when complete restoration cannot be achieved immediately.
  • Support root-cause analysis and document technical causes, contributing factors, dependencies, corrective actions, and preventive recommendations.
  • Track post-incident corrective and preventive actions through completion.
  • Support database, application, middleware, server, and appliance component upgrades and refreshes.
  • Develop or execute implementation plans, upgrade procedures, test steps, validation criteria, rollback procedures, and outage contingencies.
  • Coordinate approved maintenance, patching, configuration changes, migrations, and component replacements.
  • Perform pre-implementation and post-implementation validation of database and application availability, connectivity, functionality, and performance.
  • Support backup, restoration, replication, failover, failback, high availability, and disaster-recovery capabilities.
  • Validate database and application recovery following outages, maintenance, migrations, restorations, or continuity events.
  • Test service dependencies and end-to-end transaction paths after recovery.
  • Support capacity, performance, availability, and resource-utilization analysis.
  • Identify recurring failures, dependency risks, obsolete components, certificate risks, and potential points of failure.
  • Apply or coordinate approved operating-system, database, middleware, application, vendor, firmware, and security updates.
  • Support remediation of vulnerabilities, IAVAs, CND Directives, POA&M items, and security-control deficiencies.
  • Follow approved incident, problem, change, configuration, release, availability, and service-continuity processes.
  • Maintain database and application dependency diagrams, interface records, certificate inventories, configuration documentation, recovery procedures, standard operating procedures, and troubleshooting guides.
  • Recommend improvements that increase database and application availability, resilience, performance, recoverability, security, and supportability.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 8 years of relevant database support, application support, systems engineering, production operations, or enterprise IT experience.
  • Demonstrated experience diagnosing database availability, application dependencies, connection failures, services, certificates, and API-related outages.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting enterprise databases and applications in a federal or Department of Defense environment.
  • Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle Database, PostgreSQL, MySQL, AWS relational database services, Azure SQL, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience with database clustering, replication, backup, restoration, failover, high availability, and disaster recovery.
  • Experience supporting application servers, middleware, web servers, integration platforms, schedulers, and background services.
  • Experience with Microsoft Internet Information Services, Apache, Tomcat, WebLogic, JBoss, .NET, Java, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience troubleshooting REST, SOAP, API gateway, authentication, authorization, payload, timeout, and endpoint-connectivity issues.
  • Experience managing or troubleshooting TLS certificates, trust stores, keystores, certificate bindings, and Public Key Infrastructure dependencies.
  • Experience using application-performance monitoring, database monitoring, logging, tracing, observability, and event-management tools.
  • Experience supporting production outages, incident bridges, service restoration, root-cause analysis, and corrective-action tracking.
  • Experience coordinating operational issues between infrastructure engineers, database administrators, application owners, and software-development teams.
  • Experience providing logs, traces, reproduction steps, technical findings, and impact information to developers for code-level correction.
  • Experience validating component upgrades, software releases, database changes, application fixes, and recovery procedures.
  • Experience applying DISA STIGs and supporting DoD RMF, ATO, IAVA, CND Directive, vulnerability-remediation, and POA&M requirements.
  • Experience using ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM platform for incident, problem, change, configuration, and release management.
  • Familiarity with PowerShell, Python, SQL, Bash, or other scripting and query languages used for diagnostics and automation.
  • Database, cloud, middleware, application-server, or ITIL certifications.
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, communication, and cross-team coordination skills.
  • Ability to support after-hours outages, deployments, maintenance windows, upgrades, and recovery activities when required.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. jobs.description:
Full-Time, W2 Position

Wilmington, DE or Remote

Open to candidates based in DC, VA, MD, DE, PA, NJ or OH

Who We Are

Blackwell HR is a woman-founded human resources third party and consulting group based in Wilmington, Delaware, serving clients across the US.

With a focus on small to medium-sized businesses and nonprofits, our team of experienced HR professionals partner with clients across a variety of industries and business communities to develop and implement HR and solutions that allow business leaders to focus on achieving their mission and fully engage their teams.

We believe in operating with innovation, exercising compassion, being engaged with our clients, and delivering exceptional results. We live our values every day in the work we do with our clients, our community, and our team.

What You'll Do

You'll support 6-8 different clients rather than being immersed in just one company. You'll get exposure to different industries, business challenges, and HR needs while working alongside experienced HR professionals who can offer guidance and support.

You'll have meaningful ownership of your work, from processing payroll and administering benefits to preparing HR documentation, supporting employee relations, and helping clients improve their processes. You'll also have opportunities to build your client-facing skills and expand your HR knowledge as you grow.

  • Support client relationships: Serve as a point of contact for routine HR questions, respond to client needs, and partner with HR Principals on more complex situations.
  • Process payroll: Manage payroll processing for assigned clients, including multi-state employees and 1099 contractors, time and attendance, payroll deductions, tax-related requirements, and pre- and post-payroll reporting.
  • Administer benefits: Coordinate benefits enrollment and ongoing administration, process employee changes, troubleshoot routine issues, and escalate complex questions when needed.
  • Document document document: Create and maintain employee communications, policies, procedures, notices, and other HR documents that are accurate, clear, and appropriate for each client.
  • Support employee relations: Help clients navigate routine employee questions and workplace matters, recognizing when a situation requires additional guidance from an HR Principal.
  • Assist with projects: Support initiatives such as recruiting, onboarding, performance management, employee engagement, and other client HR programs.
  • Maintain HR systems and records: Keep employee information, HRIS data, benefits records, and documentation organized, accurate, and up to date.
  • Improve how work gets done: Identify opportunities to make recurring processes more efficient, recommend improvements, and help implement better ways of working.

Who Are You?

You're a hands-on HR professional who enjoys variety and takes pride in getting the details right. You may have worked as part of a small HR team or in a generalist role where you had to be resourceful, learn quickly, and manage a range of responsibilities.

You're comfortable working independently on established processes and routine HR matters, but you also recognize when a situation calls for additional guidance. You communicate clearly, follow through on commitments, and understand that clients depend on you to be responsive, accurate, and professional.

You don't need to know every answer immediately. You do need to be willing to ask good questions, find answers, and take ownership of getting the work done.

  • 3+ years of HR experience, preferably in an HR generalist, HR operations, or client-facing role.
  • Experience supporting a small business, nonprofit, startup, or lean HR team is a plus.
  • Working knowledge of core HR functions, such as payroll, benefits administration, employee documentation, onboarding, recruiting, and employee relations.
  • Hands-on experience with payroll processing and HRIS systems. Experience with platforms such as ADP, Paycom, Paylocity, Workday, Gusto, Rippling, or similar systems is a plus.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy, confidentiality, and follow-through.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with employees, managers, and senior leaders.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple clients, deadlines, and priorities.
  • Comfort working independently in a remote environment while collaborating with a team.
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and experience preferred.

What We Offer

  • Full-time, W2 position with a base salary range of $70,000-$78,000
  • Full benefits package + 401(k) match
  • Four weeks PTO plus holidays
  • Fully remote work environment with culture-building events twice annually
  • Collaborative, low-ego team culture driven by our values: Determination, Integrity, Service Driven, Teamwork, and Innovation
If you're the person who enjoys keeping things organized, solving problems, and making sure the details don't fall through the cracks, this role offers the opportunity to put those strengths to work across a variety of organizations.

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Sr Associate Software Engineer – Applied AI

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will join a fun, innovative Applied AI team within the AI & Data Science (AI&D) organization at Amgen.

As a Sr Associate Software Engineer, you will be an integral member of the Applied AI – AI Productivity/Custom GPT Solutions Practice team, which empowers Amgen teams and staff members to build high‑value, purpose‑driven, LLM-powered AI Assistants and/or Custom GPTs through expert design and development support. You will play a key role in driving adoption of this program across multiple Amgen organizations by partnering with cross‑functional teams and senior leaders. This role requires strong technical depth, adaptability, and the ability to operate effectively in a fast‑evolving environment.

The primary responsibility of this role is to design, develop, and deploy secure, scalable, and intuitive AI agents, Custom GPTs and associated AI capabilities on leading enterprise AI platforms and tools.

Responsibilities:

GenAI/AI Delivery:

  • Design, develop, and deploy LLM-powered Agents and/or Custom GPTs on ChatGPT Enterprise platform that leverage RAG pipelines, Apps integration and prompt engineering.
  • Contribute to the capability Roadmap through implementation of MCP-based Apps, ChatGPT Skills, Plugins and Workspace Agents.
  • Implement scalable RAG pipelines that ground assistant responses in trusted enterprise data.
  • Build integration layers and event-driven orchestrations using N8N (webhooks, nodes, APIs) to connect systems, trigger agent workflows, and implement human-in-the-loop steps.
  • Evaluate emerging AI models, enterprise platforms, agent frameworks, retrieval technologies, and orchestration patterns, including OpenAI, Databricks, LangChain/LangGraph, and AWS AI services.
  • Ensure compliance with data privacy, security, and regulatory standards of the company.
  • Implement automated evaluation, regression testing, tracing, and monitoring to assess retrieval quality, context, response quality, safety, latency, and cost.
  • Apply relevant advancements in generative AI, agentic systems, retrieval, evaluation, and AI software engineering to continuously improve solution quality and delivery practices.

Collaboration & Enablement:

  • Work closely with functional teams, product owners, data engineers, platform and DevOps teams, and business SMEs to translate requirements into reliable, production-grade solutions.
  • Produce clear technical design documents, runbooks, and handover materials to support operational sustainability.
  • Support office hours and other technical enablement sessions.
  • Support junior engineers and contribute towards technical guidance, reusable patterns, and engineering best practices for GenAI adoption

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The professional we seek is a person with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications

  • Master’s degree with 4+ years of experience in Computer Science, IT, or a related field, OR
  • Bachelor’s degree with 6+ years of experience in Computer Science, IT, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience in software development and system design.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building & deploying Generative AI applications, Assistants or Custom GPTs in production centered around OpenAI(preferred), Claude or Gemini.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience designing and building cloud-native solutions (preferably on AWS using services like Amazon Bedrock, AWS Lambda, Amazon EKS)
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with vector databases, embedding models, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience designing and implementing secure RESTful integrations using API gateways, OAuth, service identities, and enterprise authentication patterns.
  • Experience effectively using AI-assisted software development tools such as OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, and GitHub Copilot while applying appropriate code-review, security, and quality controls.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience building modern web applications using TypeScript, React, and Next.js, with strong knowledge of component-driven architecture, design systems, REST/GraphQL integration, state management, automated testing, performance optimization, and modern CI/CD practices.
  • Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with GenAI libraries (Transformers, LangChain, Hugging Face, etc.).
  • Ability to work effectively with global, distributed teams using Scaled Agile methodologies.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills and the ability to perform effectively in a fast‑paced environment.

Preferred Skills:

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • High degree of initiative and self‑motivation, with a servant‑leadership mindset.
  • Ability to work under minimal supervision while delivering high‑quality outcomes.
  • Excellent analytical, gap, and fit‑assessment skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully.
  • Team‑oriented, with a strong focus on achieving shared goals.
  • Experience working with Power Automate, Uipath, Tableau, JIRA, and Smartsheet.
  • 2+ years of experience with Agentic AI platforms and frameworks (Langchain, AWS Bedrock, Uipath Maestro).
  • Familiarity with GxP environments and systems validation.
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as biotech or healthcare.

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers competitive and comprehensive Total Rewards Plans that are aligned with local industry standards.

Apply now and make a lasting impact with the Amgen team.

careers.amgen.com

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.

jobs.description:
Job title: Medical Science Liaison Rhinology – New England

  • Location: Remote, US

About the job


The Medical Science Liaison (MSL) is a field-facing role that serves as a trusted scientific partner to key external experts, conducting frequent scientific exchanges to enhance understanding of Sanofi's products. The MSL executes stakeholder engagement plans to gather insights that inform medical strategies and future research, while staying current on therapeutic developments to identify research opportunities and support evidence generation.


This role involves recognizing and sharing insights about patient and healthcare provider needs, maintaining effective communication with internal stakeholders across Medical Affairs and Commercial Operations, and ensuring full compliance with company, industry, legal, and regulatory requirements through excellent governance and risk management.


Join the engine of Sanofi’s mission — where deep immunoscience meets bold, AI-powered research. In R&D, you’ll drive breakthroughs that could turn the impossible into possible for millions.

About Sanofi:


We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world and are supported and enhanced through our diverse portfolio of medical device and diagnostic products. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Main Responsibilities:


1. Scientific Engagement: Conduct one-on-one and group interactions with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and healthcare stakeholders, sharing medical/scientific information about products and disease management within regulatory guidelines.

2. Stakeholder Mapping & Strategy: Identify, profile, and prioritize ~50 stakeholders using the Scientific Engagement Model; develop territory and individual engagement plans aligned with Medical Affairs strategy.

3. Relationship Building: Establish long-term peer relationships with KOLs, payers, and HCPs by demonstrating strong clinical knowledge and articulating the medical value of Sanofi products.

4. Congress & Event Presence: Attend scientific congresses, symposia, and organize educational meetings or advisory boards to establish Sanofi's medical presence in the field.

5. Medical Information Support: Respond to unsolicited requests for medical information on products and disease states; support speaker training for continued scientific education.

6. Insight Generation: Gather feedback from stakeholder interactions, critically evaluate published studies, and report insights that inform Sanofi's medical strategies, messages, and product development.

7. Internal Collaboration: Share scientific information and external insights with Medical Affairs, Commercial Operations, Regulatory, and other internal teams while ensuring compliance with company and regulatory policies.

8. Evidence Generation Support: Identify clinical trial sites, monitor disease epidemiology, support protocol development, and facilitate investigator-sponsored study (ISS) submissions through approved processes.

9. Healthcare Policy Awareness: Understand healthcare policies, guidelines, and clinical practices at local, state, and national levels as they relate to the therapeutic area.

10. Independent Operation & Compliance: Work remotely with minimal supervision, travel nationally/internationally as needed, and maintain strict regulatory boundaries between non-promotional medical activities and commercial operations.

About you


Basic Qualifications


  • Advanced degree in a technical, scientific or medical field (MD, PhD, Pharm D preferred) or other Relevant Life Science degree (RN/MS/PA/NP)
  • Must reside in territory. This position will cover the West territory— currently including New York, Vermont, New Hampshire, Maine, Massachusetts, Rhode Island, and Connecticut (subject to change). Candidate must live within the territory near a major airport with flight availably to adequately cover the territory and necessary travel.
  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in pharmaceutical industry, Medical Science Liaison role, or relevant clinical practice. Additional years of experience are an asset. MSL experience strongly preferred.
  • Candidates with relevant Immunology clinical experience consisting of Rhinology, Otolaryngology and/or Allergy may be considered.
  • Clear understanding of medical practice, clinical decision making, and healthcare systems related to patient care.
  • Ability to interpret key scientific data and translate this information to meet educational and research needs.
  • Demonstrated ability to address educational and research needs through delivery of cutting edge scientific/evidenced based data.
  • Understand the design and execution of research studies.
  • Exemplary communication and presentation skills.
  • Experience in working on multi-disciplinary teams and managing significant volume of projects.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record and ability to pass a complete background check.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Actively listens to others and is adept at confidently stating expert opinion while respecting the positions of others - can exert diplomacy while standing firm on a position.
  • Utilizes effective, professional communications to cultivate strong working relationships with internal and external colleagues, flexible in own approach to people and situations.
  • Skillfully plans, prioritizes, and executes multiple responsibilities and projects.
  • Demonstrates effective leadership skills (by example and through accomplishments), steps forward to handle challenges within scope of authority.
  • Deep understanding and knowledge of local regulations and codes of practice for pharmaceutical industry, in particular as they apply to the non-promotional activities of this role.
  • Demonstrates scientific expertise - stays abreast of data, treatment trends, and new information in the profession and ability to articulate therapeutic knowledge and translate expert feedback into appropriate insights.
  • Knowledge of relevant healthcare systems, the evolving medical landscape, regulatory and payer environment, public health and industry trends.
  • Proficiency in digital tools.

Why choose us?

  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Be part of a pioneering biopharma company that engages patients early in drug development and uses their insights to design studies that reflect real-world needs.
  • Help improve the lives of millions of people globally by making drug development quicker and more effective.
  • Work at the forefront of drug discovery, harnessing cutting-edge AI, data, and digital platforms to push the boundaries of science.

jobs.title: Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analyst (Senior)
jobs.excerpt: OverviewDecisionPoint seeks two Senior Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analysts to provide experienced customer-facing technical support for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.
jobs.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks two Senior Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analysts to provide experienced customer-facing technical support for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. These positions receive and assess incidents and service requests, resolve approved first-contact and Tier 2 issues, maintain complete ticket records, confirm service restoration, and escalate potential outage signals.

Senior Analysts handle complex or high-priority cases within the Tier 1/2 support scope and provide technical guidance to less-experienced service-desk personnel. They help ensure that tickets are accurately prioritized, thoroughly documented, resolved through approved procedures, and escalated to the appropriate technical team when necessary.

The Senior Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analysts support issues involving computer hardware, software, operating systems, networks, telecommunications, websites, portals, user access, audio-visual equipment, and enterprise connectivity. They work closely with service-desk leadership, field support, network and systems administrators, cybersecurity personnel, application teams, engineering teams, and Government stakeholders.

These positions are remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred. Analysts must be able to work assigned shifts and support after-hours, weekend, holiday, or surge coverage when required.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Senior Tier 1/2 Service Desk Analyst will:

  • Serve as an experienced initial point of contact for USMEPCOM users requiring technical support.
  • Receive incidents and service requests through approved telephone, email, website, self-service, monitoring, and escalation channels.
  • Create complete and accurate ServiceNow records for incidents, requests, problems, customer contacts, and technical actions.
  • Verify customer identity, contact information, location, affected service, operational impact, urgency, and relevant equipment or system information.
  • Categorize, prioritize, assign, route, and track incidents and requests in accordance with approved procedures.
  • Resolve approved first-contact issues using established diagnostic procedures, scripts, knowledge articles, known-error information, and remote-support tools.
  • Provide Tier 1 and authorized Tier 2 support for computer hardware, software, operating systems, networks, telecommunications, websites, portals, system access, audio-visual equipment, and connectivity.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex end-user incidents within the authorized Tier 1/2 support scope.
  • Troubleshoot laptops, desktops, zero clients, thin clients, mobile devices, printers, peripherals, and related equipment.
  • Diagnose LAN, WAN, VPN, wireless, internet, remote-access, circuit, and general network-connectivity problems.
  • Support approved user-account, password, authentication, and access-management activities.
  • Troubleshoot email, collaboration, browser, productivity software, and enterprise-application issues.
  • Provide remote technical support and guide users through approved diagnostic, recovery, and restoration procedures.
  • Apply approved workarounds when a permanent resolution is not immediately available.
  • Determine when an incident requires field support, system administration, network, application, cybersecurity, engineering, vendor, or other specialized assistance.
  • Escalate incidents that exceed the analyst’s authority, technical capability, service-level target, or approved support scope.
  • Identify and immediately escalate potential outage signals, including multiple related incidents, widespread connectivity failures, significant service degradation, or loss of mission-critical functionality.
  • Document initial outage symptoms, affected users and locations, business impact, start time, troubleshooting actions, and available technical evidence.
  • Support SEV 1 and SEV 2 incident response by maintaining accurate ticket information and providing requested technical details.
  • Monitor assigned tickets and maintain current status, troubleshooting notes, communications, escalations, dependencies, and resolution information.
  • Retain ownership of assigned incidents through resolution, approved reassignment, or formal escalation.
  • Communicate status, expected next steps, known workarounds, delays, escalation actions, and restoration information to customers.
  • Confirm with customers that service has been restored and verify satisfaction before closing tickets.
  • Ensure closed tickets include accurate resolution notes, applicable knowledge references, closure codes, and customer confirmation.
  • Reopen or re-escalate incidents when restoration is incomplete, a workaround fails, or the issue recurs.
  • Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to Journeyman and less-experienced service-desk analysts.
  • Review complex tickets and recommend appropriate troubleshooting, escalation, or assignment actions.
  • Assist service-desk leadership with queue monitoring, backlog reduction, priority-ticket management, and workload balancing.
  • Support shift handoffs by communicating open priority tickets, outages, VIP issues, escalations, pending actions, and operational risks.
  • Provide experienced support for VIP, executive, and other high-priority incidents and requests.
  • Identify recurring incidents, ineffective workarounds, missing knowledge, and emerging service problems.
  • Recommend new or revised knowledge articles, troubleshooting procedures, automated resolutions, service-catalog content, or process improvements.
  • Contribute incident history, technical evidence, business impact, workarounds, and resolution information to problem-management activities.
  • Support the development and review of known-error records and reusable technical guidance.
  • Perform ticket-quality reviews when assigned and identify documentation, categorization, escalation, or resolution deficiencies.
  • Help reinforce consistent ticket documentation, customer communication, and escalation practices across the service desk.
  • Follow approved incident, request, access, problem, knowledge, escalation, security, and customer-communication processes.
  • Protect sensitive, personal, operational, and Government information during all support activities.
  • Meet established response, update, escalation, and resolution targets.
  • Provide ticket, queue, incident, outage, and customer-support data for operational dashboards and program reporting.
  • Participate in technical training, readiness activities, process reviews, and continual service-improvement initiatives.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must meet all of the following requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Associate’s degree in information technology or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Minimum of six years of relevant experience providing enterprise service-desk, help-desk, desktop-support, end-user support, or related technical services.
  • Experience receiving, documenting, troubleshooting, resolving, and escalating technical incidents and service requests.
  • Experience resolving complex Tier 1 or Tier 2 technical-support issues.
  • Experience using an enterprise ticketing or IT service-management platform.
  • Working knowledge of computer hardware, operating systems, productivity software, user accounts, networks, remote access, and common enterprise applications.
  • Ability to recognize and escalate potential outages and other mission-impacting incidents.
  • Ability to maintain complete, accurate, and timely ticket documentation.
  • Ability to communicate technical instructions clearly to users with different levels of technical knowledge.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance to less-experienced service-desk personnel.
  • Strong customer-service, communication, organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work assigned shifts and support after-hours, weekend, holiday, or surge coverage when required.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • CompTIA A+ certification.
  • CompTIA Network+ certification.
  • ITIL v4 Foundation certification.
  • CompTIA Security+ certification.
  • Experience using ServiceNow.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense users.
  • Experience working in a multi-tier enterprise service-desk environment.
  • Experience providing technical guidance, peer mentoring, or shift-lead support.
  • Experience supporting geographically dispersed or remote users.
  • Experience supporting a 24/7/365 operational environment.
  • Experience supporting VIP or executive users.
  • Experience supporting SEV 1 and SEV 2 incidents.
  • Familiarity with ITIL incident, request, problem, knowledge, access, and service-level management practices.
  • Experience using remote-support, endpoint-management, directory-services, or knowledge-management tools.
  • Experience identifying incident trends or contributing to known-error, root-cause, and problem-management activities.

Skills and Competencies

  • Advanced customer-facing technical support.
  • Complex Tier 1/2 troubleshooting and problem isolation.
  • Clear verbal and written communication.
  • Accurate ticket and incident documentation.
  • Incident prioritization, routing, and escalation.
  • Hardware, software, account, and network troubleshooting.
  • Outage recognition and rapid escalation.
  • Peer guidance and technical mentoring.
  • Queue, priority, and workload awareness.
  • Ability to follow approved procedures and knowledge content.
  • Ability to manage multiple tickets and changing operational priorities.
  • Professionalism when assisting frustrated, senior, or time-sensitive customers.
  • Strong attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with remote and specialized technical teams.

Our Equal Employment Opportunity Policy

  • EEO and Affirmative Action Policy: DecisionPoint Corporation is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.
  • Pay Transparency Policy: In accordance with Presidential Executive Order 13665, DecisionPoint Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor's legal duty to furnish information.
  • Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information: By expressing your interest and submitting your resume for this position, you authorize DecisionPoint Corporation to share your resume, as well as personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should DecisionPoint Corporation. or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.
