jobs.description:
Why NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture:

At NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, we are redefining the future of business through the power of AI and groundbreaking technologies like Agentforce. As a trusted leader in AI, AWS, and Salesforce innovation, we craft intelligent solutions—integrating Salesforce Einstein, Service Cloud Voice, Amazon Connect, Agentforce and more—to revolutionize workflows, elevate customer experiences, and deliver tangible results. From conversational AI to predictive analytics, we empower organizations to stay ahead in an ever-evolving digital landscape with cutting-edge, tailored strategies.

We are proud to be creating the future of generative AI and AI agents. Salesforce has launched Agentforce, and NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture, was selected as the only partner for the private beta prior to launch. Post-launch, we’ve earned the distinction of being Salesforce’s #1 partner for Agentforce, reinforcing our role as pioneers in this transformative space.

Be part of the NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture journey and help shape the next wave of AI-powered transformation. Here, you’ll collaborate with trailblazing experts who are passionate about pushing boundaries and leveraging technologies like Agentforce to create impactful customer outcomes. Whether you're developing advanced AI-powered bots, streamlining business operations, or building solutions using the latest generative AI technologies, your work will drive innovation at scale. If you’re ready to make your mark in the AI space, NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture is the place for you.

AS AN AWS TECHNICAL ARCHITECT, YOU WILL HAVE THE OPPORTUNITY TO:

  • Ensure customer success in building and launching Amazon Connect solutions for NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture customers
  • Conduct technology assessment and audits to identify the need (from an ROI and Outcomes perspective) to move to CCaaS AWS Connect Platform, improving agent experience and productivity
  • Facilitate business process reviews to identify customer requirements and processes
  • Educate customers on the value proposition of AWS, and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud
  • Lead discovery for customers, help customers build ROIs for projects, and deliver presentations and estimate for delivering that ROI
  • Translate customer requirements into contact center design, leveraging best practices, and other AWS Services
  • Oversee and mentor technical teams, providing guidance and support to ensure that proposed solution (on Salesforce and AWS Cloud) is delivered on time, on budget, and to the required quality standards
  • Act as a liaison between technical teams and business stakeholders, communicating technical concepts in a clear and understandable manner, and managing expectations and priorities
  • Drive best practice contact center design into each and every aspect of solution delivery
  • Effectively manage all aspects of project and customer communications
  • Deliver customer end user training and documentation
  • Exercise independent judgment, and take the lead role on enterprise level projects with minimal direction from senior management
  • Lead vision and strategy discussions with contact center and customer service leadership and management

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Customer-facing contact center experience
  • Experience building integrations across WFM, CRM, and contact center solutions
  • Experience with communications protocols and APIs such as WebRTC and SIP
  • Experience with hands-on Scripting/coding (e.g., python, java, c#, .NET, Node.js)
  • Communication and presentation skills with a high degree of comfort speaking with executives, IT Management, and customers
  • API integration experience
  • Strong troubleshooting and debugging skills
  • Experience with Cloudformation, Contact Flow Design, Lambda Integration, Lex Integration, and Call Center Routing
  • Proficient in understanding and documenting the infrastructure requirements and specifications, including resource types, networking, security, and compliance needs.
  • Knowledge of automation tools and frameworks for building, testing, and deploying software, such as Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CodeDeploy
  • Contact Center architecture knowledge
  • Experienced in implementing infrastructure as code using AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK) and Terraform, ensuring consistent and efficient infrastructure deployment.
  • Capable of setting up monitoring and logging for infrastructure components and performing ongoing maintenance to ensure optimal performance and availability.
  • Experience in technology/software sales, pre-sales, or consulting
  • Advanced knowledge of AWS services and cloud architecture
  • Salesforce knowledge and familiarity with Salesforce Service Cloud
  • Contact center product knowledge of other platforms (Genesys, Cisco, Avaya, Twilio, etc.)
  • Experience with WorkForce Management solutions
  • Experience working with outbound dialers and campaign management
  • Knowledge of software development methodologies such as Agile and Scrum
  • AWS Cloud Practitioner Certification
  • AWS Developer Associate Certification or Professional
  • AWS Solution Architect Certification or Professional
  • Salesforce Certified Administrator

What’s it like to be a part of NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture?

  • Remote & In-Person: Whether you work out of our HQ in Massachusetts, one of our regional hubs, or you're one of over half of our NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture Family who work remotely, we’re focused on keeping everyone connected and unified as one team.
  • Travel: Get ready to pack your bags and hit the road! For certain roles, travel is an exciting part of the job, with an anticipated travel commitment of up to 25%. So, if you have a passion for adventure and don't mind a little jet-setting, this opportunity could be your ticket to exploring new places while making a positive impact on clients.
  • Flexibility: Do you have to take the dog to the vet, pick up the kids from school, or the in-laws from the airport? We know that a perfect 9-5 isn’t possible. So you have to jump out to do any of those, no problem! We build a culture of trust and understanding. We value good work not the hours in which you get it done
  • Collaboration: You have a voice here! If you work with a team of smart people like we do, it’s a no-brainer to take suggestions and feedback on how to keep NeuraFlash, Part of Accenture thriving. Our executive team holds town halls & company meetings where they address any suggestions or questions asked, no matter how big or small.
  • Celebrate Often: We take our work seriously, but we don’t take ourselves too seriously. Whether it is an arm wrestling contest, costume party, or ugly holiday sweaters our teams love to have fun. And while we work hard, we don’t forget to slow down and celebrate the big things and the small things together.

Start Date: January 4, 2027

Contract Length: 5 months
Location: Remote (must be comfortable working PST hours)- Preferably NYC or SF so you can go into the office when needed
Weekly Flat Rate: $2,500 a week

About the Role

We’re looking for a highly operational, agile Digital Marketing Producer to manage production for a dynamic, global marketing website and app experience on behalf of the client, a world-class technology organization. You’ll join a fast-paced team focused on scaling the client’s digital presence at an ambitious level.

This is a production role at its core. You’ll own deliverables, timelines, and coordination across website marketing projects, site updates, product updates, and app content. Partnering closely with Marketing, Creative, GTM, Legal, SEO, UI/UX, and Dev teams, you’ll serve as the central operational hub, making sure global product launches and major brand moments come to life on time and exactly as intended.

The ideal candidate is a decisive, hands-on producer with a bias to action who moves with urgency and purpose. You’re comfortable managing many high-velocity projects at once, thrive in ambiguous and fast-changing environments, and know how to keep every stakeholder aligned on launch readiness.

What Sets This Role Apart

The client operates at an exceptional pace, and this person needs to match that energy from day one. You’ll be expected to:

  • Move fast, with tight timelines and high stakes across simultaneous workstreams
  • Be proactive with a positive attitude
  • Handle complexity at scale, juggling many overlapping projects with grace and precision
  • Stay hands-on, from uploading creative assets to running QA checklists
  • Use AI tools as a real part of your daily workflow, not just a curiosity

What You’ll Do

  • Act as “air traffic control” for website marketing projects, product page updates, site updates, and app store content updates, setting priorities and keeping every project moving
  • Must have CMS experience.
  • Own deliverables and schedules end to end, keeping trackers updated as projects evolve
  • Coordinate the upload and maintenance of final creative and copy across the website and app, working closely with internal creative teams and agency partners
  • Manage the ticket pipeline with the dev vendor, making sure tickets and project trackers stay accurate and serve as the source of truth
  • Lead pre-launch QA, including link checks, deeplinks, and UTM tracking, so every launch is fully ready
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across meetings, chat spaces, and email threads; triage inbound requests and keep approvals moving
  • Use AI tools and automation to streamline repetitive tasks, speed up production cycles, and find smarter ways to work

What We’re Looking For

  • 5-7 years of experience in digital production, marketing production, or marketing operations
  • Proven track record as a producer in a fast-paced, ambiguous, agile environment, at scale
  • Ability to manage many complex projects at once without losing momentum, quality, or stakeholder trust
  • Strong project management skills: organized, detail-oriented, and great at staying on top of deliverables
  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to be the operational hub for cross-functional teams so nothing falls through the cracks
  • AI fluency, with hands-on experience using tools like generative AI assistants and automation platforms to work more efficiently
  • A doer mindset; you build momentum rather than create bottlenecks
  • Experience working with big brands or top agencies. A mixture of big tech and startup would be ideal
  • Working familiarity with CMS platforms, ticketing workflows, and web tracking (UTMs, deeplinks)

Nice to Have

  • Marketing background with a solid understanding of web best practices and user journeys
  • Experience in large, matrixed enterprise or tech organizations with many stakeholders

We Are Rosie provides strategic consulting and talent solutions for the marketing industry. We partner with more than 200 of the world’s biggest brands and agencies to help them solve unique marketing challenges with the best people, swiftly and at scale. Founded by former advertising executive Stephanie Nadi Olson in 2018, We Are Rosie is on a mission to redefine how marketing works, with an inclusive, human-centric approach that’s better for business and better for marketers. Our company has been recognized as an industry trailblazer and earned many accolades, including being named to the 2023 Global Top 100 Inspiring Workplaces, the Inc. 5000 2022, and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Agencies in 2021.

We Are Rosie is an equal opportunity employer. jobs.excerpt: At WelbeHealth, we serve our communities’ most vulnerable seniors through shared intention, pioneering spirit, and the courage to love.
jobs.description:
At WelbeHealth, we serve our communities’ most vulnerable seniors through shared intention, pioneering spirit, and the courage to love. These core values and our participant-focus lead the way no matter what.

The Operations Support & Strategy Manager is accountable for delivering measurable results in enterprise operational initiatives, specifically to the role assignment they support. The Operations Support & Strategy Manager is an individual contributor who plays a hands-on role in identifying and implementing process improvement strategies to ensure our teams are prepared to perform their role duties efficiently and effectively. This role works to identify gaps where additional clarity and improvement in enterprise operations processes are required, and works closely with impacted teams to achieve reliable, hard-wired processes that facilitate operational excellence.

This role is different because the Operations Support & Strategy Manager at WelbeHealth:

  • Leads highly ambiguous, complex operational challenges, bringing structure and clarity to undefined problems that directly impact care delivery
  • Owns end-to-end enterprise initiatives, influencing both strategy and execution across multiple markets and cross-functional teams

We care about our team members. That’s why we offer:

  • Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days
  • 401K savings + match
  • Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus
  • And additional benefits!

On the day-to-day, you will:

  • Independently manage end-to-end enterprise operations improvement initiatives that yield simplified, repeatable, and scalable processes to improve care quality and drive team engagement
  • Create and conduct presentations on key indicators of clinical excellence, ensuring appropriate team members understand how to maintain and improve clinical excellence in a data-driven way
  • Develop training, job aids, SOP's, workflows, and other support materials related to operations improvement initiatives
  • Contribute to the development of operations playbooks, role specific handbooks, role specific checklists, and departmental guides
  • Proactively create and lead cross-functional work groups to drive complex initiatives across both shared functions and market operations
  • Utilize complex data to inform recommendations

Job requirements include:

  • Must be currently located and residing in the state of California (Southern California preferred)
  • Must be comfortable with 20-25% of travel based on projects and business needs
  • Must be willing and able to work a varied schedule that may include evenings, nights, weekends, and overtime
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Certification in Lean Six Sigma (Black Belt preferred) or related process improvement methodologies are highly desired
  • Minimum of four (4) years of project and process improvement experience in the healthcare industry; PACE experience is highly desired
  • Experience in a healthcare or clinic setting with the ability to independently manage full scope healthcare operations initiatives with minimal direction
  • Hands-on facilitator of complex clinical operations improvement initiatives, while also directing more junior team members on sub-workstreams
  • Experience leading teams with direct reports including hiring, onboarding, training, and providing feedback and mentorship required
  • Microsoft Office competency
  • Experience with Electronic Medical Records platforms
  • Outstanding critical and analytical thinking skills, verbal and written communication skills, and presentation skills

We are seeking an Operations Support & Strategy Manager who thrives in solving complex operational challenges, driving cross-functional initiatives, and building scalable processes that enhance care delivery. If you are passionate about improving healthcare operations and making a meaningful impact on the lives of vulnerable seniors, we’d love to hear from you.

Compensation consists of base salary plus bonus. WelbeHealth offers a competitive total rewards package that includes a 401(k) match, comprehensive healthcare coverage, and a broad range of additional benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience and relevant qualifications.

Compensation Offering
$109,240—$144,197 USD

At WelbeHealth, our mission is to unlock the full potential of our vulnerable seniors. In this spirit, please note that we have a vaccination policy for all our employees and proof of vaccination, or a vaccine declination form will be required prior to employment. WelbeHealth maintains required infection control and PPE standards and has requirements relevant to all team members regarding vaccinations.

At WelbeHealth, we embrace and cherish the diversity of our team members, and we're committed to building a culture of inclusion and belonging. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Senior Training Specialist
jobs.excerpt: At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health.
jobs.description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Senior Training Specialist to join our Operations, Client Support team. This role would be responsible for developing and delivering impactful training programs that drive employee performance, operational excellence, and continuous improvement across Client and Provider Support. We are looking for someone who is collaborative, adaptable, and passionate about learning and development, and is passionate about making a meaningful impact and bringing their talents into a “for purpose” space. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

  • Instructional Design and Training
    • Design, develop, and maintain training programs for Client Support and Provider Support, including new-hire onboarding, role-specific training, certifications, process and system training, and ongoing upskilling.
    • Create engaging learning experiences across a variety of formats, including self-paced eLearning, instructor-led materials, job aids, tutorials, demonstrations, assessments, and interactive activities.
    • Apply adult learning principles and instructional design best practices to ensure training is engaging, accessible, and aligned with defined learning and business outcomes.
    • Continuously review and refresh curriculum based on learner feedback, performance data, process changes, and evolving business needs.
    • Facilitate live and virtual training sessions, new-hire nesting, demonstrations, guided practice, and other learning experiences for Client Support and Provider Support.
  • Training Administration and Learning Systems
    • Manage training assignments, enrollments, completion tracking, attendance, and learner progress through the LMS and other internal systems.
    • Coordinate training schedules and communicate training requirements and expectations to learners, Supervisors, and other stakeholders.
    • Maintain accurate training documentation and provide completion and learner performance information to relevant stakeholders.
  • Data Analysis & Performance Optimization
    • Evaluate training effectiveness through assessments, learner feedback, operational data, and other performance indicators.
    • Use data to identify knowledge and skill gaps, recommend learning interventions, and continuously improve training programs.
    • Maintain department skill assessments and skill matrices to support curriculum development, employee growth, and future training needs.
    • Track and communicate training initiatives, outcomes, and opportunities for improvement to leadership and relevant stakeholders.
  • Collaboration & Strategic Partnership
    • Partner with Client Support and Provider Support leadership to identify learning opportunities and develop strategies that address knowledge and performance needs.
    • Collaborate with SMEs and cross-functional partners to translate complex processes, workflows, systems, and business requirements into clear and effective learning experiences.
    • Serve as a trusted training resource during organizational, process, and system changes, helping teams successfully adopt new expectations and workflows.
    • Contribute to training standards, best practices, and broader learning initiatives across the organization.
    • Perform other related duties as assigned.

About You

  • Bachelor's degree in Instructional Design, Education, Communications, Learning & Development, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • 3–5+ years of experience in instructional design, training, learning and development, or a related field.
  • Experience designing and delivering training for adult learners, including self-paced eLearning and instructor-led training.
  • Experience with eLearning authoring tools such as Articulate Rise, Storyline, Captivate, or similar platforms, as well as Learning Management Systems.
  • Strong facilitation, communication, project management, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to translate complex processes and information into clear, engaging learning experiences.
  • Data-driven approach to evaluating training effectiveness and identifying opportunities for improvement.

Bonus Points

  • Experience in healthcare, behavioral health, customer support, contact center, or operations environments preferred.

Benefits

  • Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans
  • Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA
  • 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%
  • Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.
  • Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care
  • PTO and Remote First Environment
  • Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events
  • Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The base salary range for this role is between $70,000 - $80,000/yr. Within the range, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

Belonging reflects the affinity and positive relationships that develop among employees from diverse backgrounds when businesses actively promote diversity, equity, and inclusion in the workplace.

jobs.description:
About Point Foundation

Point Foundation is the nation's largest scholarship-granting organization for LGBTQ+ and ally students, supporting 1,250 scholars in the 2026–27 academic year. Point provides scholars with financial support, leadership and career development, and a lifelong community of students, alumni, and leaders in every field and industry.

Point’s mission is to support the educational aspirations of LGBTQ+ and ally students to become impactful leaders in their lives, careers, and communities. Point is proud to be a top-rated nonprofit by watchdog groups including Charity Navigator, GuideStar, and the Better Business Bureau.

We pursue excellence in all we do and are building for scale – growing the number of scholars we serve, expanding leadership and career development opportunities, and innovating the systems and technology that let a nimble team reach further every year.

Position Overview

Point Foundation seeks a systems-minded, detail-driven Director, Program Operations to own the requirements, systems, and workflows that carry applicants and scholars through every stage of Point's programs. This is a builder role for an operations leader who loves designing processes that work reliably for thousands of students at once. The Director will own Point's scholarship application portals and scholar CRM, administer the requirements that determine scholars' payments and continued eligibility, and lead operations for scholar programming. Working closely with the Chief Program Officer, the Sr. Director, Technology & Systems, and the Scholarships and Scholar Programs teams, the Director will set and document program requirements and ensure the systems behind them reflect program needs. As Point grows the number of scholars it serves, this role builds the operational foundation that lets a nimble team deliver a fair, consistent experience at scale.

Reports to: Chief Program Officer, Tina Kim

Status: Full time, exempt

Supervises: None

Location: Remote position based in the greater Los Angeles area. Occasional in-person meetings and events require candidates to be located in, or willing to relocate to, the L.A. area. Relocation assistance is available.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Systems Ownership - own Point’s scholarship application portals and scholar CRM, including configuration, maintenance, and ongoing improvement. Partner with the Sr. Director, Technology & Systems and the Director, Development Operations to plan and launch Point’s CRM strategy; lead program-side tool selection and implementation so that programs get what they need.
  • Scholar Lifecycle Operations- oversee operations across the full scholar lifecycle, from application and review through awarding, payment, renewal, and program completion. Manage the timelines and daily workflows to keep each stage on track, and deliver a smooth experience for applicants, scholars, and the volunteer and paid readers who review applications.
  • Scholar Communications & Completion Campaigns -
    own all scholar communications about requirements, including expectations, deadlines, reminders, and outcomes. Design and run multi-touch email and SMS campaigns triggered by requirement status, track completion rates, and adjust outreach to close gaps before deadlines.
  • Requirements & Eligibility Review -
    administer, track, and review scholar requirements for approval, determining whether scholars qualify for payment and continued eligibility. Set program requirements in partnership with the Chief Program Officer, maintain the policy documentation behind them, and refine procedures as programs evolve.
  • Program Event Operations - own the operational infrastructure for Point’s scholar programming, including the National Leadership Conference, such as registration, attendance tracking, scholar communications, and the data and workflows behind each event.
  • Data Integrity, Security & Reporting -
    maintain clean, consistent, well-governed program data that meets the organization-wide standards set by the Sr. Director, Technology & Systems. Protect sensitive scholar information through appropriate access controls, privacy practices, and security protocols, and produce summary reports from end-of-term scholar data.
  • Cross-Team Collaboration -
    partner regularly with the Scholarships and Scholar Programs teams to ensure operational systems meet their needs and objectives.
  • AI Innovation & Adoption- serve as a champion and resource for driving program team efficiency through the introduction of AI tools that reduce manual work and automate routine functions.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of experience in scholarship administration, financial aid, student services, or program operations.
  • 2+ years in a senior leadership role managing eligibility, compliance, or requirement-review processes at scale, tracking and communicating with large student populations (2,000+) through systems, automated workflows, and mass communications.
  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Hands-on experience configuring and maintaining a CRM or application management platform, including building forms, workflows, automations, user permissions, and reports.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and launching multi-touch requirement-completion campaigns across email and SMS that drive thousands of students to finish requirements on time.
  • Proficiency in cleaning, reconciling, analyzing, and reporting on large program datasets, including advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills (pivot tables, lookups, data validation) and AI tools.
  • Discretion and sound judgment in handling sensitive scholar information.
  • Passionate about Point's mission and enthusiasm about communicating the organization's philosophy, mission, and values.
  • Commitment to advancing equity and inclusion in all areas of responsibility and across the organization.

Core Competencies – Our Ways of Working

  • Ownership: Owns outcomes, not just tasks. Follows through on commitments or proactively resets expectations, and raises issues early and directly.
  • Learn & Adapt: Stays curious and self-aware. Seeks feedback, reflects on impact, and applies learnings as conditions change.
  • Focus & Excellence: Prioritizes the highest-impact work, delivers consistent high-quality results, and makes tradeoffs visible and intentional.
  • Trust & Belonging: Builds relationships grounded in respect, honesty, and inclusion. Engages candidly, assumes good intent, and addresses issues constructively.
  • Collaborate for Scale & Growth: Clarifies roles and handoffs, shares information transparently, commits to decisions once made, and designs sustainable, repeatable systems over "boutique" solutions.

Compensation and Accommodations

Pay range: $110,000 - $145,000/year. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus based on performance. Our total compensation goes well beyond salary: Point pays 100% of employee health insurance premiums, with coverage for dependents available at additional cost. Our full benefits package also includes a 403(b) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 3%.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Accommodations: we want the process to work for you. If you need an accommodation at any stage – application, screen, interview, or work sample – tell your recruiter. Accommodations are offered proactively and are honored at every later stage.

The purpose of this job description is to provide an overview of the scope of the position. This is not a comprehensive list of duties and responsibilities.

Salary: $110,000 - $145,000/year

jobs.description:
What You Will Do

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to own the future of Lattice Engagement and help define what great employee listening looks like in the years ahead.

Employee listening is a critical way HR leaders understand their organizations, build trust with employees, and turn feedback into action. As expectations for listening evolve, Lattice has an opportunity to make Engagement a more strategic, intelligent, and indispensable part of how companies lead.

You’ll create the long-term strategy for Lattice Engagement and lead the first major iteration of that strategy from discovery through launch. You’ll join a cross-functional team ready to execute, and together you’ll build products that give HR leaders a clearer understanding of their people—and the confidence to act on what they learn.

If you enjoy solving meaningful customer problems, developing a strong point of view, and turning strategy into high-impact products, you’ll love the impact you can have here. As a Lead Product Manager for Engagement, you will:

  • Own the Engagement and employee-listening strategy. Define not only what we build next, but what the future of employee listening should mean for Lattice and the HR leaders we serve.
  • Turn insight into action. Develop product experiences that help HR leaders gather meaningful feedback, understand what it reveals, and take action that improves the employee experience.
  • Lead strategy. Drive discovery, prioritization, execution, launch, and iteration for the products that bring this vision to life.
  • Build a deep understanding of customers. Partner with Research to understand the needs, workflows, and most important decisions of HR leaders, and use those insights to guide the roadmap.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design. Translate customer problems and product strategy into clear, high-quality experiences that customers will want to use.
  • Use data to sharpen decisions. Work with Data Science to identify opportunities, measure outcomes, and continually improve the product.
  • Drive go-to-market readiness. Partner with Product Marketing to shape positioning, launches, and customer communication.
  • Own outcomes. Set and influence the key results that show Engagement is creating value for customers and for Lattice.

What You Will Bring to the Table

We’re looking for a product manager with the strategic instincts, customer empathy, and employee-listening expertise to shape the next generation of Lattice Engagement. You’ll be a great fit if you have a combination of:

  • 7+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Direct experience with employee engagement, surveys, employee listening, feedback, research, or insight products.
  • A clear and informed point of view on the future of employee listening, including how product innovation can help organizations better understand and respond to their people.
  • A track record of taking ambiguous, high-impact product problems from strategy through execution and measurable customer outcomes.
  • Deep customer empathy and an ability to understand the priorities and challenges of HR leaders.
  • Strong product judgment: you can balance a compelling long-term vision with the practical decisions required to ship meaningful work now.
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills, especially with Engineering, Design, Research, Data Science, and Product Marketing.
  • A bias for action and the ability to create clarity and momentum in an evolving space.

Bonus:

  • Experience building products for HR, people teams, or other complex organizational workflows.
  • Experience with AI-enabled research, feedback, analytics, or insight products.

If you have strong experience in employee listening, survey products, or adjacent customer-insight domains—even if you do not meet every preferred qualification—we encourage you to apply. We’re looking for a strong product thinker with a meaningful perspective on the future of employee listening, not a perfect resume.

Location Requirement:
This role is open to candidates located in British Columbia or Ontario, Canada. At this time, we are only able to hire employees residing in these provinces.

___

The estimated annual cash salary for this role is CAD $135,000 - $180,000. This position is also eligible for incentive stock options, subject to the terms of Lattice’s applicable plans.

Benefits: Lattice offers eligible Canada-based employees comprehensive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision coverage; life and AD&D insurance; short- and long-term disability coverage; mental health and wellness support; emergency weather support; 16 weeks of paid parental leave; flexible time off, 13 company holidays, and 3 recharge days; a monthly remote-work stipend and one-time home-office setup stipend; an RRSP contribution match of up to 3% of gross pay (maximum $2,500 CAD annually); and a $500 CAD annual Learning & Development reimbursement. Benefits are subject to applicable eligibility requirements.

*Note on Pay Transparency:

Lattice provides an estimate of the compensation for roles that may be hired as required by state regulations. Compensation may vary based on (a) location, as Lattice factors in specific location when benchmarking compensation for most roles; (b) individual candidate skills and qualifications; and (c) individual candidate experience.

Additionally, Lattice leverages current market data to determine compensation, so posted compensation figures are subject to change as new market data becomes available. The salary, other compensation, and benefits information is accurate as of the date of this posting. Lattice reserves the right to modify this information at any time, subject to applicable law.

About Lattice

Lattice is on a mission to build cultures where employees and their companies thrive. In an age where employees have more choices than ever before, businesses that put employees first are winning 🏅– and Lattice is building the tools to empower those people-centric companies.

Lattice is a people success platform that offers performance reviews, employee engagement surveys, real-time feedback, weekly check-ins, goal setting, and career planning in a way that allows companies to focus on employee development, growth, and engagement – yielding stronger employee retention, performance, and impact to the bottom line 📈. Since launching in 2016, we have grown to over 5,000+ customers globally, including brands like Loom, Robinhood, and Gusto.

jobs.excerpt: About LyraLyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships.
jobs.description:
About Lyra

Lyra Clinical Associates partners with Lyra Health, a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Lyra members have access to care in one day, and nine out of ten improve with the support of providers like you. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions. You will be employed by Lyra Clinical Associates.

About the Role

As a therapist within our Pediatric Outpatient Service Line, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in the lives of children, teens, young adults, and their families while working as part of an integrated clinical team.

You'll provide evidence-based, developmentally appropriate therapy that helps members build resilience, strengthen relationships, develop effective coping skills, and make progress toward individualized treatment goals. Depending on the member's age and clinical needs, treatment may also involve partnering with parents or caregivers to reinforce skills, support treatment goals, and promote meaningful change outside of therapy sessions.

Therapists are an integral part of our collaborative care model. You'll work closely with behavioral case managers, psychiatric providers, nurses, coaches, and other clinical team members to ensure members receive coordinated care that reflects their individual, developmental, and family needs.

This role is a great fit for an independently NY licensed behavioral health clinician who is passionate about supporting children, teens, and young adults, values collaboration, and is comfortable adapting treatment across developmental stages. You'll have opportunities to expand your clinical expertise through consultation, ongoing training, evidence-based care practices, and collaboration with an interdisciplinary team.

We are looking for a part-time licensed therapist to join our Pediatric Care Services clinical team. This role sits within the Pediatric Outpatient Service Line and reports to a Clinical Supervisor.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Provide evidence-based individual and family therapy to children, adolescents, young adults, and caregivers.

  • Conduct comprehensive behavioral health assessments and develop individualized treatment plans.

  • Utilize evidence-based modalities, including CBT, DBT, ACT, MI, PMT, trauma-informed interventions, and other approaches appropriate to the member's clinical and developmental needs.

  • Collaborate with psychiatrists, behavioral case managers, coaches, nurses, and other interdisciplinary team members to provide coordinated care.

  • Engage caregivers as active partners in treatment when clinically and developmentally appropriate through psychoeducation, collaborative goal setting, and skills coaching.

  • Maintain timely, accurate, clinically meaningful, and compliant documentation.

  • Participate in clinical consultation, supervision, ongoing training, and professional development.

  • Support quality improvement initiatives and the continued delivery of high-quality, evidence-based care.

Requirements:

  • Ability to work part-time, 24 hours per week.

  • Availability to provide care during afternoon and evening hours to support member scheduling needs.

  • Potential opportunity to work Saturdays based on program needs.

  • Ability to maintain a private, professional workspace appropriate for providing confidential telehealth services.

  • Ability to maintain reliable internet connectivity necessary to provide consistent, high-quality virtual care.

  • Must reside in and be authorized to work in the United States

  • Ability to meet applicable state licensing, credentialing, payer enrollment requirements, and interstate practice requirements.

Qualifications:

  • Current, active New York license and registration in good standing that permits independent clinical practice and diagnosis, such as LCSW, Licensed Psychologist, LMHC, or LMFT. LMHCs and LMFTs must hold New York’s diagnostic privilege. License must have no current restrictions or pending disciplinary action.

  • Doctoral degree (Psy.D. or Ph.D.) in Clinical Psychology, Counseling Psychology, or a related psychology discipline.

  • Experience providing evidence-based behavioral health treatment to children, adolescents, young adults, and families.

  • Demonstrated ability to deliver culturally responsive, trauma-informed, and developmentally appropriate care that recognizes and respects members' identities, lived experiences, family structures, and backgrounds.

  • Experience utilizing evidence-based interventions such as CBT, DBT, ACT, MI, PMT, EMDR, and other clinically appropriate treatment approaches.

  • Experience engaging caregivers as collaborative partners in treatment while promoting developmentally appropriate member autonomy.

  • Experience working collaboratively within an interdisciplinary care team.

  • Strong clinical judgment with excellent communication, organization, and documentation skills.

  • Tech-savvy and comfortable utilizing telehealth platforms, electronic health records, and other digital tools to deliver high-quality virtual care.

  • Warm, engaging, and collaborative clinical style with the ability to build therapeutic rapport across developmental stages.

jobs.excerpt: About Point FoundationPoint Foundation is the nation's largest scholarship-granting organization for LGBTQ+ and ally students, supporting 1,250 scholars in the 2026–27 academic year.
jobs.description:
About Point Foundation

Point Foundation is the nation's largest scholarship-granting organization for LGBTQ+ and ally students, supporting 1,250 scholars in the 2026–27 academic year. Point provides scholars with financial support, leadership and career development, and a lifelong community of students, alumni, and leaders in every field and industry.

Point’s mission is to support the educational aspirations of LGBTQ+ and ally students to become impactful leaders in their lives, careers, and communities. Point is proud to be a top-rated nonprofit by watchdog groups including Charity Navigator, GuideStar, and the Better Business Bureau.

We pursue excellence in all we do and are building for scale - growing the number of scholars we serve, expanding leadership and career development opportunities, and innovating the systems and technology that let a nimble team reach further every year.

Position Overview

Point Foundation seeks a hands-on, systems-minded Director of Development Operations to serve as the engine behind the Development team's fundraising success. This is a builder role - someone who can zoom out to shape a forward-looking and AI-powered technology roadmap and zoom back in to troubleshoot a broken integration before it slows the team down. The Director will own the full technical infrastructure that powers fundraising at Point. Partnering closely with the Chief Development Officer on the day-to-day, and with the Sr. Director, Technology & Systems on strategy and the buildout of the technical roadmap, this person will be both the engineer of Point's fundraising technology stack and the hands-on operator who keeps it running.

Reports to: Chief Development Officer

Status: Full time, exempt

Supervises: One associate-level direct report

Location: Remote position based in the greater Los Angeles area. Occasional in-person meetings and events require candidates to be located in, or willing to relocate to, the L.A. area. Relocation assistance is available.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Database, Data Integrity & Reporting Oversight - own overall accountability for the donor database, including data integrity standards, hygiene, reporting, and analytics. Direct staff on day-to-day data work while remaining hands-on with complex reporting, troubleshooting, and data strategy as needed.
  • Data Governance & Compliance - establish and enforce Development-specific policies for donor data privacy, security, and user access permissions, in line with organization-wide standards set by the Sr. Director, Technology & Systems, and ensure compliance with applicable regulations and PCI standards across all fundraising platforms.
  • Fundraising Analytics & Reporting - build dashboards, KPIs, and revenue forecasts that give the Chief Development Officer, gift officers, and leadership clear visibility into pipeline, portfolio performance, and progress toward goals.
  • Platform & Vendor Management - serve as the primary owner of the Development team's technology stack, including Fundraise Up, iWave, and other giving and prospect research platforms; manage related vendor relationships and design and maintain integrations between Development systems and those used by Finance, Marketing, and Programs, ensuring data flows accurately and consistently across the organization.
  • Technology Strategy & Roadmap -
    partner with the Sr. Director, Technology & Systems and the Director, Program Operations to plan and launch Point’s CRM strategy, and develop a forward-looking roadmap for the Development team’s technology needs that integrates within the organization's overall technology roadmap, including evaluating new tools and platform upgrades.
  • AI & Emerging Technology - harness AI and emerging technologies to increase efficiency, automation, and outcomes across Development operations, identifying high-value use cases, piloting and implementing new tools, and ensuring responsible use that safeguards donor data.
  • Gift Processing, Acknowledgment & Revenue Operations -
    oversee staff responsible for gift entry, processing workflows, and revenue reconciliation in partnership with the Finance Team, ensuring accuracy and compliance with data standards. Oversee timely, accurate gift acknowledgments and tax receipts, ensuring donor documentation meets IRS requirements and Point's stewardship standards.
  • Campaign & Event Operations - support appeals, campaigns, and events through list segmentation, appeal and campaign coding, and integration of registration and giving data into the donor database.
  • Process Improvement & Team Enablement -
    train and support Development staff on system use, troubleshoot user issues, and continuously refine processes to reduce manual work and improve data quality across the team.
  • Documentation & Standard Procedures - create and maintain documentation for data standards, gift processing procedures, and system configurations so institutional knowledge is preserved and the team can scale.

Requirements

  • 6+ years of development operations, database administration, or fundraising systems experience, including 2+ years in a senior or leadership capacity overseeing staff or systems strategy.
  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience in lieu of a degree.
  • Direct, hands-on experience administering a nonprofit CRM/donor database (e.g., Raiser's Edge), including data integrity management, gift processing and attribution, and report building.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple integrated fundraising platforms (e.g., online giving tools like Fundraise Up, prospect research tools like iWave) as a system owner, not just an end user.
  • Proficiency in building and running reports, queries, and donor/prospect lists from a CRM database to support gift officer portfolios, board reporting, and organizational fundraising analysis.
  • Hands-on experience identifying, piloting, and implementing AI tools to automate workflows and improve data quality, including responsible-use practices that protect sensitive donor data.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with other staff to evaluate and identify technology solutions for fundraising needs, including researching, assessing, and recommending new platforms or integrations that address gaps in the Development team's tech stack.
  • Highly organized and deadline-driven, managing multiple high-priority projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Discretion and sound judgment in handling sensitive organizational and donor information.
  • Passionate about Point's mission and enthusiasm about communicating the organization's philosophy, mission, and values.
  • Commitment to advancing equity and inclusion in all areas of responsibility and across the organization.
  • Preferred: experience with SQL, data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau), or advanced reporting/analytics beyond native CRM reporting; experience managing technology vendor relationships and leading system migrations or platform implementations; and experience in nonprofit fundraising specifically, understanding the unique data and reporting needs of a development shop.

Core Competencies - Our Ways of Working

  • Ownership: Owns outcomes, not just tasks. Follows through on commitments or proactively resets expectations and raises issues early and directly.
  • Learn & Adapt: Stays curious and self-aware. Seeks feedback, reflects on impact, and applies learnings as conditions change.
  • Focus & Excellence: Prioritizes the highest-impact work, delivers consistent high-quality results, and makes tradeoffs visible and intentional.
  • Trust & Belonging: Builds relationships grounded in respect, honesty, and inclusion. Engages candidly, assumes good intent, and addresses issues constructively.
  • Collaborate for Scale & Growth: Clarifies roles and handoffs, shares information transparently, commits decisions once made, and designs sustainable, repeatable systems over "boutique" solutions.

Compensation and Accommodations

Pay range: $110,000 - $145,000/year. This role is also eligible for an annual bonus based on performance. Our total compensation goes well beyond salary: Point pays 100% of employee health insurance premiums, with coverage for dependents available at additional cost. Our full benefits package also includes a 403(b)-retirement plan with an employer match of up to 3%.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Accommodations: We want the process to work for you. If you need accommodation at any stage - application, screen, interview, or work sample - tell your recruiter. We offer accommodations proactively and honor them at any later stage.

The purpose of this job description is to provide an overview of the position. This is not a comprehensive list of duties and responsibilities.

Salary: $110,000 - $145,000 / year

Position Title: DIRECTOR, OPERATIONAL INNOVATION & ENABLEMENT

Salary: $160000 - $180000 / year

Other Forms of Compensation:15% Annual Bonus Opportunity

As the leader in business and industry dining, Eurest is the company to join if you want a rewarding career packed with limitless opportunities. We feed the employees of the nation's largest and most-prestigious companies -- in every state and across all industries. As a member of Eurest's leadership and professional support team, you will help our 16,000 chefs, and in-unit associates excel as they deliver world-class meals in corporate cafes and executive dining rooms with on-site catering through vending innovations and more.

Our company is innovative, high performing and fast growing. Our teammates are enthusiastic, committed to quality and thrive on consistently delivering unparalleled results. And did we mention we work with exciting companies and at interesting locations? Come grow your career with Eurest.

Mission

Build the people, systems, and deployment frameworks required to turn strategy and innovation into scalable organizational capability.

Job Summary

Reporting to the Vice President of Operations, the Director, Operational Innovation & Enablement serves as the bridge between organizational strategy and field execution across a complex, multi-site hospitality portfolio.

This role serves as the primary enablement and deployment partner to field leadership, translating strategic priorities into scalable execution models that can be successfully adopted across diverse campuses, operating formats, and varying levels of organizational maturity.

This role is responsible for building the organizational capabilities, deployment frameworks, and leadership systems that enable teams to successfully adopt, sustain, and scale new programs, technologies, and operating models.

Unlike traditional operational support roles focused on reporting, governance, or performance management, this position focuses on building organizational capability — creating the systems and leadership behaviors that allow change to succeed long after implementation.

Success in this role is measured by the organization's ability to consistently execute, sustain, and scale strategic initiatives across diverse locations, operating models, and levels of organizational complexity.

The role’s long-term impact is reflected in the organization’s ability to adopt, execute, sustain, and scale change through established systems, leadership capability, and operational ownership.

Key Responsibilities:

Organizational Enablement & Leadership Capability:

  • Develop scalable operating frameworks, playbooks, standards, and tools that drive consistency across the portfolio.
  • Build leadership capability through scalable learning frameworks, field resources, and development programs focused on execution, problem-solving, decision-making, and change leadership.
  • Strengthen local change leadership by equipping district and site leaders to independently lead and sustain improvement initiatives.
  • Lead change management eƯorts, including communication, stakeholder engagement, readiness planning, and adoption strategies.
  • Establish accountability and sustainment mechanisms that reinforce long-term execution, organizational ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Translate strategic priorities into practical implementation plans that can be successfully executed by field teams.
  • Assess operational challenges and identify opportunities to improve eƯectiveness, consistency, and organizational capability.

Innovation Deployment & Scaling:

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to identify, evaluate, and advance operational, service, and technology innovations.
  • Design pilot and testing frameworks to evaluate new ideas and measure eƯectiveness.
  • Convert successful pilots into scalable operating models supported by standards, training, and deployment plans.
  • Enable adoption across diverse locations, business formats, and leadership teams.
  • Create clear pathways that move innovations from concept to pilot, deployment, and long-term sustainment.

Strategic Deployment & Cross-Functional Alignment:

  • Lead operational deployment of enterprise initiatives from planning through adoption and sustainment.
  • Align stakeholders across Operations, Culinary, Experience, Finance, and support functions to ensure successful execution.
  • Assess organizational readiness and proactively address barriers to implementation.
  • Establish metrics and reporting processes that measure adoption, execution quality, and initiative effectiveness.
  • Identify, standardize, and scale best practices across the portfolio.
  • Serve as a strategic partner to the VP of Operations and senior leadership team, translating organizational priorities into scalable operating solutions that strengthen capability and drive execution.

Target Candidate Profile & Qualifications:

Experience:

  • 8+ years of leadership experience in multi-unit hospitality, food service, retail, corporate dining, contract catering, or similarly complex service environments.
  • Experience leading initiatives across geographically dispersed, multi-site operations with diverse business models, stakeholder groups, and operating complexities.

Operational Enablement & Change Leadership:

  • Proven success building operating systems, leadership development programs, training functions, or change-management initiatives across dispersed teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead organizational change and drive adoption of new programs, technologies, and operating models.
  • Demonstrated success leading organizational transformation eƯorts, including change adoption, capability development, operational deployment, and long-term sustainment.

Innovation & Execution:

  • Experience piloting, implementing, and scaling innovative solutions in complex operating environments.
  • Strong project and program management skills, including stakeholder engagement, deployment planning, and performance measurement.

Leadership & Influence:

  • Ability to build alignment across functions and influence leaders at all levels of the organization, including senior leadership, through credibility, strategic thinking, and effective change leadership.
  • Strong communication skills with experience creating scalable tools, frameworks, and resources that support field execution.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders to influence organizational priorities, align cross-functional stakeholders, and drive enterprise-wide initiatives.

Strategic Thinking & Execution:

  • Demonstrated ability to translate organizational strategy into scalable operating models, deployment frameworks, and leadership capabilities that deliver measurable business outcomes.

Preferred:

  • Experience in leadership development, organizational learning, training, continuous improvement, or operational excellence initiatives.

jobs.description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Driving Technology Adoption, Consumption, and Growth

Lumen is evolving how we sell by bringing deeper technology fluency, consultative discovery, and business-outcome conversations into every customer engagement. Our Acceleration and Growth team offers multiple distinct opportunities to help shape this journey while building your own expertise as a technology-focused seller. This is an opportunity to be part of meaningful change - help define how we engage, advise, and support customers as their technology needs become more complex. If you are energized by building trusted relationships, shaping a more consultative customer experience, and making a visible impact as our sales approach evolves, this role offers the chance to help lead that change.

As an Account Director Senior Large Enterprise, you will own growth across large, important, and potentially global enterprise accounts by translating customer business priorities into measurable outcomes enabled by Lumen’s network, cloud, security, managed services, and orchestration portfolio.

As the Account Director Senior, you operate independently from acquisition through modernization, activation, adoption, consumption, and expansion. You set account strategy, shape and negotiate commercial terms, mobilize cross-functional resources, and advise executive stakeholders. Your broad command of customer economics, markets, technology, and complex buying environments makes you a trusted expert to customers and colleagues.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Own and execute a self-directed strategy for a portfolio of large, important, or global accounts, grounded in each customer’s business model, financial priorities, operating risks, technology estate, market context, and competitive position.
  • Anticipate needs before they become formal requirements; develop points of view and use cases that connect modernization to growth, efficiency, resilience, risk reduction, and innovation.
  • Build qualified pipeline through executive relationships, account intelligence, focused prospecting, partners, marketing, and business development.
  • Prioritize investments and resources based on customer potential, solution fit, buying signals, competitive dynamics, and revenue opportunity.
  • Lead discovery across executive, business, technical, operational, and financial stakeholders to define the problem, value at stake, decision path, and urgency to act.
  • Integrate relevant capabilities across Lumen and its partners into a coherent outcome; direct architects and specialists through clear commercial and customer objectives while they own technical design and validation.
  • Build quantified business cases covering expected value, investment, implementation requirements, risk, and cost of inaction.
  • Develop customers’ and colleagues’ understanding of business, market, and solution tradeoffs; influence executive sponsors, economic buyers, technical decision makers, and internal champions.
  • Own new-logo acquisition and expansion against assigned sales, revenue, and consumption goals.
  • Lead complex, high-value sales cycles through qualification, validation, pricing, negotiation, procurement, legal review, and close.
  • Exercise substantial commercial discretion—and, within company governance, full authority to shape and negotiate product, service, pricing, and contract terms.
  • Establish mutual action plans, decision criteria, stakeholder commitments, milestones, and activation dates; surface risks and dependencies early.
  • Plan and manage the account resource model, mobilizing sales, technical, delivery, customer success, channel, and partner teams without relying on formal authority.
  • Retain commercial ownership through implementation and activation; hold downstream partners accountable for customer readiness, delivery commitments, adoption, and value realization.
  • Use consumption data and customer signals to remove adoption barriers, address underutilization, anticipate revenue risk, and identify expansion across workloads, locations, and business units.
  • Convert demonstrated value into modernization, additional use cases, broader executive relationships, recurring revenue, and sustained growth.
  • Serve as a recognized expert across business, financial, market, customer, and portfolio domains; coach peers and contribute account insight that improves sales approaches and solution fit.
  • Activate channel and technology partners through joint targeting, account planning, and selling, with clear ownership and measurable outcomes.
  • Use AI, agents, and automated workflows to improve research, prioritization, outreach, follow-through, and opportunity management; validate outputs and apply sound judgment.
  • Maintain rigorous qualification, stakeholder maps, next steps, forecasts, and CRM records.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • 8+ years of enterprise sales experience and sustained quota achievement, with evidence of performance at the scope and complexity described above.
  • Success acquiring and expanding large, important, or global enterprise accounts and closing complex deals with multimillion-dollar total contract value.
  • Broad expertise across customer business and financial drivers, enterprise technology markets, complex buying environments, and relevant solutions such as networking, cloud, security, managed services, or enterprise software.
  • Demonstrated authority and judgment in structuring and negotiating complex product, service, pricing, and contract terms with senior customer leaders.
  • Technical fluency to lead credible discovery, recognize solution opportunities, and direct architects and specialists effectively.
  • Experience planning account strategy independently and orchestrating colleagues and partners across the full customer lifecycle without formal authority.
  • Understanding of recurring-revenue and consumption-based models, including how activation, adoption, and usage create customer value and revenue growth.
  • Practical experience using AI and automation to improve sales execution, with disciplined validation of outputs.
  • Executive presence, sound judgment, and an ownership mindset; you make decisions, surface risk early, give direct feedback, and take responsibility for outcomes.

Compensation

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position based on current national data. Minimums and maximums may vary based on location. Individual pay is based on skills, experience and other relevant factors.

Location Based Pay Ranges

About the Company

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.
A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.
Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet the Team

We are looking for detail-oriented Data Annotators to join our team on a six-month contract with possibility of converting to full-time employee or extending an additional six months. In this role, you will help support Torc’s data annotation and quality assurance pipeline by labeling information from different sensors, including images and LiDAR, to help train AI systems used in autonomous trucks.

What You’ll Do

As a Data Annotator, you’ll work with both 2D images and 3D sensor data to help our AI systems recognize and understand their surroundings. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Labeling objects using specialized tools to create:
    • 2D bounding boxes
    • 3D cuboids
    • Other shape types to represent vehicles, road features, obstacles, and more
  • Reviewing pre-labeled data to ensure it follows detailed guidelines
  • Accepting, rejecting, or correcting annotations using our software
  • Providing clear notes when corrections are needed
  • Learning and mastering our internal tools over time

Your work directly supports the development of safer autonomous vehicle technology by ensuring the AI models used on those vehicles are trained with high-quality, accurate data.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately annotate objects in both 2D and 3D environments
  • Follow instructions and guidelines consistently across tasks

About Waymark

Waymark is a mission-driven team of healthcare providers, technologists, and builders working to transform care for people with Medicaid benefits. We partner with communities to deliver technology-enabled, human-centered support that helps patients stay healthy and thrive. We’re designing tools and systems that bring care directly to those who need it most—removing barriers and reimagining what’s possible in Medicaid healthcare delivery.

Our Values

At Waymark, our values are the foundation of how we work, grow, and support one another:

  • Bold Builders: We tackle the toughest challenges in care delivery by harnessing the power of community and technology.
  • Humble Learners: We seek feedback, embrace diverse perspectives, and welcome challenges to our assumptions.
  • Experiment to Improve: We use data to inform decisions and continuously assess our performance.
  • Focused Urgency: Our mission drives us to act swiftly and relentlessly in pursuit of meaningful results.

If this resonates with you, we invite you to bring your creativity, energy, and curiosity to Waymark.

About this role

As a Pharmacy Technician, you will provide virtual (primarily telephonic) support for Medicaid patients. You will partner with Waymark pharmacists to help patients access medications, address barriers to medication non-adherence, access relevant durable medical equipment (DME), and elevate prescription needs to providers. You will report to the Clinical Pharmacist Lead in Virginia.

You will interact with patients through telehealth modalities (SMS, phone, and app-free video) as part of a broader team that includes community health workers who see patients in person and support patients in addressing social determinants of health, therapists who provide mental health counseling, and care coordinators who work closely with primary care providers to support wrap-around services. You should be familiar with pharmacist interventions in primary care that help patients overcome challenges gaining access to, and appropriately taking, their medications.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate patient medication needs with a multidisciplinary team including community health workers (CHW’s), care coordinators, and therapists.
  • Perform telephonic and SMS outreach to patients and providers/pharmacies to address medication access issues, medication non-adherence or other drug utilization activities to improve patient and quality outcomes. Outreach also includes addressing medication-related and disease-control HEDIS gaps.
  • Coordinate with external healthcare providers and Waymark care team colleagues to provide accurate and timely information on medications as well as facilitation of medication access, answering, resolving and triaging inbound inquiries in collaboration with the rest of your Waymark pharmacy team.
  • Communicate with patients and healthcare providers to assist in completing medication prior authorizations, navigate formulary changes, manage side effects, and identify therapeutic substitutions in conjunction with Waymark and primary care teams.
  • Facilitate timely responses to internal Waymark requests for pharmacy team assistance by obtaining and documenting medication information and verifying eligibility, formulary, benefits and allergy information as requested by your Waymark Pharmacist supervisor.
  • Provide accurate and timely documentation to ensure productivity and quality metrics are met.
  • Actively participate in innovation with an evolving startup environment by identifying trends, resolving problems, recommending improvements, and implementing process improvement changes, applying observations and recommendations to resolve operational issues, increasing productivity and quality, and achieving excellent customer experience.

Minimum qualifications

  • Current Virginia State Pharmacy Technician License in good standing.
  • PTCB CPhT Certification.
  • 2 or more years experience working in outpatient/primary care/clinic-based, or managed care settings.
  • Experience with and commitment to improving care for underserved populations.
  • Ability to collaborate and communicate effectively in a multidisciplinary team setting.
  • Strong interpersonal communication skills, comfortable with proactively engaging patients telephonically, comfortable reaching out to on-site clinicians, payors, and pharmacies telephonically.
  • Detail-oriented, customer service-oriented mindset, motivated problem solver.
  • Ability to navigate proficiently within multiple computer systems including but not limited to spreadsheets, EHRs, and others.
  • Reside within the state of Virginia.

Preferred qualifications

  • 3 or more years experience working in outpatient/primary care/clinic-based, or managed care settings.Experience working in a call center handling pharmacy-related customer service requests and performing outbound calls.Experience in navigating Virginia Medicaid prescription benefits in addressing medication access issues for Medicaid and dual-eligible patients.
  • Experience with lean process improvement and/or other quality improvement initiatives and development and implementation of new operational workflows.
  • Experience with EHR documentation.
