jobs.excerpt: Associate Digital Solutions Engineer (Associate DSE) THE POSITION IN A NUTSHELLSciens Building Solutions is seeking an Associate Digital Solutions Engineer (Associate DSEs) that build and test practical AI and automation tools that make everyday work easier for our field and office teams.
jobs.description:
Associate Digital Solutions Engineer (Associate DSE)

THE POSITION IN A NUTSHELL

Sciens Building Solutions is seeking an Associate Digital Solutions Engineer (Associate DSEs) that build and test practical AI and automation tools that make everyday work easier for our field and office teams.

This position will work with the Digital & AI team, reporting to the Chief Digital Officer. Associate DSEs take in ideas from across the business, build pilots for the ones that are prioritized, test them with the people who will use them, and measure whether they work. Pilots that prove out are handed to the delivery team for production builds.

Associate DSEs are encouraged to try modern AI tools and test ideas quickly. Strong performers can grow into the Digital Solutions Engineer role as they take on more ownership.

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING (and doing well!)

  • Spend time with field and office teams, take in their ideas, and check whether SAP or a tool we already have can do the job before anything new is built.
  • Build and configure pilot tools using AI, automation, and workflow platforms, starting from use cases prioritized by the Chief Digital Officer.
  • Test pilots with the people who will use them, measure whether they save time or improve results, and refine them based on what you learn.
  • Work with the analytics and systems teams to get the data a pilot needs.
  • Document on how each pilot works, what was tested, and what was learned, and share results in short, clear updates.
  • Support the handoff of validated pilots to the delivery team for production builds.
  • Review AI tools that teams and departments build for themselves before they are shared more widely.
  • Help run tools once they are live by watching answer quality, fixing wrong answers, and flagging tools that are not showing value.

WHAT WE LIKE ABOUT YOU

  • Curious about how a business runs and how technology can make the work easier.
  • Hands-on builder who learns new tools quickly.
  • Interest in applying AI and automation to practical, everyday problems.
  • Prefers simple, testable approaches and is comfortable trying something, measuring it, and adjusting.
  • Asks good questions, takes direction well, and follows work through to the end.
  • Clear communicator who can explain technical ideas in plain terms.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Working knowledge of Python or a similar language, plus basic data skills (SQL, spreadsheets, or data analysis tools).
  • Familiarity with modern AI tools and concepts, including LLMs, prompt design, copilots, and workflow automation platforms.
  • Strong documentation, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • Coursework or graduate study in machine learning or AI is a plus.

WHAT WE’RE BRINGING TO THE TABLE
 

  • Competitive salary based on qualifications. 
  • Paid time off plan and holidays. 
  • 401(k) matching. 
  • Short term and long-term disability.  
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans with options. 
  • Life insurance. 
  • Professional career development opportunities. 
  • Tuition reimbursement program.

A $2,500 SIGN-ON BONUS will be given to all external candidates hired into this role. Half of the bonus will be paid after 3 months of employment and the remainder will be paid after 9 months of employment.


Territory: This role covers the North Central CA (San Joaquin & Stanislaus) area.


Ideal Candidate Locations: The ideal candidate will live in San Joaquin or Stanislaus counties.


This is a work-from-home position with day travel to policy locations (on average 3-4 days a week) via company vehicle (personal use, gas and maintenance included). Claims inspections will include onsite and virtual inspection. Depending on claim volume, this role may also support additional territories in a desk adjuster capacity. Occasional overnight travel may be required in this role.


Relocation assistance may be available for qualified candidates who reside more than 50 miles outside of the territory. 


Qualifications:

  • 3-5 years of insurance field/property claims handling or adjusting experience
  • Solid experience/proficiency with Xactimate
  • Solid experience writing own estimates and handling claims start to finish
  • Construction background/experience - Residential, Roofing, Remodeling, Water mitigation, etc
  • Strong customer service competency
  • Strong written & verbal communication skills

PLEASE NOTE that CAT duty is a requirement of this role


Benefits Include: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401k with company match, Company-paid Pension plan, Paid time off and more!


Job Description Summary

No two property claims are ever the same and each customer has unique needs. Our team thrives on providing the very best service and building lasting, successful relationships with our customers. If you are confident, curious, driven to learn and grow, and have a desire to help people when they most need it, we want to know more about you!

As a Field Claims Specialist, you'll investigate and resolve moderate to severe property damage claims by phone and in face-to-face claims handling.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities:

  • Handles all assigned claims promptly and effectively, with little to no direction and oversight. Makes decisions within delegated authority as outlined in company policies and procedures.

  • Determines proper policy coverages and applies appropriate claims practices to resolve cases in alignment with company guidelines.

  • Opens, closes and adjusts reserves according to company practices to ensure reserve adequacy. Adheres to file conferencing notification and authority procedures.

  • Maintains current knowledge of insurance and applicable product/services; court decisions which may impact the claims' function; current guidelines; and policy changes and modifications. This may require attending various seminars and/or training sessions.

  • Maintains current knowledge of local industry repair procedures and local market pricing.

  • Submits severe incident reports, reinsurance reports and other information to claims management as needed.

  • Partners with Special Investigation Unit and Subrogation to identify fraud and subrogation opportunities. Assists or prepares files for lawsuit, trial or subrogation.

  • Initiates and conducts follow-ups by proficient use of claims and other related business systems.

  • Delivers an outstanding customer service experience to all internal, external, current and prospective Nationwide customers. Adheres to high standards of professional conduct while providing delivery of outstanding claim's service.

May perform other responsibilities as assigned.

Reporting Relationships: Reports to Claims Manager. Individual contributor role.

Typical Skills and Experience:

Education: Undergraduate degree or equivalent experience.

License/Certification/Designation: State licensing where required. Successful completion of required applicable claims certification training or classes. Obtain Xactimate Level 1 certification within a year of start date. Obtain Xactimate Level 2 certification within two years of employment.

Experience: Three to five years of related property claims experience. Experience in a customer service environment including flexible work schedules and extended work hours preferred.

Knowledge, Abilities and Skills: General knowledge of insurance theory and practices, and contracts and their application. Property estimating and automated claims systems. Demonstrated knowledge of the investigation, consultation and settlement activities used to resolve extensive property damage claims. Proven ability to meet customer needs and provide exemplary meaningful service by guiding customers through the claims process and ensuring a positive customer experience. Analytical and problem-solving skills necessary to make decisions and resolve issues related to application of coverages to submitted claims, application of laws of jurisdiction to investigation facts, and application of policy exclusions and exceptions. Ability to establish repair requirements and cost estimates for property losses. Ability to evaluate and successfully advise on property claims. Organizational skills to prioritize work. Command of written and verbal communication skills to effectively communicate with policyholders, claimants, repairpersons, attorneys, agents and the general public. Ability to efficiently operate a personal computer and related claims and business software. Able to provide leadership to less experienced claims associates. Must be able to safely access and inspect rooftops using a ladder.  Must be prepared and capable of conductingphysical inspections on rooftops, including first and second story roofs with pitches up to 8/12.

Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence.

Staffing exceptions to the above must be approved by the business unit executive and HR Business Partner.

Values: Regularly and consistently demonstrates the Nationwide Values.

Job conditions:

Overtime Eligibility: Eligible (Non-Exempt)

Working Conditions: Normal office or field claims environment. May require ability to sit and operate phone and personal computer for extended periods of time. Able to make physical inspections of property loss sites; including climb ladders, balance at various heights and rooftops up to 8/12 pitch stoop, bend and/or crawl to inspect vehicles and structures; work outside in all types of weather. Must be willing to work irregular hours and to travel with possible overnight requirements. May be on-call. Must be available to work catastrophes (CAT). Extended and/or non-standard hours as required. Must have a valid driver’s license with satisfactory driving record in accordance with Nationwide standards.

Credit/Background Check: Due to the fiduciary accountabilities within this job, a valid credit check and/or background check will be required as part of the selection process.

jobs.excerpt: We're on a mission to be a Force For Good, through our People, Products and Purpose at Nuix.
jobs.description:
We're on a mission to be a Force For Good, through our People, Products and Purpose at Nuix. This extends to our People. We're fiercely passionate, love working at pace, thrive in ambiguity, live, and breathe outside of the box, and above all are good humans. We're determined to make a positive difference in the world, whether through our solutions which help the top companies, governments and agencies find the truth and combat illegal activities, or through our people who care about contributing and giving back both within, and outside, of Nuix. We are a Force For Good. We're selective about who comes on board, and you should be too. But if the above sounds like a match, get in touch today and get ready for the possibility of starting a once-in-a-career journey.

This Role Is About Relationships

Nuix is seeking an experienced Enterprise Account Executive whose greatest asset is not simply a history of exceeding sales quota, but the ability to build trusted relationships with senior decision makers across large corporate and regulated enterprises.

As part of our GTM strategy focused on accelerating market penetration through trusted customer and partner relationships, we are looking for an executive who can engage senior stakeholders, understand complex business priorities, and develop strategic opportunities across the enterprise technology landscape.

This is not a traditional territory-building role. It is a market expansion role focused on identifying, developing, and converting opportunities across large enterprises and their strategic partner ecosystems.

The successful candidate will demonstrate a strong track record of cultivating executive relationships, navigating complex enterprise sales environments, and developing partnerships that create access to new opportunities. You should understand how enterprise technology decisions are made and procured and be able to credibly engage stakeholders including CIOs, CDOs, CISOs, General Counsel, Heads of Data & Analytics, and their teams.

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate an ability to establish relationships with senior decision makers, create new opportunities, and advance complex enterprise sales conversations involving multiple stakeholders, lengthy sales cycles, and significant business impact.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated success selling enterprise technology into highly regulated industries, such as:

  • Financial Services

  • Insurance

  • Venture Capital

  • Energy & Utilities

  • Mining & Natural Resources

  • Telecommunications

  • Healthcare

  • Pharmaceuticals

  • Transportation & Logistics

  • Construction & Real Estate

  • Retail

  • Agriculture, Forestry & Fishing

Equally important, the successful candidate will have experience developing and managing relationships throughout the partner ecosystem, including national and regional Systems Integrators, advisory firms, VARs, and other strategic technology partners.

Location

Remote — based within reasonable commuting distance of Toronto, Ontario.

The successful candidate should be able to attend customer, partner, and company meetings in the Greater Toronto Area as required.

Key Responsibilities

The deepest parts of the ocean are the least explored, yet they hold some of the planet’s rarest and most valuable finds. Enterprise data is much the same. Only 10–20% has been analyzed for strategic value, while the remaining 80–90% is largely unstructured and often considered too costly or difficult to access. Nuix data intelligence technology fills this gap, enabling organizations to explore and understand this “deep data” alongside relevant structured data.

Unlike enterprise analytics platforms that often require extensive customization and lengthy consulting engagements across disparate solutions, Nuix delivers rapid time-to-value through a unified platform designed to automate complex investigations, data intelligence, and AI-driven analysis.

Its applications span internal investigations, cyber incident response, privacy, compliance, mergers and acquisitions, and enterprise data intelligence—bringing diverse data sources together to connect entities and events and generate actionable intelligence.

The Nuix Neo platform rapidly aggregates, processes, analyzes, and visualizes massive volumes of structured and unstructured information within a unified analytical and investigative environment. Its graph technology and link analysis correlate data from virtually any source, revealing hidden relationships and connections between entities.

This enables analysts and executives to uncover insights, accelerate decisions, and manage risk with greater confidence.

Nuix data intelligence technology is already established across Canada's public sector, including law enforcement, public safety, justice, and regulatory organizations. Your role is to bring these capabilities to commercial executives who are transforming their organizations through data, analytics, and AI.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop and leverage strategic customer and partner relationships to expand Nuix's footprint across commercial markets and drive long-term growth.

  • Identify, qualify, and develop new enterprise opportunities across target customer segments and industries.

  • Engage senior executives and business stakeholders to understand strategic priorities and connect them to Nuix's capabilities.

  • Build trusted relationships across multiple levels of complex enterprise organizations and navigate diverse stakeholder groups.

  • Develop strategic partnerships that increase market access through established contracts, partner-led engagements, and joint go-to-market opportunities.

  • Identify opportunities where Nuix can consolidate, analyze, and visualize enterprise data to solve complex business and investigative challenges.

  • Lead enterprise sales opportunities from initial executive engagement through contract execution.

  • Develop account and opportunity strategies that align customer priorities with Nuix's solutions and commercial objectives.

  • Partner closely with Solution Engineers, Professional Services, Customer Success, Marketing, and executive leadership throughout the sales cycle.

  • Consistently build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified enterprise opportunities.

  • Forecast accurately and maintain disciplined opportunity management throughout the sales cycle.

  • Demonstrate fluency in a structured enterprise sales methodology applied to long and complex sales cycles. Practical experience applying MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Challenger, or an equivalent framework to qualify, advance, and close opportunities spanning multiple quarters is preferred.

  • Represent Nuix at relevant industry, customer, and partner events to develop relationships and generate new business opportunities.

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

The successful candidate will bring:

  • Proven experience selling enterprise technology, software, SaaS, data intelligence, cybersecurity, analytics, investigations, or a related solution into complex organizations.

  • A demonstrated track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets in enterprise environments.

  • Experience engaging senior executives and navigating complex, multi-stakeholder buying processes.

  • Strong business development skills, with the ability to create opportunities through relationship development, strategic outreach, referrals, partnerships, and other channels.

  • Experience developing and maintaining strategic customer and partner relationships.

  • Experience selling into one or more highly regulated industries, such as financial services, insurance, energy, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, telecommunications, transportation, or other complex enterprise environments.

  • Experience working with Systems Integrators, advisory firms, VARs, or other strategic technology partners.

  • Strong understanding of enterprise technology procurement and the ability to navigate legal, procurement, security, compliance, and executive approval processes.

  • Experience managing complex, multi-quarter enterprise sales cycles with multiple decision makers and influencers.

  • Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

  • Experience with MEDDIC, MEDDPICC, Challenger, or another structured enterprise sales methodology.

  • Ability to operate independently in a remote environment while collaborating effectively across a global organization.

  • A growth mindset, strong accountability, and the ability to operate effectively in an evolving and ambiguous environment.

Compensation

The expected base salary range for this position is CAD $150,000–$175,000, with flexibility depending on experience, qualifications, skills, and other relevant factors.

This position may also be eligible for additional compensation, including sales incentive compensation, and benefits in accordance with Nuix's applicable plans and programs.

About Nuix:

Nuix is on an incredible journey of transformation, aligning our strengths with our ambitions to pursue greater opportunities. As we expand our global team and extend our skills and expertise, we are unified as one Nuix team guided by our shared values.

Vision:Finding Truth in a Digital World.

Mission:Nuix creates innovative software that empowers organisations to simply and quickly find the truth from any data in a digital world. We are a passionate and talented team, delighting our customers with software that transforms data into actionable intelligence.

EEO STATEMENT:Republic Services is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, relationship or association with a protected veteran (spouses or other family members), genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

  • Dow Jones Best-In-Class Indices
  • Ethisphere’s World’s Most Ethical Companies
  • Fortune World’s Most Admired Companies

jobs.title: VP, In Vitro - Scientific Operations
jobs.excerpt: Grow Your Career Where Talent Meets Innovation Job Summary:The Global VP of In Vitro Scientific Operations will lead Crown Bioscience’s global in vitro operations across the US, APAC, and Europe, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, decision-enabling data for oncology and immunology drug discovery programs.
jobs.description:
Grow Your Career Where Talent Meets Innovation


Job Summary:

The Global VP of In Vitro Scientific Operations will lead Crown Bioscience’s global in vitro operations across the US, APAC, and Europe, ensuring the delivery of high-quality, decision-enabling data for oncology and immunology drug discovery programs. This role oversees global assay platforms, multi-site scientific teams, operational strategy, and capability expansion across cell-based, immunology, imaging-based, and translational in vitro systems.

The VP will drive scientific excellence, standardize operations, harmonize workflows across regions, and partner closely with Commercial, R&I and cross-functional scientific groups to ensure operational reliability, scientific rigor, and client satisfaction. This leader must be able to connect in vitro science with in vivo, biomarker, and translational workflows to support integrated project delivery—consistent with Crown’s end-to-end service model.

Responsibilities:

Global Operational & Scientific Leadership

  • Lead all global in vitro scientific operations across Crown’s sites.
  • Ensure consistent and high-quality execution of in vitro studies, maintaining strong scientific rigor, reproducibility, and translational relevance.
  • Drive operational efficiencies through standardized workflows, SOP harmonization, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Operational Excellence & Delivery

  • Oversee end-to-end operational workflows, including study design support, resource planning, execution, QC, reporting, and on-time delivery.
  • Drive improvements in productivity, reproducibility, cycle time, and cross-site alignment.
  • Establish and track operational KPIs (quality, timeliness, resource utilization, client satisfaction).

Platform Expansion & Scientific Capability Development

  • Identify opportunities to expand and modernize in vitro capabilities.
  • Lead implementation of new technologies, automation, and translational assays supporting MoA, PK/PD linkage, and IND-enabling studies.
  • Partner with biomarker, in vivo, and translational science leaders to ensure integration across platforms.

Client Engagement & BD Support

  • Act as a senior scientific representative for key client meetings, supporting proposal development, study design, troubleshooting, and data interpretation.
  • Support BD strategy with strong scientific storytelling, customer retention insights, and expansion of strategic partnerships.
  • Guide teams in translating client program objectives into actionable in vitro study plans.

Cross-Functional Scientific Collaboration

  • Ensure alignment between scientific operations, project management, quality, and commercial teams.
  • Support cross-site initiatives, including platform harmonization and global capability mapping.

Global Leadership, Talent Development & Culture

  • Build a high-performance culture emphasizing scientific rigor, innovation, accountability, and client-centricity.
  • Provide strategic mentorship, succession planning, and competency development across assay platforms.

Financial & Resource Management

  • Oversee global in vitro budgets, headcount planning, capital equipment strategy, and site capacity allocations.
  • Support revenue planning, operational forecasting, and margin optimization.
  • Partner with finance and senior leadership to drive operational efficiency and scalability.

Minimum Requirements:

  • Ph.D. in cancer biology, immunology, pharmacology, molecular/cell biology, or related discipline.
  • 10+ years of experience in oncology/immunology preclinical research with deep expertise in in vitro assay platforms.
  • 7+ years of leadership experience managing scientific teams, ideally across multiple global sites.
  • Demonstrated track record in CRO scientific operations, with strong understanding of client expectations and data delivery requirements.
  • Extensive experience designing, executing, and interpreting mechanistic in vitro assays, immune effector studies, co-culture systems, and imaging-based platforms.
  • Proven ability to manage operational workflows, introduce new capabilities, and ensure high-quality scientific output.
  • Excellent communication skills, with experience in client-facing scientific roles.

Preferred Requirements:

  • Experience leading multi-site or global scientific operations within a CRO or service-based company.
  • Expertise with advanced or emerging in vitro technologies.
  • Deep understanding of oncology, immuno-oncology, and translational biology.
  • Strong program or portfolio management exposure within scientific operations.
  • Strong commercial partnership history with BD teams and biotech/pharma clients.
  • Cross-cultural leadership experience and ability to manage teams across time zones.

Join the world's largest HVAC company, named by Forbes as one of America's Best-In-State Employers 2025!

This role is a high-impact executive role responsible for leading the end-to-end supply chain organization. This leader will design and execute global strategies across materials management, demand and supply planning, inventory optimization, and logistics. A primary mandate of this role is to champion and mature the Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SIOP / S&OP) process, driving cross-functional alignment between Sales, Operations, Finance, and Product Management to support business growth and customer fulfillment goals.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic SIOP Leadership

  • Own and mature the enterprise SIOP framework to effectively balance market demand with manufacturing and supplier capacity.
  • Lead monthly SIOP executive review cadences, driving alignment on a single consensus demand, supply, and inventory plan utilized for financial forecasting.
  • Perform scenario planning and rough-cut capacity analysis to support demand shifts, new product introductions (NPI), and product lifecycle transitions.

Materials Management & Production Planning

  • Oversee global material planning and execution processes to ensure uninterrupted supply and optimized material flow across all manufacturing facilities.
  • Govern Material Requirements Planning (MRP) system discipline, data integrity, and parameters (e.g., lead times, MOQs, and lot sizes).
  • Strengthen production control and scheduling mechanisms to optimize shop-floor resource utilization.

Supply Chain Strategy & Inventory Optimization

  • Drive working capital performance by establishing strict Days of On-Hand (DOH) targets and reducing Excess & Obsolete (E&O) inventory.
  • Identify, mitigate, and resolve long-range supply chain risks, including labor, equipment, tariff exposure, and material constraints.
  • Design dashboards and KPI scorecards to track forecast accuracy, supplier execution, on-time delivery (OTD), and total supply chain costs.

Inventory Control & Optimization

  • Drive working capital performance by establishing strict Days of On-Hand (DOH) targets, striking a precise balance between peak-season readiness and off-season reduction.
  • Implement robust inventory tracking mechanisms, including multi-site cycle counting and warehouse management systems (WMS) to maximize accuracy.
  • Minimize Excess & Obsolete (E&O) inventory through rigorous management of phase-out components, engineering change notices (ECNs), and legacy replacement parts.

Team Leadership & Supplier Partnerships

  • Provide executive-level guidance and mentorship to a global team of supply planners, materials managers, and analyst professionals.
  • Cultivate strategic relationships with tier-1 vendors, holding partners accountable to contractual commitments and delivery metrics.
  • Foster continuous process improvements utilizing Lean Six-Sigma methodologies to eliminate operational waste and enhance scalability.

Role Requirements & Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Engineering, or a related field is required; an MBA or advanced degree is strongly preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience in global supply chain planning, materials management, and SIOP within a manufacturing environment.
  • Proven track record of successfully implementing or scaling enterprise-wide SIOP / S&OP processes across matrixed organizations.

Technical Skills & Certifications

  • Deep proficiency in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and advanced planning tools (e.g., SAP/IBP, Anaplan).
  • Expert-level knowledge of MRP architecture, demand analytics, and lean supply chain principles.
  • Professional certifications such as APICS CSCP, CPIM, or a Six Sigma Green/Black Belt are highly desirable.

Leadership Competencies

  • Exceptional cross-functional influence with the ability to build consensus between high-level sales, finance, and manufacturing stakeholders.
  • Strong financial acumen with a clear history of tying physical material movements to P&L outcomes and working capital metrics.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20%–30% to corporate sites and supplier locations as needed.

HVAC Logistics & Distribution Network

  • Optimize outbound distribution strategies for finished goods, managing complex logistics networks servicing commercial distributors, residential contractors, and job sites.
  • Manage inbound freight operations, mitigating risks associated with long-lead international components and bulky, heavy-gauge raw materials.
  • Cultivate strategic relationships with third-party logistics (3PL) providers and freight forwarders to optimize total landed cost and transportation efficiency.

HVAC Industry Competency

  • Deep understanding of HVAC supply chain dynamics, including regional seasonality, weather-correlation modeling, and distributor channel behaviors.
  • Familiarity with HVAC regulatory frameworks, including EPA refrigerant regulations, DOE energy efficiency mandates, and UL safety standards.
  • Technical comprehension of HVAC bill of materials (BOMs), commodity pricing indexation (copper/steel), and international sourcing constraints.

Systems & Analytics Expertise

  • Advanced proficiency in Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and dedicated SIOP/Advanced Planning tools (e.g., SAP/IBP, Kinaxis).
  • Expertise in material optimization frameworks, including Safety Stock calculations, Economic Order Quantity (EOQ), and ABC/XYZ analysis.
  • Strong command of logistics metrics, such as On-Time In-Full (OTIF), freight-as-a-percent-of-sales, and warehouse utilization rates.

Position Overview

The Prescription Access Specialist is responsible for driving engagement with clinicians and office staff to expand GoodRx Prescription Services utilization under DistributeRx. This role focuses on removing prescription access barriers, increasing medication fulfillment, and supporting clinicians in providing cost-effective solutions for patients.

A successful candidate will take ownership of their territory, leveraging a consultative approach to educate prescribers and staff on GoodRx Prescription Services as a streamlined alternative for prescription fulfillment.

About the Company:

DistributeRx is an affiliate of Mayne Pharma Group Limited. We area modern healthcare solutions company transforming how medications reach patients. We partner with pharmaceutical manufacturers across the product lifecycle — from pre-launch strategy and product launch to growth optimization and mature-brand support. Our integrated services span sales strategy, patient affordability and adherence programs, pharmacy network management, and data analytics, reducing friction throughout the distribution process. The result is stronger product adoption for manufacturers, transparent pricing for clinicians, and more consistent access to therapy for patients.

Key Responsibility Areas

  • Clinician Engagement & Education: Build and maintain strong relationships with clinicians educating them on GoodRx Prescription Services solutions that enhance prescription accessibility and improve patient adherence.
  • Prescription Fulfillment Growth: Drive adoption of GoodRx Prescription Services by strategically positioning GoodRx Prescription Services as a trusted, cost-effective, and hassle-free alternative to traditional prescription fulfillment.
  • Market Development & Execution: Analyze territory trends and develop targeted access strategies to maximize script volume while ensuring seamless implementation of GoodRx Prescription Services solutions.
  • Patient Access Advocacy: Partner with clinicians and their offices to help remove barriers to prescription access, providing actionable insights that allow prescribers to offer cost savings and predictable pricing options.
  • Business Performance & Sales Execution: Own and drive sales objectives within an assigned territory, proactively identifying opportunities for increased GoodRx Prescription Services utilization and prescription conversion.

Specific Responsibilities:

  • Develop strategic clinician engagement plans to increase awareness and adoption of GoodRx Prescription Services.
  • Collaborate with offices, prescribers, and pharmacy liaisons to drive seamless prescription fulfillment and patient access.
  • Analyze prescribing trends and access barriers to positionGoodRx Prescription Services as a viable solution.
  • Educate healthcare professionals and staff on cost savings, formulary exclusions, and access hurdles that GoodRx Prescription Services can help address.
  • Track and measure key performance indicators (KPIs), including prescription volume, fulfillment rates, and clinician adoption.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Key Competencies/Requirements:

  • Integrity: Consistently operates with honesty and ethical judgement, ensuring all activities align with company polices, industry regulations, and compliance standards. Builds trust withpartners through transparency, reliability, and accountability.
  • Innovation: Proactively identifies new opportunities and creative solutions to drive pharmacy growth, improve access, and enhance customer outcomes. Adapts quickly to market changes and leverages data, tools, and insights to improve performance.
  • Transparency:Communicates openly and accurately with internal teams and pharmacy partners, providing clear updates on performance, challenges, and opportunities. Shares information proactively to support informed decision making.
  • Collaboration:Works cross-functionally with internal stakeholders and external pharmacy partners to achieve shared goals and deliver strong customer outcomes. Actively seeks input, builds strong relationships, and contributes to a team-first culture.
  • Customer/Patient Focus: Develops trusted partnerships withclinicians, office staff, and patients and effectively influences workflows and behaviors to drive adoption and improve patient access and affordability.
  • Sales & Business Acumen:Demonstrates strong territory planning, data analysis, and prioritization to identify opportunities, guide strategy, and execute effectively. Uses insights and performance metrics to drive GoodRx Prescription Services adoption and maximize prescription fulfillment.
  • Self-Starter & Accountable: Demonstrates an ownership mindset by proactively planning and preparing for accounts, aligning activities to goals and milestones, and taking full accountability for execution, follow-through, and results.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s Degree required
  • Minimum 1-2 years of direct sales experience; pharmaceutical sales strongly preferred
  • Strong presentation skills (both oral and written) required
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and acceptable driving record
  • Must have strong computer skills (including MS Office and Sales Force software)

Physical Requirements:

  • Business travel required
  • Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs. frequently

General Statement

DistributeRx is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Any communication you receive from DistributeRx will never come from a personal email domain or chat service such as "Gmail" or "Google Chat". All official communication from DistributeRx will be received from our company email domain - @distributerx.com.

jobs.excerpt: Role and team: We are looking for an experienced Senior Auditor to support planning and lead execution of global and/or regional operational and integrated audits spanning business operational controls, IT general controls and application controls.
jobs.description:
Role and team:

We are looking for an experienced Senior Auditor to support planning and lead execution of global and/or regional operational and integrated audits spanning business operational controls, IT general controls and application controls. This remote position will be reporting to Director, Internal Audit Management. You’ll also help build the next version of Internal Audit by designing AI-enabled tools and automations that change how audits get done, not just using the tools others hand you.

We have a tight team environment where support, loyalty, and honest feedback are the currency. ServiceNow employees are expected to be self-starting, proactive, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Support planning and scoping of operational and integrated audits across business and IT operations. Complete assignments efficiently and timely.
  • Conduct walkthroughs, evaluate process design, and perform controls testing across both business processes and IT systems, consistently delivering quality audit work papers that support and substantiate audit observations.
  • Identify manual or repetitive steps in the audit lifecycle and build AI-enabled solutions to automate them, such as prompt workflows, AI agents, scripts, or data pipelines for evidence gathering, testing, and workpaper drafting.
  • Use data analytics and AI to test full populations when possible, identify control gaps, quantify risk exposure, and deliver data-driven insights to management.
  • Document and share what you build so the team can reuse it, and help shape Internal Audit’s AI playbook.
  • Assist in producing high-quality Internal Audit reports by clearly drafting audit issues and developing valid conclusions resulting in process and internal control improvements, while considering implementation requirements, cost, and stakeholder feedback.
  • Timely and effective communication with audit leads on audit status, escalations, issues, and reporting.
  • Perform action tracking follow-up with management for Audit Committee reporting purposes.
  • Participate in major business initiatives and proactively advise and assist the business on key risks, control environment, and change initiatives.
  • Contribute to the evolution of Internal Audit methodology, automation, and reporting, including ServiceNow IRM to scale audit coverage and quality.
  • Responsible for internal stakeholder engagement, including the development of working relationships with key stakeholders and proudly representing the Internal Audit function.

To be successful in this role, you have:

  • A passion for Internal Audit and strong desire to be part of a stellar IA team!
  • Minimum 4-year degree (or US equivalent) from an accredited university; degree in Management Information Systems, Finance and Accounting strongly preferred.
  • Minimum of 5 years’ work experience, with 3 years at a public accounting firm (Big 4 or national consulting firm preferred), including experience in internal auditing, external auditing, SOX, operations and process improvement.
  • Demonstrated experience auditing both IT general controls and application controls, and business operational processes. Comfort moving fluidly between technology and business-process audits, including within the same integrated engagement.
  • Understanding of data governance and privacy compliance, and the ability to apply system architecture knowledge to the processes being reviewed.
  • Understanding of risks and controls in modern technology environments. Awareness of AI/GenAI governance and model risk considerations.
  • Builder track record: you’ve built something, such as a tool, automation, script, or AI workflow, that solved a real problem in your work. Be ready to walk us through it.
  • Hands-on experience with generative AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) beyond basic chat, such as building custom prompts, agents, or automated workflows.
  • Good understanding of business and operations, strong analytical and project management skills.
  • Proficiency in Excel and process mapping tools. Hands-on experience with data analytics tools such as Power BI. Experience with SAP preferred.
  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills; ability to identify and conduct root cause analysis.
  • Excellent verbal, written, oral communication and presentation skills.
  • Ability to work both independently and as a team member.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks concurrently, efficiently and effectively with minimal oversight.
  • Familiarity with the ServiceNow platform, including IRM modules, a strong plus
  • (Preferred) At least one of the following certifications: CISA, CISM, CIA, CPA
  • Prefer candidates with exposure to a high growth and/or rapidly changing technology enterprise.

As an Associate Client Director, you’ll lead a team of Client Managers, Associate Client Managers and Analysts; guiding and coaching them to support clients to analyze data through use of NIQ tools and services, based on NIQ standards and service model to ensure clients are delivered insights on industries, markets and consumers so that they make informed business decisions. Responsible to drive NIQ's CS Industry Insights mission for their team through delivery of Thought Leadership and accountable for the on-target delivery of team KPIs.

Responsibilities

  • Own CS Industry Insights mission for the team through delivery of Thought Leadership.
  • Ensure team delivers as per the relevant KPIs/ success metrics.
  • Drive Service Model and JBPs execution strongly.
  • Ensure all team members complete the Academy in time and with success, developing probing skills to identify and uncover the most important business questions for their clients & hold the team accountable for delivery of insights as per Academy learnings.
  • Continuously guide and coach your team in utilizing and visualizing the most relevant data for developing strategically impactful presentations full of insights and proactive recommendations.
  • Manage and guide the team to manage 'clients' expectations' in project scoping, prioritization, time management and adhering to JBP priorities. 
  • Demonstrate and guide team on solid question probing skills to identify and uncover the most important business questions for client(s). 
  • Lead generation: Display a full understanding of all NIQ portfolio of services and products as well as 'incremental offerings', and identify, create, and convert opportunities to incremental sales through strong client relationships & partnerships.
  • Client briefing: Ensure the team receives client briefing as per the briefing form with all areas filled and client probing is done for clarity. Carry key accountability to client and hub that the team delivers fully completed (with quality inputs) briefing forms.
  • Proactively partner with necessary senior stakeholders to prevent potential roadblocks and to remove them when they arise. 
  • Drive customer satisfaction, ensuring the team delivers the best-in-class  analyses and relevant and impactful insights.
  • Be a bi-lingual (CPS+RMS) team leader/ strategist:
    • Demonstrate an everyday Consumer- driven marketing culture.
    • Probe and provoke clients to more business questions to analyze consumer behavior.
    • Generate CPS Leads (upsell contracts, ad-hoc, CAS).
    • Persuade win-back clients on NIQ's superior CPS proposition.
  • 7+ years of experience in the CPG industry and/or related sales, category management, market research.
  • Prior experience with NielsenIQ (or similar) solutions preferred in analytics space, including POS/Panel data.
  • Strong analytical mind and excellent numerical skills.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Google Sheets/Slides.
  • Excellent command of both written and spoken English.
  • Digital savvy.
  • Fast learner of concepts/ tools/ analyses.
  • Display ability to incorporate deep industry knowledge and Thought Leadership into analyses.
  • Proficiency in pulling, analyzing, and incorporating all NIQ data sources that are relevant to the client(s) – i.e. RMS, Homescan, Omni, Spectra, etc. 
  • Proficiency in utilizing Discover and helping diminish/eliminate client concerns & roadblocks in order to drive usage. 
  • Ability to coach others in data analyses and working with the NIQ tools.

This role has a market-competitive salary with an anticipated base compensation of the following range: $99,800 - $112,420. Actual salaries will vary depending on a candidate’s experience, qualifications, skills, and location. This role might also be eligible for a sales-based incentive or performance-based bonus. Other benefits include a flexible working environment, comprehensive health insurance, industry-leading parental leave, life insurance, education support and more.

  • Comprehensive healthcare plan (medical, Rx, dental and vision). 
  • Flexible spending accounts and Health Savings Account (including company contributions). 
  • Life and AD&D insurance. 
  • 401(k) retirement plan including company matching contributions. 
  • Disability insurance. 
  • Tuition Reimbursement. 
  • Discretionary paid time off program and 11 paid holidays.

Our Benefits

  • Flexible working environment

If you have GDS experience and are looking for a stable remote career where your travel knowledge is valued, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Position Title: Senior Project Manager

Studio/Department: Operations

Employee Type: Full Time, Regular

Location: Remote ( within BC, Canada)

Salary Range: $90,000 - $100,000 CAD

Ravenwake Games is the newest studio within Enad Global 7, a global leader in video game development and publishing. Backed by iconic franchises such as EverQuest®, PlanetSide®, DC Universe™ Online, Dungeons & Dragons Online®, The Lord of the Rings Online™, Magic: The Gathering Online, and MechWarrior®, we draw on a legacy of genre‑defining experiences. We’re committed to delivering entertainment that inspires, engages, and unites players around the world. At Ravenwake Games, our mission is to craft immersive worlds that bring players together, build vibrant communities, and deliver unforgettable gameplay at every turn.

Description

The Senior Project Manager is responsible for driving the overall planning, management and completion of Operations projects across our organization and its affiliates. The Senior Project Manager is responsible for providing delivery leadership and execution support to multiple shared services teams and game teams across our studios. This role focuses on enabling teams by driving technically complex initiatives—such as platform services, tooling, infrastructure, and cross-studio programs—rather than owning feature delivery within a single game team.

The ideal candidate is technically fluent, comfortable operating across multiple stakeholders, and excels at bringing structure, visibility, and predictability to projects that span teams, disciplines, and time zones. The ideal candidate understands game development pipelines, can speak the language of engineers and technical leads, and brings structure, predictability, and risk management to fast-moving creative environments.

Key Responsibilities

Project & Program Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of complex projects (e.g., service upgrades, tooling, integrations, live ops initiatives).
  • Define project scope, milestones, dependencies, and delivery plans across multiple teams and time zones.
  • Drive execution against schedules while balancing quality, technical debt, and production realities.
  • Define standardized project management processes, tools, workflows.
  • Mentor other project managers

Cross-Team Project Leadership

  • Lead and coordinate initiatives that support multiple game teams and shared services teams.
  • Own integrated project plans, milestones, dependencies, and delivery timelines.
  • Enable alignment and execution without direct line management authority over delivery teams.

Technical Enablement & Partnership

  • Translate technical strategies and architectural decisions into clear execution plans, timelines, and risks.
  • Ensure teams have visibility into delivery progress, impacts, and adoption timelines.
  • Partner closely with stakeholders to translate designs into executable project plans.
  • Act as a bridge between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring clarity and alignment.

Process & Delivery Governance

  • Establish and maintain consistent project management practices across shared services initiatives.
  • Facilitate planning, execution, and retrospectives for cross-team efforts with a focus on delivery outcomes.
  • Track progress and delivery metrics, manage dependencies and risks; proactively escalate and resolve blockers.
  • Implement and continuously improve methodologies and processes.

Stakeholder & Communication Management

  • Act as a primary point of coordination between shared services teams and supported game teams.
  • Provide clear, concise status reporting to studio leadership and senior stakeholders.
  • Manage expectations and trade-offs across competing priorities and timelines.
  • Communicate status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to studio leadership and stakeholders.
  • Align project priorities with product, publishing, and business objectives.
  • Support go-to-market timelines, certification, and launch readiness.

Risk, Dependency & Change Management

  • Identify, understand, and manage technical, operational, and resourcing risks that may impact teams.
  • Drive mitigation plans and manage changes while minimizing disruption.
  • Support release coordination, rollout planning, and adoption of shared services and tools.
  • Manage change requests while protecting team focus and delivery commitments.
  • Ensure lessons learned are captured and applied.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of senior project or program management experience in technical or software-driven organizations.
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field; PMP or CSM certification is preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience managing cross-team, shared-services initiatives.
  • Experience with budget planning, ROI analysis
  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, infrastructure, and technical delivery models.
  • High degree of initiative, self-starter, looks for opportunities to make improvements
  • Experience working in data analytics a plus
  • Proven ability to influence and coordinate without direct ownership of delivery teams.
  • Excellent communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with high interdependency.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage deeply with technical teams.
  • Ability to pivot quickly when priorities shift, demonstrating both adaptability and agility.
  • Excellent and effective problem solving and time management skills.
  • Creative, self-driven with a strong work ethic.
  • Administrative knowledge and experience of Jira and Confluence with hands on experience in setting up projects, dashboards, reporting capabilities, and custom JQL filters.
  • Solid Microsoft Excel skills (e.g., functions, formulas, PivotTables, data validation, charts)
  • Game Industry experience and a passion for games especially MMOs
  • Comfortable reviewing technical documentation, architecture diagrams, and release plans.
  • Experience working in a centralized/shared services organization

Be Aware of Fraudulent Recruiting Activities

Ravenwake Games will never ask applicants for social insurance numbers, date of birth, bank account information or other sensitive information in job applications. Additionally, our recruiters do not communicate with applicants through free e-mail accounts (Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or through online messaging apps (WhatsApp, Hangouts). We will never ask applicants to provide payment during the hiring process or extend an offer without conducting a phone, live video or in-person interview.

**Ravenwake is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

  • Ability to produce quality materials within tight time frames and simultaneously manage several projects.

jobs.description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Lead SailPoint Solutions Engineer is the senior technical execution owner responsible for designing, implementing, and sustaining Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) solutions across the organization. Working in close partnership with the Lead IGA Solutions Architect, this role is accountable for translating architectural strategy, reference designs, and governance models into scalable, supportable, and operational IGA implementations—primarily within SailPoint Identity Security Cloud (ISC).

This position serves as the authoritative engineering lead for the IGA platform. Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Applications for this position will be accepted on an ongoing basis.

Modern warfare is a data problem. As a MuleSoft Account Executive for COCOMs, you will be at the center of the military’s most critical priority: Interoperability. Your mission is to help Combatant Commands break down data silos across disparate legacy systems, partner nation networks, and "at-the-edge" environments. You will position MuleSoft as the connective tissue for initiatives such as Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2), enabling a unified data layer that connects data at the edge.

Key Responsibilities

  • The "Integration First" Strategy: Position MuleSoft’s Anypoint Platform and DataGraph as the standard for API-led connectivity across COCOM J-code directorates.
  • JADC2 & Mission Partner Environment (MPE): Drive adoption of secure data-sharing frameworks between the US and coalition partners to ensure seamless coordination during joint exercises and real-world operations.
  • Legacy Modernization: Help COCOMs move away from "brittle" point-to-point integrations and custom-coded middleware toward a scalable, governed API ecosystem.
  • Complex Stakeholder Management: Navigate the "Three-Legged Stool" of defense sales: the COCOM end-user, the Service Component, and the Systems Integrator (SI) executing the program.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Salesforce "Core" AEs to provide the integration layer that powers CRM, Tableau, and Slack mission sets.

Required Qualifications

The Senior Manager, Risk Intelligence & Decision Support leads the analytics and decision support elements of the Risk Automation & Intelligence portfolio, including the Key Risk Indicators and the process instrumentation and internal performance indicators that are core to GSK's Risk Operations Centre. This is a delivery leadership role combining hands-on work with team and stakeholder management. This role is critical in enabling leaders at all levels and functions of GSK to rapidly identify, evaluate and make decisions on risk, and in providing assurance that compliance requirements are met.


About the team. Risk Intelligence and Decision Support turns GSK's cyber risk data into decisions, and is a core part of GSK's Risk Operations Centre. The team builds the data platform, analytics and reporting that tell CSO leadership and the business where risk actually sits, what to do about it, and how effectively and efficiently the risk and compliance programme itself is operating.


Key responsibilities:

This role will provide you the opportunity to lead key activities to progress your career. These responsibilities include some of the following:

  • Lead a defined area of the capability, including its people, delivery and outcomes.

  • Bring a product management and Agile delivery mindset to the roadmap for risk intelligence and decision support tooling, working with business and business-facing teams to capture voice of customer and prioritise features.
  • Develop team capability through coaching, review and structured feedback.
  • Represent the area in CSO governance and cross-functional forums.
  • Own the Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) used across GSK, ensuring they are meaningful, well-defined and consistently reported and aligned to GSK enterprise risk management priorities.
  • Define and instrument the internal performance indicators that measure the effectiveness and efficiency of the Risk and Compliance programme itself, as a core input to the Risk Operations Centre.
  • Build and maintain the data platform underpinning cyber risk intelligence and reporting.
  • Work with partner teams to engineer data pipelines that bring risk, control, threat and asset data into a single model.

  • Experience in data modelling and pipeline development.

The Senior Vice President (SVP), Clinical Development – Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care provides strategic, scientific, and operational leadership across global clinical development programs within the Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care (CMIC) therapeutic areas. This executive role is responsible for ensuring the successful delivery of complex, high-value studies across all phases, driving operational excellence, financial performance, innovation, and client satisfaction.

As a senior member of the Global Project Management leadership team, this individual shapes the organization’s therapeutic delivery strategy, ensures scientific and operational rigor, and fosters high-impact partnerships with clients and internal stakeholders. The SVP, CMIC acts as a trusted advisor and scientific authority within Cardiology, Metabolic Disorders, Critical Care, and related domains—bringing both credibility and vision to drive Syneos Health’s position as a market leader in these therapeutic areas.

Key Responsibilities:

Impact to the Organization

  • Directly influences Syneos Health’s success in the Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care therapeutic areas by ensuring delivery excellence, strengthening client partnerships, and driving innovation across clinical operations.

Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the strategic vision for Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care delivery, aligning clinical execution with corporate goals and client expectations.

  • Anticipate emerging trends and therapeutic innovations to position Syneos Health as the preferred partner in these therapeutic areas.

  • Drive organizational strategy for operational excellence, scalability, and delivery modernization.

  • Collaborate closely with senior leaders to align project delivery with enterprise objectives and strategic growth priorities.

Scientific Authority & External Influence

  • Act as a recognized thought leader—engaging in high-level discussions with client C-suites, regulatory stakeholders, and industry influencers.

  • Contribute to scientific and clinical development discussions, leveraging evidence-based insights to shape client strategies and partnerships.

  • Represent the company in scientific and industry forums to enhance visibility and credibility.

Therapeutic Portfolio Oversight

  • Provide executive oversight of all Cardio Metabolic and Intensive Care projects from early to late development phases.

  • Ensure operational excellence, delivery performance, and proactive risk mitigation across the portfolio.

  • Establish and monitor governance frameworks for performance tracking, escalation management, and continuous improvement.

  • Partner cross-functionally with operational, scientific, and quality leaders to drive consistency and innovation in project delivery.

Executive Client Management & Business Development

  • Serve as the senior executive liaison for key strategic clients within the CMIC portfolio.

  • Partner with BD and functional teams to expand client relationships and identify growth opportunities.

  • Support high-stakes client engagements, including bid defenses, RFIs, and strategic presentations; coach senior leaders to do the same.

  • Cultivate long-term partnerships by demonstrating deep therapeutic expertise, strategic insight, and delivery excellence.

Financial & Operational Leadership

  • Maintain accountability for the financial health and performance of the CMIC therapeutic area.

  • Drive forecasting accuracy, portfolio profitability, and efficient resource utilization.

  • Collaborate with finance and operations leaders to ensure sustainable cost management and growth.

  • Champion data-driven decision making using operational analytics and performance metrics.

Organizational Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of global leaders (VP and below) within the CMIC therapeutic area.

  • Build a culture of collaboration, inclusion, empowerment, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Partner with HR and organizational leadership to strengthen succession pipelines and develop next-generation leaders.

Quality, Compliance & Continuous Improvement

  • Ensure compliance with ICH/GCP, regulatory standards, and internal quality systems.

  • Collaborate with quality leadership to drive inspection readiness and consistency across global operations.

  • Lead process improvement initiatives aimed at enhancing efficiency, scalability, and client satisfaction.

  • Model a culture of quality and operational integrity across all delivery teams.

Qualifications

  • Advanced degree (MS, PharmD, MD, or equivalent) in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, or related scientific discipline required; Ph.D. preferred but not required.

  • Minimum of 15+ years of experience in clinical research, project management, or clinical operations within CRO, pharmaceutical, or biotechnology environments.

  • Extensive experience leading complex clinical development programs in cardiology, metabolic disorders, or intensive care indications.

  • Proven ability to manage large, global portfolios and lead multi-layered leadership teams.

  • Strong business acumen and financial management experience (budgeting, forecasting, P&L ownership).

  • Deep understanding of drug development processes, GCP/ICH guidelines, and global regulatory expectations.

  • Exceptional executive presence with demonstrated ability to influence and engage at C-suite and senior client levels.

  • Strategic thinker with a track record of driving innovation, transformation, and operational excellence.

  • Ability to travel as required (approximately 30–35%).

At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

  • Maintain professional relationships with journalists, media organizations, community groups, government representatives, and other stakeholders.

  • Monitor news coverage, social media, and public discussions relevant to the organization.

  • Track media mentions and prepare summaries of public and media coverage.

  • Coordinate logistics and materials for public affairs events and community outreach activities.

  • Support the preparation of speeches, presentations, briefing materials, and executive talking points.

  • Ensure public-facing communications are accurate, consistent, clear, and aligned with organizational policies.

  • Coordinate communications across departments to gather accurate information for public statements and announcements.

  • Assist with crisis and issues communications by preparing approved information and supporting established communication procedures.

  • Develop and maintain media contact lists, stakeholder databases, distribution lists, and communication records.

  • Maintain an organized archive of press releases, media inquiries, public statements, photographs, publications, and other communications materials.

  • Support website, newsletter, social media, and other public communication channels as assigned.

  • Coordinate with marketing, legal, leadership, operations, and other internal teams on communications activities.

  • Assist with community outreach programs and initiatives designed to strengthen relationships with external stakeholders.

  • Research public affairs issues, community concerns, media trends, and relevant developments.

  • Prepare communication reports, media-monitoring reports, and performance summaries.

  • Copywriting & Editing

  • Media Monitoring

  • Digital Communications

  • Content Development

  • Presentation Skills

jobs.description:
About Wherobots

Wherobots is the AI Context Engine for the Physical World: the missing infrastructure layer for AI that needs to reason about our physical reality. Existing AI context infrastructure was built for text, code, documents, databases, and the internet. The most consequential enterprise decisions also depend on the physical world: supply chains, climate exposure, geopolitics, infrastructure, and more.

Our two products let teams use familiar SQL and Python to analyze physical-world data and give AI agents persistent context about their organization’s assets and operations:

  • WherobotsDB is a fully distributed spatial analytics engine with a Rust-native execution layer. It processes vector and raster data in the same engine at scale, enabling precise spatial joins across billions of geometries and analysis that connects imagery with business data.
  • RasterFlow is a fully distributed, serverless engine for raster preparation and computer vision. It processes satellite imagery at planetary scale, runs built-in or custom PyTorch models, and turns imagery into predictions and spatial features that teams can analyze with WherobotsDB.

Wherobots was founded by the original creators of Apache Sedona, the open-source spatial computing platform with more than 80 million downloads. Apache Sedona is used in production by tens of thousands of organizations, including many Fortune 500 companies.

About the role

Wherobots is looking for an experienced Solution Architect to help enterprise customers design and adopt geospatial data solutions. You will partner with sales throughout technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, and proofs of concept, then help customers move into production and expand their use of Wherobots.

This is a customer-facing role with hands-on technical work. You will help customers connect raster ETL, spatial analytics, and computer vision or machine learning use cases to their business needs. You will also create reusable technical resources and bring customer feedback to product and engineering teams.

Responsibilities

  • Pre-sales: Lead technical discovery. Partner with sales and marketing to understand customer business challenges, data infrastructure, and analytics needs. Translate those requirements into proposed solutions and clear success criteria.
  • Pre-sales: Design solution architectures. Develop architecture diagrams, integration flows, and deployment plans tailored to customer environments, including platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, AWS, and Google Earth Engine.
  • Pre-sales: Deliver demonstrations and proofs of concept. Build customer-specific demonstrations, notebooks, and benchmarks that show how Wherobots supports raster ETL, spatial analytics, and ML workflows. Help customers evaluate technical fit and business value.
  • Post-sales: Lead architectural onboarding. Guide new customers from evaluation into production, working with their engineering and analytics teams to establish implementation plans and operational best practices.
  • Post-sales: Support customer implementations. Help customers design data ingestion and transformation pipelines, spatial analysis workflows, and model inference integrations, including storage, querying, visualization, and governance.
  • Post-sales: Troubleshoot technical issues. Serve as a technical escalation point and work with product and support engineering to resolve issues and improve customer deployments.
  • Create reusable technical resources. Develop reference architectures, implementation guides, Jupyter notebooks, tutorials, and technical blog posts. Share practical examples through workshops, webinars, technical events, and community engagement.
  • Inform product direction. Collect customer requirements and implementation feedback to help prioritize improvements to Wherobots capabilities, APIs, and documentation.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a customer-facing technical role covering pre-sales and post-sales activities, such as solution architecture, sales engineering, or technical consulting.
  • Experience with spatial data and spatial analysis, including raster processing using tools such as GDAL and Rasterio.
  • Hands-on Python and SQL skills for building customer examples, analyzing data, and troubleshooting workflows.
  • Strong understanding of the data analytics lifecycle, from extract, transform, and load (ETL) pipelines through data platform design to business intelligence and analytics tools.
  • Strong skills in databases, data warehouses, and data processing, with familiarity with technologies such as PostgreSQL, Apache Iceberg, and AWS Glue.
  • Experience working with cloud object storage such as Amazon S3 and geospatial data formats such as GeoTIFF, Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFF (COG), or Zarr.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a customer-focused approach and the ability to collaborate across sales, engineering, and product teams.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, geography, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have (Optional)

  • Experience with Apache Spark and Apache Sedona.
  • Experience with PyTorch, computer vision, or machine learning workflows, including model inference on satellite imagery or other raster data.
  • Familiarity with Xarray for working with multidimensional raster and scientific datasets.
  • A track record of supporting enterprise data or analytics software sales, including identifying key stakeholders, establishing value propositions, and delivering successful proofs of concept.
  • Experience designing solutions around large-scale databases and enterprise data platforms.
  • Familiarity with downstream data consumption patterns, including BI tools, dashboards, and application integrations.

Packetlabs was built by an ethical hacker after seeing vulnerability assessments presented as penetration tests. Our slogan "Identify Risks Before They Become Headlines" drives at the importance of not providing our clients with a false sense of security.

We are a passionate team of highly trained, proactive ethical hackers. We provide expert-level penetration testing services that are thorough and tailored to help foster a safe digital space where everyone has the right to privacy and security. Packetlabs consultants find weaknesses others overlook and continuously learn new ways to evade controls. We hold ourselves to a very high standard.
