The Ethical Hacker – Infrastructure & Red Team is responsible for planning, executing, and reporting on infrastructure penetration testing, cloud security assessments, Active Directory security assessments, and adversary simulation engagements. The role evaluates the effectiveness of client security controls by identifying, validating, and demonstrating exploitable security vulnerabilities across enterprise infrastructure using industry-recognized offensive security methodologies.

Working independently and collaboratively with other security consultants, the Ethical Hacker performs offensive security assessments across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments while contributing to red team operations, purple team exercises, and advanced security testing engagements. The role provides technical guidance to clients through detailed reporting and presentations while contributing to the continuous improvement of Packetlabs' offensive security methodologies, tooling, and service offerings.

Who we are looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience will be considered.
  • Minimum of 3 years of professional experience performing infrastructure penetration testing, red teaming, adversary simulation, or offensive security consulting.
  • Demonstrated experience conducting penetration testing across enterprise infrastructure, including Windows, Linux, Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, cloud platforms, and enterprise networking.
  • Experience performing internal and external network penetration testing, privilege escalation, Active Directory security assessments, and lateral movement testing.
  • Experience assessing cloud environments, including AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise networking, authentication technologies, identity management, cloud security, and offensive security methodologies.
  • Experience using industry-standard offensive security frameworks, tools, and tradecraft.
  • Excellent technical writing, presentation, and communication skills, with the ability to communicate findings to both technical and executive stakeholders.
  • Industry certifications such as OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, CRTE, CARTP, CARTA, CREST CRT, CREST CCT, PNPT, GPEN, GXPN, or equivalent are considered an asset. OSCP or equivalent demonstrated technical capability is strongly preferred.
  • Experience participating in Red Team, Purple Team, adversary simulation, or threat emulation engagements is considered an asset.

  • You dig deeper into every finding. Doesn't stop until impact is proven.

  • You are self-motivated and dependable.

What you’ll be doing

  • Infrastructure Security Assessments
    • Plan and execute infrastructure penetration testing engagements across on-premises, hybrid, cloud, wireless, and enterprise network environments.
    • Perform internal and external network penetration testing to identify, validate, and exploit security vulnerabilities using manual testing methodologies and industry-standard offensive security tools.
    • Assess enterprise technologies including Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), Windows and Linux environments, virtualization platforms, cloud services, and supporting infrastructure.
    • Evaluate cloud environments including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform to identify configuration weaknesses, privilege escalation opportunities, identity risks, and cloud security vulnerabilities.
    • Assess containerized environments, Kubernetes platforms, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native technologies where applicable.
  • Red Team & Adversary Simulation
    • Participate in and lead adversary simulation, red team, and objective-based security engagements in accordance with established methodologies and client objectives.
    • Execute offensive security operations across the attack lifecycle, including reconnaissance, initial access, persistence, privilege escalation, credential access, lateral movement, defense evasion, command and control, and objective execution.
    • Support purple team engagements by working collaboratively with defensive teams to validate detections, improve monitoring capabilities, and strengthen defensive controls.
    • Develop and execute attack scenarios that demonstrate realistic business impact while maintaining client system integrity.
  • Client Delivery & Reporting
    • Prepare comprehensive technical reports that clearly communicate vulnerabilities, attack paths, business impact, risk ratings, and remediation recommendations.
    • Present assessment findings to technical teams, executive stakeholders, and client leadership.
    • Provide technical guidance on remediation strategies, security architecture, and defensive improvements.
    • Manage assigned engagements while ensuring delivery quality, timelines, and client expectations are achieved.
  • Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement
    • Maintain expertise in offensive security methodologies, infrastructure security, cloud technologies, Active Directory security, and emerging attack techniques.
    • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of testing methodologies, internal tooling, technical documentation, and service offerings.
    • Participate in technical research, automation initiatives, internal training, and knowledge-sharing activities.
    • Collaborate with consulting teams to strengthen technical quality, consistency, and service delivery across the Offensive Security practice.
    • Perform other duties as assigned.

How is success defined

  • Performance in this role is evaluated using a combination of technical, operational, and client-focused measures, including but not limited to:
    • Successful delivery of infrastructure penetration testing and adversary simulation engagements within established quality, budget, and timeline expectations.
    • Accuracy, completeness, and technical quality of client reports and deliverables.
    • Demonstrated expertise across enterprise infrastructure, cloud security, Active Directory, and offensive security methodologies.
    • Positive client feedback regarding technical expertise, communication, and professionalism.
    • Contribution to technical research, methodology development, automation, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
    • Effective collaboration with Delivery Managers, Project Managers, and consulting team members.
    • Ongoing professional development through certifications, research, and technical skill advancement.

Why us?

  • A leadership team that values substance, quality, and disciplined execution

jobs.description:
Build and run the GHL systems that turn leads into members and keep members coming back — and be the go-to support for the gym team using them.

About the Role

Seamless Assist places AI-fluent virtual assistants with growing businesses and builds the automation systems they run. We are hiring a GoHighLevel Specialist on behalf of our client, a US-based gym business. This is a fully remote role open to candidates worldwide.

The gym runs its lead follow-up, trial bookings, member communication, and retention campaigns through GoHighLevel. This hire owns that platform end to end — building the automations that drive memberships and supporting the owner and front-desk team who use it every day.

Culture: owner-led, fast-moving fitness business. Clear ownership, proactive communication, and steady improvement over perfection.

Role Details

  • Industry: Health & Fitness — Gym
  • Reports to: Gym Owner
  • Type: Full-time · 40 hours/week
  • Hours: US Eastern Time (EST) business hours
  • Rate: TBD
  • Location: Remote — open to candidates worldwide
  • Tools: GoHighLevel (GHL), Zapier / Make / n8n, gym management software (e.g., Mindbody, ABC Glofox, PushPress, Zen Planner), Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, Google Workspace

Role Overview

Every lead, trial, and member touchpoint at the gym runs through GoHighLevel. The GHL Specialist will design and maintain those systems — from the first ad inquiry to the membership renewal — and provide responsive, first-line support to the gym owner and staff.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move between building and supporting in the same day: fixing a broken trial-booking workflow in the morning, walking the front desk through the pipeline after lunch, and documenting both so it doesn't happen twice. The right person treats every support request as a signal of what to systematize next.

Key Responsibilities

GHL Automation & Build

  • Build and maintain lead nurture workflows — speed-to-lead SMS/email, trial class and intro session booking, and follow-up for leads who don't book
  • Automate the member journey — class and appointment reminders, no-show follow-up, new-member onboarding, and milestone check-ins
  • Run retention and reactivation campaigns — lapsed and frozen members, expiring memberships, failed payments, and win-back offers
  • Set up and manage pipelines, calendars, forms, surveys, landing pages/funnels, custom fields, and tags
  • Build and send email and SMS campaigns — promotions, challenges, events, and monthly member newsletters
  • Automate review requests and referral campaigns to grow the gym's reputation
  • Integrate GHL with the gym's management software, payment tools, and ad lead sources (Facebook/Instagram lead forms) via native integrations, Zapier, Make, n8n, or webhooks

Customer Support

  • Serve as first-line GHL support for the gym owner and front-desk/sales staff
  • Manage and respond to member and lead inquiries in the GHL Conversations inbox (SMS, email, social DMs) within agreed response times
  • Troubleshoot issues: broken workflows, failed sends, calendar sync errors, A2P/10DLC and email deliverability problems, integration failures
  • Train gym staff on using GHL — pipelines, conversations, booking, and reporting — through live walkthroughs and short recorded videos
  • Escalate billing, platform-level bugs, or out-of-scope requests to the gym owner with a clear summary

Reporting, Documentation & Improvement

  • Build dashboards that track leads, trial bookings, show rates, conversions to membership, and retention
  • Write SOPs and how-to guides for every recurring build and support issue
  • Audit the account for broken, duplicate, or unused workflows and recommend clean-up
  • Track recurring issues and propose automations or fixes that remove them at the source
  • Use AI tools to speed up campaign copy, troubleshooting, and documentation

Who Will Succeed

"Builds it right, explains it simply, and fixes the root cause — not just the ticket."

  • Has built real GHL automations for live businesses — ideally gyms, studios, or other membership businesses
  • Understands how a gym makes money: leads, trials, memberships, retention
  • Patient and clear with busy, non-technical owners and staff — explains a workflow without jargon
  • Systems thinker who documents as they go and hates fixing the same problem twice
  • Takes initiative — spots what is broken or missing and raises it before the owner does

Experience & Skills

Required

  • GHL expertise: 2+ years of hands-on GoHighLevel experience building workflows, pipelines, funnels, and campaigns for live businesses
  • Customer support: 1+ year providing customer or technical support (tickets, live chat, calls, or client success)
  • Integrations: Working knowledge of Zapier, Make, n8n, or webhooks to connect GHL with other tools
  • AI fluency: Actively uses AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to build, write, and troubleshoot faster — specific tools and use cases confirmed at screening
  • Time zone compatibility: Able to work US Eastern Time (EST) business hours from wherever you are based
  • Strong communication: Exceptional written and spoken English — clear, friendly, and concise with owners, staff, and members; assessed at screening
  • Deliverability: Understanding of email and SMS deliverability, including A2P 10DLC registration
  • Remote setup: Reliable high-speed internet and a dedicated workspace

Preferred

  • Experience with gyms, fitness studios, or other membership-based businesses
  • Experience with gym management software (Mindbody, ABC Glofox, PushPress, Zen Planner, or similar)
  • GHL Admin certification
  • Familiarity with GHL Conversation AI / AI Employee features
  • Experience running Facebook/Instagram lead-gen campaigns into GHL

jobs.excerpt: About AdvantixxRCM AdvantixxRCM provides comprehensive revenue cycle management services to healthcare providers, including medical billing, insurance follow-up, denial management, payment posting, credentialing, and revenue optimization.
jobs.description:
About AdvantixxRCM
AdvantixxRCM provides comprehensive revenue cycle management services to healthcare providers, including medical billing, insurance follow-up, denial management, payment posting, credentialing, and revenue optimization.

We are seeking an experienced Accounts Receivable (A/R) & Insurance Follow-Up Specialist who understands that submitting a claim is only the beginning—the ultimate objective is obtaining accurate and timely reimbursement for our clients.

Position Summary

The A/R & Insurance Follow-Up Specialist is responsible for managing outstanding insurance accounts and aggressively pursuing appropriate reimbursement from Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care, and commercial insurance payers.

This individual will investigate unpaid, delayed, denied, rejected, and underpaid claims and take appropriate action until each assigned account reaches resolution.

We are looking for someone who can work an A/R aging report independently and take ownership of accounts from follow-up through resolution.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Insurance A/R Follow-Up

  • Work assigned insurance A/R aging reports daily.
  • Follow up on unpaid and outstanding insurance claims.
  • Research claim status through payer portals, clearinghouses, telephone calls, and other available resources.
  • Determine why claims remain unpaid.
  • Contact insurance companies regarding delayed or incorrectly processed claims.
  • Document every follow-up action accurately.
  • Establish appropriate follow-up dates and continue working accounts until resolution.
  • Prioritize high-dollar and aging accounts.
  • Identify claims approaching timely-filing or appeal deadlines.
  • Escalate significant reimbursement issues to management.

Denials & Rejections

  • Investigate rejected and denied claims.
  • Review CARC/RARC codes and payer explanations.
  • Determine appropriate corrective action.
  • Correct and resubmit claims when appropriate.
  • Submit reconsiderations and appeals.
  • Obtain supporting documentation when required.
  • Track appeals through final determination.
  • Identify recurring denial patterns and communicate them to management.
  • Work with billing, coding, credentialing, eligibility, and authorization teams to resolve root causes.

Underpayment & Reimbursement Review

  • Review EOBs and ERAs.
  • Identify potential underpayments.
  • Compare reimbursement against expected or contracted reimbursement when information is available.
  • Research incorrectly processed claims.
  • Request claim reprocessing when appropriate.
  • Identify coordination-of-benefits issues.
  • Research primary and secondary payer issues.
  • Escalate suspected payer reimbursement problems.

A/R Management

  • Work accounts across aging categories, including:

0–30 Days | 31–60 Days | 61–90 Days | 91–120 Days | 120+ Days

Special attention should be given to aging balances, high-dollar accounts, filing deadlines, and claims requiring immediate intervention.

Documentation

Every account worked must contain clear documentation describing:

  • Date of follow-up
  • Payer contacted
  • Claim status
  • Representative/reference information when applicable
  • Reason payment remains outstanding
  • Action taken
  • Documentation requested or submitted
  • Expected resolution
  • Required next action
  • Follow-up date

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years of medical billing, insurance follow-up, or healthcare A/R experience preferred.
  • Experience working insurance aging reports.
  • Experience communicating directly with insurance companies.
  • Knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid Managed Care, and commercial insurance.
  • Understanding of CMS-1500 professional claims.
  • Experience with EOBs and ERAs.
  • Knowledge of claim denials, rejections, reconsiderations, and appeals.
  • Familiarity with CPT, HCPCS, ICD-10-CM, modifiers, and CARC/RARC codes.
  • Experience using payer portals and clearinghouses.
  • Strong research and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent documentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous experience with an RCM or medical billing company.
  • Experience handling multiple healthcare practices or clients.
  • CPC, CPB, CRCR, or related certification.
  • Medicare and Medicaid billing experience.
  • Experience with behavioral health, primary care, specialty medicine, or other outpatient services.
  • Experience with Availity, Office Ally, Waystar, Change Healthcare/Optum, or similar systems.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish is a plus.

Performance Expectations

Performance will be measured using appropriate departmental KPIs, including:

  • Number and quality of accounts worked
  • A/R resolution
  • Reduction of aging balances
  • A/R over 90 days
  • Recovery of outstanding reimbursement
  • Follow-up turnaround time
  • Appeal/reconsideration completion
  • Documentation quality
  • Accuracy
  • Timely-filing protection
  • Compliance with company and client procedures

Quality and actual account resolution are more important than simply documenting a high number of touches.

Digital Services Manager

Description -

Head of Digital Services, U.S. Channel


Job Description

Role Overview

The Head of Digital Services, U.S. Channel is responsible for leading HP’s Partner Development Manager (PDM) team and scaling HP’s digital software and services business across the U.S. partner ecosystem. This leader owns the strategy, go-to-market execution, partner practice development, and revenue performance required to position Digital Employee Experience (DEX) as a core channel growth pillar and transform the partner motion from hardware-led transactions to outcome-based, recurring experience-led services.


The role acts as the senior architect for HP’s DEX-led partner services motion, defining how partners assess, sell, deploy, optimize, secure, and renew digital experience solutions around HP’s portfolio. The Head of Digital Services will align HP sales, product, services, finance, operations, marketing, and program teams behind a scalable partner activation model while ensuring the PDM team is equipped to build partner capability, drive adoption, and deliver measurable recurring revenue growth.


Key Responsibilities

Lead the Partner Development Manager Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of Partner Development Managers accountable for partner practice development, pipeline creation, deal execution support, account planning, competitive positioning, and revenue growth in HP digital services.
  • Establish the PDM operating rhythm, including forecasting discipline, partner prioritization, pipeline inspection, business reviews, KPI tracking, and executive reporting.
  • Ensure PDMs operate as category and services specialists who build partner capability, contribute to joint business planning, and help partners become self-sufficient in selling and delivering HP-based services.
  • Set clear engagement boundaries and collaboration models with PBMs, DBMs, end-user sellers, technical consultants, product teams, and services specialists.

Build and Scale DEX-Led Partner Practices

  • Define the end-to-end blueprint partners use to launch and scale HP-based DEX practices, including assessment offers, adoption services, optimization motions, security adjacencies, service catalogs, pricing and margin models, delivery playbooks, onboarding, QBR cadence, renewals, and expansion motions.
  • Develop a DEX maturity model that guides partners from assess, deploy, and adopt through monitor, optimize, automate, secure, and expand.
  • Build partner business cases that quantify service margin, investment requirements, time-to-first-revenue, delivery capacity, customer productivity impact, and customer lifetime value.
  • Pair partner practice plans with specialty pricing, commitment-based programs, MDF, incentives, certification, and enablement structures that reward adoption, outcomes, renewals, and recurring revenue.

Drive Digital Services Growth Across the Channel

  • Position digital services as a core growth pillar of the U.S. Channel and a strategic revenue engine, not a hardware attach motion.
  • Scale annual recurring revenue through DEX-led partner offers, subscription motions, consumption models, adoption services, optimization engagements, and expansion plays.
  • Activate VAR, distribution, strategic partner, digital workplace, end-user computing, and security routes to market with clear value propositions, economic models, sales plays, and partner-ready DEX offers.
  • Use data, dashboards, market insights, and partner feedback to identify growth opportunities, prioritize partner investments, and improve services penetration.

Advance Solution Integration and Practice Specialization

  • Enable partners to monetize HP Workforce Experience Platform capabilities, including fleet analytics, experience scoring, operational intelligence, workflow automation, and continuous optimization services.
  • Integrate Digital Employee Experience capabilities into partner offerings, including endpoint analytics, device performance telemetry, sentiment insight, and AI-driven remediation.
  • Embed HP Security into DEX-led partner offerings as an important layer of endpoint resilience, risk reduction, compliance awareness, and proactive experience management.
  • Ensure the PDM team translates HP portfolio priorities into partner-specific practice roadmaps, enablement plans, and revenue-producing offers.

Develop the DEX and Security Partner Ecosystem

  • Recruit, activate, and scale partners with the technical, operational, and commercial capability to deliver DEX-led services around HP’s digital portfolio.
  • Prioritize partners with existing digital workplace, endpoint management, employee experience, ITSM, security operations, and end-user computing practices to shorten time-to-revenue.
  • Define security-adjacent DEX routes to market across endpoint security visibility, risk posture awareness, compliance reporting, proactive remediation, and experience-driven operational intelligence.
  • Establish integration points between HP telemetry, partner service desks, experience analytics, automation workflows, security tooling, and recurring commercial models for monitoring, optimization, and compliance-oriented services.

Influence Internal Strategy, Programs, and Operating Models

  • Serve as the internal champion for digital services across HP, building executive sponsorship and organizational alignment for the channel services business.
  • Translate partner wins, customer outcomes, competitive dynamics, and market signals into business requirements for product roadmap, pricing, programs, tools, support, and operational processes.
  • Advocate for the technical resources required to scale DEX-led partner practices, including DEX specialists, technical consultants, solution architects, security subject-matter experts, and pre-sales engineering support.
  • Drive requirements for SKU simplification, quoting, ordering, provisioning, entitlement management, renewals, deal registration, funnel visibility, and reporting.

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • Proven success leading channel, partner development, services, software, digital workplace, employee experience, endpoint management, or security-adjacent organizations in a complex technology environment.
  • Deep understanding of the Digital Employee Experience market, including endpoint analytics, experience scoring, sentiment insight, automation, remediation, ITSM integration, adoption services, and recurring revenue motions.
  • Background in security, endpoint resilience, risk management, or security operations is strongly preferred; experience with major DEX market players such as Nexthink, Lakeside, ControlUp, 1E, or similar platforms is a plus.
  • The ideal candidate will bring experience from a leading DEX competitor or a proven track record of building and scaling a software or digital services practice within a hardware company.
  • Experience building partner practices, scaling partner capability, launching new offers, and translating portfolio strategy into field execution.
  • Strong executive presence with the ability to influence across sales, category, product, services, finance, operations, marketing, and partner leadership teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to use data, market insight, and partner feedback to shape strategy, prioritize investments, and deliver measurable business outcomes.
  • Track record of building high-performing teams, coaching specialist sellers or partner development resources, and establishing disciplined operating rhythms.

Leadership Attributes

  • Transformational leader who can move the channel from transactional selling to outcome-based, services-led growth.
  • Strategic operator who converts vision into scalable operating models, clear ownership, and measurable execution.
  • Partner-first executive who understands how partners make money, where they invest, and what capabilities they need to scale.
  • Strong collaborator who can orchestrate across HP and remove friction for partners and field teams.
  • Commercially disciplined leader who balances growth, profitability, adoption, renewal, and long-term partner health.

The ideal candidate is an experienced healthcare operations leader who understands the complete medical revenue cycle and can independently manage teams, solve operational problems, analyze performance, develop processes, and hold employees accountable for results.

This position requires someone who can run the operation—not simply supervise employees.

  • Address performance deficiencies and coordinate corrective action when necessary.
  • Create an accountable, professional, results-driven work environment.
  • Escalate significant operational, compliance, financial, or client matters to executive leadership.

Revenue Cycle Management

  • Monitor claim submission and clearinghouse activity.

  • Oversee insurance A/R follow-up.

  • Identify underpayments and reimbursement discrepancies.
  • Monitor recurring payer issues and develop corrective strategies.
  • Coordinate credentialing and payer enrollment activities.
  • Work collaboratively with coding, eligibility, authorization, and billing teams.

Client Management

  • Ensure contractual services and client expectations are met.

  • Respond to client concerns professionally and promptly.
  • Coordinate resolution of escalated billing and reimbursement issues.
  • Maintain strong client relationships and support client retention.
  • Identify opportunities to improve or expand services.

Performance & Analytics

  • A/R aging
  • A/R over 90 days
  • Net collection rate
  • Claim submission turnaround
  • Payment posting turnaround
  • Denial resolution
  • Appeal recovery
  • Employee productivity
  • Quality/accuracy
  • Client performance
  • Client satisfaction and retention

The Operations Manager is expected to use data to identify problems and implement measurable corrective actions.

Process Improvement

  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Standardize workflows across departments and clients.
  • Identify inefficient processes and implement improvements.
  • Establish quality-control procedures.
  • Develop operational dashboards and reporting systems.
  • Analyze denial and A/R trends to identify root causes.

  • Assist leadership with automation and technology initiatives.

  • Experience working with clearinghouses and payer portals.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD101004

Position Overview

The Go-to-Market Data & Intelligence (GDI) organization empowers Autodesk teams to make better customer decisions using trusted data, analytics, and data science. The Data Science team develops Machine Learning products that help Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success teams determine which customers to engage, when to engage them, what actions to take, and how to measure the impact of those actions.

We are looking for a dynamic Senior Manager, GTM Data Science to join the GDI leadership team. You will lead a diverse team of data scientists and own the portfolio, execution, adoption, and measurable business impact of data science initiatives across customer intelligence domains. This role requires deep technical credibility, strong people leadership, operating discipline, and the ability to influence senior business and data leaders.

The data science team applies descriptive, predictive, and experimental methods to customer data to optimize decisions related to customer renewals, expansion, and segmentation. The data science team partners closely with GDI program management, analytics, ML engineering, and GTM teams and their operational partners to create customer intelligence experiences that are embedded in GTM workflows.

Success in this role is not measured only by the quality of models or insights delivered. You will be accountable for translating ambiguous business objectives into the right problems and products, prioritizing opportunities by expected business value, working across functions to integrate data science products into how GTM teams work, and demonstrating that those products improve decisions and business outcomes.

Responsibilities

  • Shape the multi-quarter Data Science roadmap for customer engagement use cases, aligned with GDI priorities and Autodesk business objectives

  • Partner with senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to identify and prioritize the decisions where data science can create the greatest customer and business value

  • Translate ambiguous strategic questions into clear decision frameworks, analytical problem statements, intervention strategies, success metrics, and business cases

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to executives and cross-functional leaders; challenge assumptions, make clear recommendations, and communicate tradeoffs in a way that supports timely decisions

  • Define success measures before development begins and hold the team and partners accountable for adoption and realized outcomes, including customer retention and growth, conversion, engagement effectiveness, seller and marketer productivity, and resource allocation

  • Own and actively manage a portfolio of Decision Intelligence initiatives across areas such as retention and churn, growth potential, upsell and cross-sell, segmentation, propensity and lead prioritization, license compliance, attribution, benchmarking, what-if scenarios, and next-best action

  • Lead the end-to-end lifecycle from problem formulation and data readiness through modeling, validation, deployment, workflow integration, experimentation, impact measurement, and post-launch monitoring

  • Make explicit portfolio tradeoffs, sequence work based on expected value and feasibility, and redirect or stop initiatives when evidence indicates that the opportunity is no longer compelling

  • Partner with GDI program management, analytics engineering, data engineering, product managers, and federated analytics teams to define requirements, operating dependencies, delivery plans, and adoption mechanisms

  • Establish clear operating rhythms and quality standards for the team, including roadmap reviews, technical reviews, launch readiness, outcome reviews, and escalation of material risks

  • Provide technical leadership that ensures the problem formulation matches the decision need - including when to use prediction, experimentation, causal inference, optimization, ranking, simulation, or other approaches

  • Guide the team across statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, causal methods, propensity and uplift modeling, scoring and prioritization, and related advanced analytics techniques

  • Maintain a high technical bar for data quality, leakage prevention, model evaluation and calibration, reproducibility, explainability, bias and fairness considerations, drift monitoring, and offline versus online performance

  • Ensure machine learning products connect predictions or insights to specific actions, interventions, or policies and that their incremental impact can be measured whenever practical

  • Stay current on advances in machine learning, AI, experimentation, causal inference, and decision intelligence, and apply the appropriate methods when to improve customer or business outcomes

  • Lead, recruit, retain, and develop a high-performing team of data scientists with clear roles, standards, accountability, and career expectations

  • Coach senior individual contributors and emerging leaders, developing both deep technical capability and the judgment required to operate effectively with business stakeholders

  • Conduct performance and talent reviews, provide candid and actionable feedback, identify development opportunities, and build succession and hiring plans for critical capabilities

  • Create an inclusive team environment that values rigorous technical debate, curiosity, continuous learning, cross-functional collaboration, and accountability for outcomes

  • Build organizational capability beyond individual projects by improving reusable methods, decision frameworks, operating practices, and partnerships across the broader EDA organization

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in data science, machine learning, advanced analytics, or a related quantitative field, including significant hands-on applied experience

  • 3+ years of experience managing data science, machine learning, or advanced analytics teams

  • Advanced degree in a quantitative discipline such as statistics, mathematics, economics, computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Strong technical fluency in Python or R and SQL, with the ability to engage in detailed technical design and model-review discussions

  • Demonstrated experience taking analytical or machine learning products from an ambiguous business problem through development, deployment, adoption, and measurable impact

  • Strong knowledge of statistical modeling, machine learning, experimentation, causal inference, and model evaluation techniques

  • Demonstrated ability to identify the right business problems to solve and translate business objectives into decision, measurement, and analytical frameworks

  • Experience influencing senior stakeholders with data and analysis and leading cross-functional initiatives that depend on contributions from multiple disciplines

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex concepts, recommendations, risks, and tradeoffs to audiences ranging from technical practitioners to executives

  • Strong judgment, ownership, and execution: you proactively identify gaps, resolve ambiguity, make clear recommendations, and remain accountable for outcomes across organizational boundaries

Flow Capture has a strong installed base across Autodesk's largest enterprise accounts. Now we are taking it into an entirely new segment: mid-tier production companies. This is a full-cycle field sales role built for hunters. You will target a defined set of accounts that match our ideal customer profile, most of them net new to Flow Capture. You will partner closely with our Account Based Marketing team to build awareness and generate leads inside these accounts, then own the process from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close. jobs.title: Sr. Data Modeler
jobs.excerpt: We're looking for a Sr.  Data Modeler to design and govern the data models that serve as the foundation for analytics, reporting, and business intelligence across the organization — with particular depth in semantic and metrics-layer modeling.
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Sr. Data Modeler to design and govern the data models that serve as the foundation for analytics, reporting, and business intelligence across the organization — with particular depth in semantic and metrics-layer modeling. Beyond traditional schema design, you'll build the semantic layer that sits between raw data and downstream consumers (dashboards, reverse-ETL syncs, AI-assisted querying), working closely with data engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to keep definitions consistent everywhere they're used.

What you'll get to do:

  • Contribute to the semantic layer strategy — defining metrics, dimensions, and business logic once so they're consistent across BI tools, reverse-ETL syncs, and AI-assisted querying
  • Design serving-layer models as the "source of truth" for business definitions, resolving ambiguity before it reaches dashboards
  • Build and govern semantic views/metrics layers (e.g., Snowflake semantic views, dbt metrics/semantic layer) that let analysts and AI tools query curated data without re-deriving business logic
  • Partner directly with analytics and BI consumers to understand how models get used downstream, and iterate on semantic definitions based on real query patterns
  • Reduce metric drift by auditing existing reports/dashboards for divergent definitions of the same business concept and consolidating them into governed semantic models

Who you are:

  • 5+ years of experience in data modeling or a related field, including experience operating at a senior or technical lead level
  • Experience designing or maintaining a semantic layer or metrics layer (e.g., dbt Semantic Layer, LookML, Snowflake semantic views, Cube) that serves multiple downstream consumers
  • Strong point of view on the difference between a data model and a semantic model, and how to design for both correctness and analyst usability
  • Advanced SQL skills and deep understanding of relational database design
  • Experience modeling data within modern cloud data warehouses (e.g., Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift)
  • Experience working with transformation frameworks such as dbt
  • Strong understanding of data governance, metadata management, and documentation practices
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate business needs into technical designs and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience preferred.
  • Foundational background in dimensional modeling (Kimball and/or Inmon) — helpful context, though this role emphasizes semantic/metrics layer design over traditional schema work
  • Experience with data catalog or governance tools (e.g., Collibra, Alation, Atlan)
  • Familiarity with data mesh or data product concepts
  • Background in a specific industry domain relevant to the business (e.g., finance, healthcare, retail)

jobs.description:
Position Overview

The Prescription Access Specialist is responsible for driving engagement with clinicians and office staff to expand GoodRx Prescription Services utilization under DistributeRx. This role focuses on removing prescription access barriers, increasing medication fulfillment, and supporting clinicians in providing cost-effective solutions for patients.

A successful candidate will take ownership of their territory, leveraging a consultative approach to educate prescribers and staff on GoodRx Prescription Services as a streamlined alternative for prescription fulfillment.

About the Company:

DistributeRx is an affiliate of Mayne Pharma Group Limited. We area modern healthcare solutions company transforming how medications reach patients. We partner with pharmaceutical manufacturers across the product lifecycle — from pre-launch strategy and product launch to growth optimization and mature-brand support. Our integrated services span sales strategy, patient affordability and adherence programs, pharmacy network management, and data analytics, reducing friction throughout the distribution process. The result is stronger product adoption for manufacturers, transparent pricing for clinicians, and more consistent access to therapy for patients.

Key Responsibility Areas

  • Clinician Engagement & Education: Build and maintain strong relationships with clinicians educating them on GoodRx Prescription Services solutions that enhance prescription accessibility and improve patient adherence.
  • Prescription Fulfillment Growth: Drive adoption of GoodRx Prescription Services by strategically positioning GoodRx Prescription Services as a trusted, cost-effective, and hassle-free alternative to traditional prescription fulfillment.
  • Market Development & Execution: Analyze territory trends and develop targeted access strategies to maximize script volume while ensuring seamless implementation of GoodRx Prescription Services solutions.
  • Patient Access Advocacy: Partner with clinicians and their offices to help remove barriers to prescription access, providing actionable insights that allow prescribers to offer cost savings and predictable pricing options.
  • Business Performance & Sales Execution: Own and drive sales objectives within an assigned territory, proactively identifying opportunities for increased GoodRx Prescription Services utilization and prescription conversion.

Specific Responsibilities:

  • Develop strategic clinician engagement plans to increase awareness and adoption of GoodRx Prescription Services.
  • Collaborate with offices, prescribers, and pharmacy liaisons to drive seamless prescription fulfillment and patient access.
  • Analyze prescribing trends and access barriers to positionGoodRx Prescription Services as a viable solution.
  • Educate healthcare professionals and staff on cost savings, formulary exclusions, and access hurdles that GoodRx Prescription Services can help address.
  • Track and measure key performance indicators (KPIs), including prescription volume, fulfillment rates, and clinician adoption.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Key Competencies/Requirements:

  • Integrity: Consistently operates with honesty and ethical judgement, ensuring all activities align with company polices, industry regulations, and compliance standards. Builds trust withpartners through transparency, reliability, and accountability.
  • Innovation: Proactively identifies new opportunities and creative solutions to drive pharmacy growth, improve access, and enhance customer outcomes. Adapts quickly to market changes and leverages data, tools, and insights to improve performance.
  • Transparency:Communicates openly and accurately with internal teams and pharmacy partners, providing clear updates on performance, challenges, and opportunities. Shares information proactively to support informed decision making.

jobs.title: Tech Lead, Agentic Development
jobs.excerpt: About T-InnovaT-Innova has built the software that runs sports centers, gyms and clubs in Spain since 1993, from its base in Castelldefels, Barcelona.
jobs.description:
About T-Innova

T-Innova has built the software that runs sports centers, gyms and clubs in Spain since 1993, from its base in Castelldefels, Barcelona. Deporwin and DeporSite handle memberships, bookings and activities, payments and billing, reception point of sale and the access control at the door for around 300 clients, from single facilities to chains of dozens of centers. T-Innova is part of the Manos Group within Valsoft, a Canadian group that acquires and grows vertical-market software companies, which gives it the backing of a larger group while it runs as a focused, independent product company.

After more than 30 years in this market, T-Innova is building its next product: a new cloud platform, designed agentic-first from day one. The groundwork is done. The existing system has been mapped into a documented catalog of thousands of use cases, and the scope of the first release has been agreed across the company. The new product is built fresh from that catalog. The hard part is the bridge: many clients run customized on-premise installations of today's system, and every one of them has to keep running well until it moves across. We're growing the engineering team to do both.

The role

You'll own technical delivery at T-Innova: the engineering team, the code, the release discipline and the technical decisions, working within the shared architecture and standards the Manos Group provides across its companies. You'll be hands-on, building with AI coding agents every day, and you'll set the bar the rest of the team learns from.

Two things matter, in this order. First, today's clients never feel the rebuild. Second, the new product ships in steady, usable releases. You'll lead both, and you'll be the person the managing director and the group's technology leadership turn to for a straight answer on where things stand.

What you'll do

Lead the team

  • Lead, mentor and grow the engineering team, including the hiring of new engineers, and build a culture where people own the quality of what they ship.
  • Lead the move to agentic development by working that way in the open: specifications, agent-sized tasks, review and tests, every day.
  • Work with product, professional services, support and the managing director so that technical decisions follow business priorities and how clubs actually use the software.

Build the new product

  • Turn agreed use cases into specifications and working, tested software, building end to end with AI coding agents.
  • Shape the technical design with the group's technology leadership: data model, multi-tenant SaaS architecture, APIs, integrations and the agentic features built into the product.
  • Build AI into the product for clients, such as assistants, smart search, forecasting and the automation of routine admin, reliably, cost-aware and with care for client data.

Keep today's clients running

  • Own the health of the live platform: a mature estate of Visual Basic 6, .NET Framework services, a PHP web tier and SQL Server databases, much of it running in customized on-premise environments and on Windows Server and Remote Desktop Services.
  • Use agents to read, explain and safely change code nobody has touched in years, and reduce the per-client maintenance burden as you go.
  • Plan how clients move from today's system to the new product, one group at a time, without disrupting the clubs that depend on it.

Engineering quality

  • Bring in and own automated testing, CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code and observability, where some of it does not exist yet.
  • Set the standard for code review and release, and decide what must be proven before a change reaches a client.

What we're looking for

  • At least eight years of professional software development, including at least two years leading engineers or holding technical ownership of a production system that real clients depend on.
  • Demonstrable agentic development: you ship production code with AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot agents as your normal way of working, you can show how you specify, steer and verify their work, and you have helped others work the same way.
  • Hands-on experience building AI features into a real product: integrating LLM APIs with prompting, retrieval, evaluation and guardrails.
  • Strong backend skills in at least one modern stack (.NET and C#, Python, Node.js, Go or similar) and in relational databases, including SQL Server design, migrations and performance tuning.
  • Experience with a cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP), automated testing and CI/CD, ideally introduced into a team or codebase that did not have them.
  • The patience and skill to change a mature codebase safely. You do not need to love legacy code. You need to make it behave.
  • Fluent written and spoken English, and the ability to explain technical trade-offs to non-engineers.
  • Proactive: you spot what needs fixing before anyone asks, propose a solution and follow through.

Nice to have

  • Spanish (strongly preferred) and Catalan.
  • Multi-tenant SaaS architecture, and moving on-premise clients onto a cloud-hosted product.
  • Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Bicep or similar) and observability tooling.
  • Visual Basic 6, .NET Framework, PHP or Laravel, and Windows Server and Remote Desktop Services environments.
  • Tool integration through the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and familiarity with the EU AI Act.
  • Payments, invoicing and Spanish regulatory requirements such as Veri*Factu, GDPR and the Esquema Nacional de Seguridad (ENS).
  • Sports, fitness, leisure or club management software, membership and booking systems, or access control and IoT hardware.

How we work

We hire for agentic development first and a tech stack second. AI coding agents do most of the typing, and engineers do the thinking: writing the specification, breaking the work into tasks an agent can carry out, reviewing every change, and proving it works with tests before it ships. The product itself uses agentic AI to take routine work off our clients' hands.

The team sets its own working method. The Manos Group supplies the shared architecture, an engineering standard for product AI and a shared framework for agentic user experiences, so T-Innova builds on what works across the group rather than starting alone.

Why T-Innova

You'll hold real technical ownership of a product that sports facilities across Spain rely on every day, and you'll define what agentic development looks like at T-Innova, both in the product and in how the team works. You'll build on more than 30 years of market presence and a loyal client base, with the backing of the Manos Group and Valsoft.

The essentials

Location: Remote, working European time zones (a working day that overlaps Central European Time). Occasional travel to the Castelldefels office near Barcelona.

Language: Fluent English is required. Spanish is strongly preferred: colleagues and clients are Spanish-speaking.

Reports to: Xavi Trallero, Managing Director, T-Innova.

Employment: Full time.

How to apply

Apply through Workable with your CV and, if you can, one example of work you built agentically: the specification you wrote, how you steered the agent, and how you proved the result. A repository, a write-up or a short screen recording all work. Shortlisted candidates do a practical session building a small feature with an AI coding agent, followed by a conversation about how you would lead a team through the same way of working.

Lumen's Customer Financial Services team builds and runs the applications and processes behind billing, payments, collections, credit, and other customer financial operations. The Strategic Transformation PMO within CFS drives the organization's most important initiatives, including major ERP programs on SAP BRIM and SAP S/4HANA Finance, platform modernization, and new AI-powered workflows built with leading technology partners.

We're looking for a Senior Project Manager to lead strategic initiatives and other key projects from planning through delivery. Many of our current initiatives involve ERP systems, so exposure to SAP or other ERP projects is valuable, and the role may expand to support other areas of CFS over time. You'll own project plans, timelines, and schedules; manage work in Jira; act as a product manager for your initiatives; run Agile ceremonies and PI planning; and give clear readouts to management. You'll work closely with IT teams in India and the United States, along with finance, business, and other cross-functional teams, and you'll help strengthen the PMO team's practices and tools.

  • Plan, lead, and deliver strategic transformation initiatives and other CFS projects from initiation through closure, on time, within scope, and within budget.

Agile Delivery and Jira Management

  • Own and manage Jira for assigned initiatives, including boards, epics, stories, workflows, filters, dashboards, and reports.

Reporting and Stakeholder Communication

jobs.excerpt: About Aeris Communications Inc.  Aeris is the secure connectivity platform for Physical AI and intelligent IoT devices.
jobs.description:
About Aeris Communications Inc.

Aeris is the secure connectivity platform for Physical AI and intelligent IoT devices. It caters to connected cars, drones, autonomous mobility, robotics, utilities, energy, fleet management, logistics, medical devices, and manufacturing. Aeris serves over 7,000 enterprise customers and connects more than 115 million devices worldwide, including 41 million connected vehicles, supported by an ecosystem of 30+ mobile network operators. Enterprises rely on Aeris for the borderless connectivity, embedded security, observability, and proven scale that mission critical Physical AI programs demand.

The Opportunity

The Senior Solutions Architect, Automotive Connectivity is a strategic technical role at the intersection of automotive engineering, telecommunications, cloud platforms, and IoT. You will serve as the primary technical counterpart to automotive OEM engineering and IT teams, translating Aeris platform capabilities into compelling, architecturally sound solutions that address OEM connectivity challenges.

This is not a traditional pre-sales engineering role. You will operate as a technical strategist — shaping how Aeris engages with OEMs, influencing product direction, creating differentiated technical narratives, and building the technical foundation for long-term OEM partnerships.

You will work across two Aeris business units (Automotive Business Unit and IoT Business Unit), requiring fluency in multiple platform architectures and the ability to compose cross-platform solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Sales Engagement

  • Serve as the lead technical resource in OEM pre-sales engagements, RFI/RFP responses, solution presentations, and architecture workshops
  • Design and present solution architectures that map Aeris capabilities to OEM connectivity requirements
  • Develop and deliver compelling technical demonstrations, proofs of concept, and pilot designs
  • Engage directly with OEM technical stakeholders including connectivity architects, telematics engineers, platform engineering leads, cybersecurity teams, and procurement

Solution Architecture & Design

  • Architect end-to-end connected vehicle solutions spanning connectivity management, eSIM lifecycle management (SGP.22/SGP.32), device management, data ingestion, and vehicle operations
  • Design integration architectures connecting Aeris platforms (AMP, Neo, Watchtower) with OEM backend systems, TSPs, MNOs, and cloud environments
  • Define and document technical solution proposals, integration specifications, and architecture decision records
  • Evaluate and recommend approaches for multi-MNO strategies, regional connectivity models, and roaming optimization

Product Strategy Support

  • Translate OEM technical requirements and competitive gaps into structured product requirements and recommendations
  • Collaborate with Product Management to prioritize automotive-specific platform enhancements
  • Maintain a living competitive technical analysis covering key competitors (Harman Ignite, Ericsson, Cisco/Kigen, G+D, Thales, etc.)
  • Identify emerging technology trends (SDV, vehicle-to-cloud, Android Automotive, zonal architectures) and assess implications for Aeris product strategy

Knowledge Development & Enablement

  • Develop and maintain a technical knowledge base for Automotive Connectivity including solution architectures, reference designs, integration patterns, competitive comparisons, and technical FAQ
  • Create reusable technical assets: solution briefs, architecture diagrams, demo scripts, white papers, and technical blog content
  • Enable broader Sales and Sales Engineering teams on automotive connectivity concepts, Aeris differentiators, and OEM engagement best practices
  • Document OEM-specific technical landscapes, integration requirements, and architecture preferences

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Service Delivery and Professional Services teams to ensure solution designs are implementable and supportable
  • Partner with the Automotive Connectivity Strategy Lead to align technical positioning with business strategy
  • Support Marketing with technically grounded content for thought leadership, analyst engagements, and conference presentations
  • Participate in industry standards discussions and working groups as appropriate (GSMA, 5GAA, etc.)

Requirements

Experience

  • Senior experience in solutions architecture, technical pre-sales, systems engineering, or technical consulting
  • 3+ years working in or with the automotive industry — specifically connected vehicles, telematics, V2X, or automotive connectivity
  • Direct experience with eSIM technologies (SGP.02, SGP.22, SGP.32) — architecture, provisioning flows, and ecosystem participants (SM-DP+, SM-DS, eIM, ECS, LPA)
  • Experience with connectivity management platforms and/or IoT platform architectures
  • Demonstrated experience engaging with enterprise or OEM technical stakeholders at the architecture and engineering level
  • Experience with MNO ecosystems, MVNO models, roaming, and multi-carrier connectivity strategies

Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of cellular technologies (4G/LTE, 5G NR, network slicing, private networks)
  • Proficiency in cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including API design, microservices, event-driven architectures, and data pipelines
  • Familiarity with vehicle electrical/electronic architectures — TCUs, head units, gateways, zonal controllers
  • Working knowledge of automotive protocols and standards (MQTT, SOME/IP, UDS, OBD, CAN/CAN-FD, Ethernet)
  • Understanding of cybersecurity frameworks relevant to automotive (ISO 21434, UNECE WP.29 R155/R156)
  • Experience with data analytics, observability, or AIOps concepts (relevant to Watchtower positioning)

Soft Skills

  • Exceptional ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both engineering and business audiences
  • Strong written communication — capable of producing white papers, technical proposals, and executive-ready documentation
  • Self-directed and autonomous — comfortable operating with strategic guidance rather than detailed task management
  • Intellectually curious — proactive about learning new domains, technologies, and industry dynamics
  • Effective cross-functional collaborator — able to influence without authority across Product, Engineering, Delivery, and Sales teams.

Bonus Points (preferred skills)

  • Experience working for or directly with a Tier 1 automotive OEM (Toyota, VW Group, Stellantis, Hyundai/Kia, Renault, etc.) or a Tier 1 supplier (Bosch, Continental, Harman, LG, Denso)
  • Familiarity with GSMA specifications and the connected vehicle ecosystem (RSP, M2M, Consumer architectures)
  • Experience with OTA update platforms and software-defined vehicle concepts
  • Background in fleet management, telematics service providers (TSPs), or connected vehicle platforms
  • Experience with regulatory and compliance frameworks for connected vehicles (data privacy, type approval, regional homologation)
  • Exposure to AI/ML applications in automotive operations, predictive maintenance, or anomaly detection

Our Process

  • 30-min Recruiter Screening – Teams
  • 60-min Interview with the Hiring Manager – Teams
  • 60-min Technical Interview – Telecom technologies, Teams
  • 30-min ELT Interview - Teams

Please note that this reflects the current agreed interview process and may be adjusted or updated as the recruitment process progresses.

Why Aeris?

  • A front-row seat at the intersection of automotive engineering, IoT, and telecommunications
  • Real influence over product direction, not just client engagements
  • Autonomy to shape how Aeris positions itself with the world's leading OEMs
  • A collaborative, cross-functional environment where technical depth is genuinely valued
  • The opportunity to work on problems that are shaping the future of connected vehicles

Aeris is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status.

About the Role

We’re looking for a skilled AI Engineer to build, deploy, and improve AI-powered systems and features. You’ll work across the full development lifecycle, from prototyping and model development to production deployment, integration, and performance monitoring.

The ideal candidate has strong Python and machine learning skills, practical experience with NLP or LLM-based applications, and the ability to turn AI concepts into reliable, scalable products. Key Responsibilities

AI Model Development

  • Apply machine learning techniques to solve practical product and customer problems.

Pipeline Architecture & Performance

  • Design and maintain reliable, scalable data and model inference pipelines.
  • Optimize AI systems for performance, reliability, and efficiency.
  • Identify and resolve bottlenecks across data processing and model execution.

Integration & Deployment

  • Integrate AI models into existing product infrastructure and software systems.
  • Manage the process from experimentation and testing through deployment and monitoring.
  • Work with APIs and supporting infrastructure to ensure smooth integration.

Applied AI Research & Development

  • Translate relevant research and advancements into measurable product improvements.

Quality, Evaluation & Iteration

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Contribute to architecture decisions and technical roadmaps.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven hands-on experience building and deploying AI or machine learning systems in a professional environment.
  • Strong proficiency in Python.

jobs.excerpt: Mission + People + Culture: With a corporate Mission to stop disease through technology, InductiveHealth is the market leader in software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions to public health agencies.
jobs.description:
Mission + People + Culture: With a corporate Mission to stop disease through technology, InductiveHealth is the market leader in software-as-a-service (SaaS) solutions to public health agencies. Our People come from all backgrounds and walks of life ranging from world class experts in epidemiology, informatics, and disease surveillance to engineers and product teams building high performance, modern solutions. Mission + People are unified around a virtual first Culture centered around teamwork, relentless focus on client outcomes, and individual accountability.

Why work at InductiveHealth?

1. Motivation: We value initiative-takers and self-starters who want to contribute to the success of our Team and client outcomes.
2. Curiosity: Seeking to understand and comprehend is critical - we expect and encourage questions to master job duties and grow professionally.
3. Organization: We are a Team. This means we hold each other accountable and have high expectations for performance and outcomes.
4. Feedback: "Open and honest" is part of our corporate values that builds a culture of professional growth to support client success.
5. Impact: Your individual contributions will stop the spread of disease and improve individual, community, and population health outcomes.

This role is central to building our future-state architecture by modernizing how public health data moves, transforms, and informs decision-making at scale. You will contribute to the design and implementation of next-generation pipelines, ensure data reliability and compliance, and partner with integration teams on the migration from legacy systems.

As part of a collaborative, agile team, you'll work closely with data architects, integration engineers, data scientists, and product stakeholders to deliver solutions that directly impact public health outcomes. The ideal candidate thrives in complex data environments, is motivated by meaningful mission-driven work, and brings strong technical expertise and a collaborative mindset to help advance our interoperability platform.

What You’ll Be Doing

    • Play a key role in shaping the future of our data interoperability platform.

    • Design and operate secure, high-performance data pipelines for real-time and batch public health data flows.

    • Architect and implement scalable solutions that move sensitive health data reliably and meet strict security and compliance standards.

    • Build and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines using NiFi, Kafka, Python, and SQL.

    • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for NiFi flows, Python, and SQL using GitHub and GitHub Actions, including flow versioning through NiFi Registry and automated promotion across dev, test, and production.

    • Deploy and operate data pipelines on Azure and AWS, partnering with DevOps/SRE to integrate them into existing cloud infrastructure and tooling.

    • Apply CI/CD best practices: pull request reviews, branch protection, automated testing and validation, parameterized environment configuration, and versioned releases with rollback.

    • Collaborate with interoperability, product, and data science teams to migrate legacy pipelines to modern architectures.

    • Fine-tune data lakes and ensure smooth data exchange across systems.

    • Define monitoring and alerting strategies (e.g., Grafana dashboards and alerts) and create runbooks to support operational teams.

    • Troubleshoot production issues to maintain stable and performant pipelines.

    • Drive continuous improvement across the data ecosystem through collaboration, innovation, and strong execution.

    • Contribute directly to building and delivering high-quality, scalable integrations that drive rapid product progress.

    • Collaborate closely with teammates to share knowledge and ensure smooth, efficient development workflows.

What We're Looking For

    • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

    • 3+ years of experience implementing enterprise-grade data pipelines, or 7+ years of related professional experience (e.g., software, data, or integration engineering) that includes building and operating production data pipelines.

    • Hands-on expertise with NiFi, Kafka, Python, and SQL, including designing, operating, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines in the cloud.

    • Proven ability to build robust, production-grade pipelines from the ground up and work confidently with distributed data systems.

    • Hands-on experience deploying and operating data pipelines in Azure or AWS, including secure handling of sensitive data (IAM/RBAC, encryption, secrets management).

    • Experience implementing CI/CD best practices for data pipelines with GitHub and GitHub Actions, including NiFi flow versioning and promotion (NiFi Registry), automated testing, and peer-reviewed releases.

    • Able to partner with DevOps/SRE to integrate pipelines into existing tooling (not responsible for overall platform design).

    • Experience using or integrating with OpenSearch/Elasticsearch.

    • Practical experience using relational databases and existing schemas (implementing against established data models; extending under guidance).

    • Strong understanding of data security and compliance requirements for sensitive data.

    • Excellent cross-functional collaborator with clear communication and strong technical documentation skills, able to translate complex engineering concepts into clear strategies for cross-functional partners.

    • A curious, proactive problem solver with a growth mindset who thrives in fast-paced, agile environments and is motivated by mission-driven work and complex interoperability challenges.

What Would Make You Stand Out

    • Deep technical expertise paired with a strong understanding of public health data environments.

    • Experience with healthcare data standards such as HL7 v2.x, FHIR, and terminologies like LOINC, CVX, SNOMED, and ICD-10.

    • Proven success building event-driven architectures with Kafka or implementing data de-identification strategies.

    • Hands-on experience with integration engines (e.g., Rhapsody, Mirth) and containerized deployments (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).

    • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform, Bicep, or CloudFormation) and automated deployment of NiFi or Kafka environments.

    • Experience with monitoring and observability for data pipelines using Grafana (plus cloud-native tools such as Azure Monitor or CloudWatch).

    • Demonstrated ability to scale data platforms in production environments.

    • Familiarity with Master Patient Index (MPI) solutions or data deduplication frameworks.

    • Bring a proactive mindset: anticipating challenges, designing with scalability and security in mind, and delivering solutions that accelerate time to product.

Benefits and Perks: InductiveHealth offers competitive benefits and perks including:
· Virtual first, remote organization and culture
· Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)
· 401(k) retirement plan with corporate matching
· Medical, prescription, vision, and dental coverage (multiple plans based on your needs)
· Short Term and Long Term Disability (for employee)
· Life Insurance (for employee)
· New Team Member support for home office setup
Target Salary Bands: Each team member’s compensation decisions are based on several inputs, and we expect many of the candidates who are offered positions to fall within the advertised salary band. We recognize that the team member hired may be less (or more) experienced than the posted job description therefore impacting compensation decisions.
About InductiveHealth: InductiveHealth () was co-founded by Matthew Dollacker and Stephen Macauley in 2013. Today, InductiveHealth is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia and has over 80 team members across the United States supporting state, tribal, local, and territorial (STLT) public health agencies in addition to Federal agencies such as the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC). In early 2021, InductiveHealth became the exclusive commercial partner of Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (JHU/APL) for the Electronic Surveillance System for the Early Notification of Community-based Epidemics (ESSENCE) syndromic surveillance solution. To accelerate growth in the wake of the COVID-19 pandemic, InductiveHealth become a portfolio company of Diversis Capital () in early 2022.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areFlow Pouch makes functional mushroom pouches.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Flow Pouch makes functional mushroom pouches. People use them as a clean alternative to nicotine pouches and energy products: no nicotine, no caffeine, no crash. We launched in 2024, we have grown quickly, mostly through subscriptions, and we manufacture in the US. We are a remote team of about 30 people across the US, Europe and the Philippines.

Why we are hiring

Our technology has grown faster than our ownership of it. The Shopify store and its apps, the A/B testing stack, a growing set of internal AI tools the founders have built themselves, a VPS or two, and soon a mobile app: today all of this is looked after by the founders, an agency that is being phased out, and freelancers. We want one technical person who owns all of it, keeps it running, decides what gets built in-house and what gets bought, and leads the developer, the designer and the AI builders who do the work.

You would report to Djordje, our co-founder who runs operations and work closely with both founders. This is a hands-on lead role: you will write and review code yourself, and you will also be the person the rest of the company calls when something technical breaks.

What you will own

  • The store. Shopify theme, apps, checkout, settings, integrations with our subscription, email and analytics tools. Nothing breaks, and when it does you know first.

  • Testing and site changes. The A/B tests our team wants to run get implemented quickly and correctly, about eight a month today.

  • Internal tools. The AI-assisted apps the founders have built for the creative team: take them over, harden them, host them properly, and build the next ones.

  • The mobile app. We are planning an iOS and Android app. You scope it, pick the approach and the people, and run the build.

  • Infrastructure and security. Hosting, VPS maintenance, access control, backups, domains, the basics done properly.

  • The team. A Shopify developer and a web and brand designer report to you from day one, AI builders join as we grow, and you will help hire our SEO lead. You set standards, review work and unblock people.

What this role is not

This is not a CRO strategy role; our team decides what to test, you make the tests happen. It is not a pure management role either: with a team this small you will be in the code most days. And it is not an agency relationship; we want one person who treats our stack as their own.

Who we are looking for

  • You have five or more years as a developer and at least two leading a small technical team or being the sole technical owner at a company.

  • You know Shopify deeply: Liquid and OS 2.0 themes, apps and checkout extensibility, the common DTC app stack (Recharge or Skio, Klaviyo, a CRO tool, GA4).

  • You are comfortable across the stack: a modern JavaScript or TypeScript codebase, a Python or Node backend, Linux servers, Git, basic networking and security.

  • You build with AI tools every day and have shipped something real with them, and you can tell us what they are bad at.

  • You have shipped or managed a mobile app, or you can show us how you would approach a first one.

  • You communicate clearly in English with non-technical founders and you say no when something is a bad idea.

  • You are based in Europe or within a few hours of Central European time; some overlap with US Eastern afternoons is needed.

What is hard about this

We would rather you hear it now than in month three:

  • You inherit systems built fast by founders and freelancers, with thin documentation. The first months are as much archaeology as engineering.

  • The founders are technical enough to build their own tools and will have opinions. You need to earn the right to say "we do it this way" through results.

  • Priorities change quickly. A request on Monday can be live by Thursday, and you will be the one keeping that from becoming chaos.

  • The team is small. There is no platform team behind you.

The engagement

Type

Full-time contractor

Compensation

Very competitive, set with the person. We would rather hear your expectation than anchor you with a number.

Location

Remote. Europe preferred.

Reports to

Djordje, our co-founder who runs operations

Team

Shopify developer and web and brand designer from day one; AI builders and SEO to follow.

Start

November 2026.

How to apply

Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile, plus short answers to three questions:

  1. A system you took over from someone else and made reliable. What did you find, what did you change first, and why?

  2. Something you have built with AI tools in the last six months that is in real use. What did the tools get wrong?

  3. Your location, time zone, notice period and earliest start date.

jobs.description:
Managing twenty-five scheduler cells by hand does not scale, and we are not going to try. NVIDIA is building a config-as-code foundation for its EDA compute farm, and we need an automation engineer to own it end to end. You are joining at the point where this is still partially manual and inconsistently applied across cells. That is the interesting version of the problem — you will be migrating off partial systems and reconciling drift, not starting from a blank repository.


What you'll be doing:

  • Designing and owning the configuration schema for LSF cell deployment, so that a policy change is written once, reviewed, tested, and applied identically everywhere it belongs.
  • Building the deployment pipeline that takes scheduler configuration from merge to production across a federated estate, including staged rollout and rollback.
  • Eliminating configuration drift across cells, and building the tooling that keeps it eliminated.
  • Standing up the regression suite that lets us upgrade LSF on a schedule rather than on a dare.
  • Working alongside our LSF internals engineer to encode hard-won scheduler knowledge into templates and policy, so that expertise lives in the repository instead of in one person's head.

What we need to see:

  • BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience.
  • 6+ years in infrastructure engineering with strong config management depth — Ansible, Salt, Puppet, Chef, or comparable.
  • Real experience with GitOps practice at scale: review workflow, environment promotion, drift detection, and safe rollback.
  • Proficiency in Go, Python and shell, and comfort building the tooling rather than only using it.
  • Experience automating stateful, long-lived infrastructure where you cannot simply destroy and recreate.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:
